summary.en: The day's news unfolds with Prime Minister Anthony Albanese dismissing concerns about the powers within a digital duty of care bill. He argues that criticisms from Nationals leader Matt Canavan, regarding the Communications Minister Anika Wells potentially having too much power to expand content regulations, are...
summary.zh: 当日新闻动态，总理阿尔巴尼斯驳斥了对数字责任法案中权力设定的担忧。他认为，国家党领袖马特·卡纳万关于通讯部长阿妮卡·韦尔斯可能拥有过大权力来扩大平台需保护用户免受的内容范围的批评是虚伪的。阿尔巴尼斯指出，拟议的措施将像以往的立法一样，受到议会否决的约束。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live Albanese dismisses concerns over powers in digital duty of care bill Anthony Albanese says the Nationals leader, Matt Canavan, is being “disingenuous” over his criticisms that the communications minister, Anika Wells, will have too much power under the new digital duty of care legislation. The eSafety commissioner will of course provide the advice, but Matt Canavan actually knows that he’s being disingenuous because all of these things will be disallowable. That is, will be up to the whole parliament, like the other previous laws have been. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 表示，国家党领袖马特·卡纳万 (Matt Canavan) 批评通讯部长阿尼卡·韦尔斯 (Anika Wells) 拥有太多权力，无法扩大平台在新的数字注意义务立法下保护用户免受影响的内容。电子安全专员当然会提供建议，但马特·卡纳万实际上知道他是不诚实的，因为所有这些事情都是不允许的。也就是说，将由整个议会决定，就像之前的其他法律一样。否则，为了做出改变，你必须做的就是改变立法，所以要一次又一次地挺身而出。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In political discourse, debates often arise concerning the scope of governmental power and the protection of citizens. The exchange over the digital duty of care bill touches on how authority is wielded and checked. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true governance involves not just laws, but also acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, a...
reflection.zh: 在政治论述中，关于政府权力的范围和公民保护的辩论常常出现。关于数字责任法案的争论触及了权力的运用和制约方式。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的治理不仅在于法律，还在于秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这一原则可以指导领导者在权力和责任之间取得平衡。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

Missouri congressional maps thrown into chaos after conflicting court rulings Sign up for US Breaking News emails Further down the ballot in New Hampshire, the Democratic primary for Chris Pappas’s House seat has drawn eight candidates, with Stefany Shaheen – daughter of the outgoing senator – and Maura Sullivan , a former Obama administration official, leading the field. body.zh: 政界人士中的州参议员回击总统的社交媒体帖子，称新墨西哥州应该改为“新美国”。在新罕布什尔州的投票中，克里斯·帕帕斯众议院席位的民主党初选已经吸引了八名候选人，其中即将卸任参议员的女儿斯蒂芬妮·沙欣和前奥巴马政府官员莫拉·沙利文领先。这个长紫色的选区自 2017 年以来一直是可靠的蓝色。共和党人现在认为它是可以翻转的，唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 在共和党竞选中支持拥有多家汽车经销店的商人安东尼·迪洛伦佐 (Anthony DiLorenzo)。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Disputes over names and symbols, like the suggestion to rename New Mexico, often reflect deeper debates about national identity and values. Proverbs 14:34 reminds us that a nation's moral character is foundational to its flourishing. Political discourse can easily become a battle of egos, but the enduring health of a society depends on its commitment to...
reflection.zh: 关于名称和象征的争论，例如将新墨西哥州更名的提议，常常反映出对国家身份和价值观的更深层次辩论。《箴言》14:34 提醒我们，一个国家的道德品格是其繁荣的基础。政治言论很容易变成一场自负的较量，但社会的持久健康取决于其对公义的承诺。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Pilots tried to abort landing seconds before deadly Amazon cargo plane crash that killed five
title.zh: 亚马逊货运飞机在迈阿密机场坠毁，造成五人死亡

summary.en: An Amazon cargo plane crashed at Miami International Airport on Saturday, resulting in the deaths of five individuals who were employees of an aircraft cleaning company. Preliminary evidence from the flight data recorder suggests the pilots may have considered aborting the landing before the crash.
summary.zh: 周六，一架亚马逊货运飞机在迈阿密国际机场坠毁，造成五名飞机清洁公司员工死亡。飞行数据记录器中的初步证据表明，飞行员可能在坠机前考虑过放弃着陆。

body.en: The five people killed were employees of an aircraft cleaning company who were in a van struck by the plane after it overran the Miami airport runway At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport Officials in Florida on Tuesday said evidence collected from Saturday’s Amazon cargo plane crash at Miami international airport suggests the pilots considered aborting the flight’s landing before it crashed and killed five people on the ground. At a press conference Tuesday evening, officials from the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) released data from the plane’s “black box” flight data recorder, which was recovered from the wreckage on Monday, indicating pilots initiated a “go-around”, or aborted landing, seconds before impact. Reuters contributed reporting Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚马逊货机在迈阿密机场坠毁后，至少有五人死亡，佛罗里达州官员周二表示，从周六在迈阿密国际机场发生的亚马逊货机坠毁事件中收集到的证据表明，在飞机坠毁并造成地面五人死亡之前，飞行员考虑过中止飞机着陆。在周二晚上的新闻发布会上，美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）的官员公布了周一从残骸中找到的飞机“黑匣子”飞行数据记录器的数据，表明飞行员在撞击前几秒钟启动了“复飞”或中止着陆。路透社贡献报道继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of the Amazon cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport brings a stark reminder of the fragility of life and the suddenness of loss. Five lives, belonging to employees of an aircraft cleaning company, were tragically cut short. In moments of such profound grief, we look to the ultimate hope that even death and suffering will one day cease.
reflection.zh: 迈阿密国际机场亚马逊货运飞机坠毁的消息，令人痛心地提醒我们生命的脆弱和失去的突然。五条生命——飞机清洁公司的员工——不幸被过早地夺走。在如此深切的悲痛时刻，我们仰望那最终的盼望，知道死亡和痛苦终将止息。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

A lone juror in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother accused of murdering her three children, would not agree to acquit Clancy despite expressing reasonable...

Speaking to NBC 10 Boston just days after Clancy’s trial ended in a mistrial , Roni Carlson, the foreperson, confirmed there was one holdout juror who would not be persuaded to acquit Clancy due to insanity. reflection.en: This trial's mistrial, stemming from one juror's inability to reach a consensus despite expressing doubt, underscores the complexities of justice and human judgment. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that in any dispute, the first voice heard is not always the final word, and true understanding requires listening to all perspectives before a just conclusion can be...
reflection.zh: 这场审判因一名陪审员尽管表达了怀疑但仍无法达成共识而导致审判无效，这凸显了司法和人类判断的复杂性。箴言 18:17 提醒我们，在任何争论中，第一个听到的声音并不总是最终的定论，而真正的理解需要倾听所有观点，才能达成公正的结论。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
title.zh: 英国宣布对约旦河西岸定居点实施制裁，引发以色列愤怒回应

summary.en: Britain has imposed sanctions on Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, with the UK's foreign secretary accusing settlers of "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians. Israel's foreign minister responded by calling the accusation an "outrageous lie" and announced the closure of the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem.
summary.zh: 英国已对约旦河西岸的以色列定居点实施制裁，英国外交大臣指责定居者对巴勒斯坦人进行“种族清洗”。以色列外交部长回应称这一指控是“骇人听闻的谎言”，并宣布关闭英国驻东耶路撒冷领事馆。

body.en:
The UK has announced sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, accusing Israel's government of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians by settlers.

Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said the move marked the "beginning of a new approach" to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, which "not only calls out injustice and suffering but acts".

Israel's Foreign Minister Gideon Saar responded by accusing him of spreading an "outrageous lie" and announced counter-measures including shutting the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem.

The UK sanctions will ban settlement goods but also act against companies and individuals providing services for settlement expansion.

The sanctions were launched alongside France and Canada, which in a joint statement with the UK said the action "marks a further turning point in our approach to protecting the two-state solution".

Settlements are illegal under international law, and there has been a rise in violence towards Palestinians in the West Bank by settlers in recent months.

In a statement to MPs, Miliband said: "The British government agrees that there is ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in areas of the West Bank, perpetrated by settler terrorists.

"And all too often the Israeli government has turned a blind eye to this and worse, members of it have made statements and taken actions to support the forced displacement of Palestinians."

He said ethnic cleansing was defined by the UN as a "purposeful policy designed by one ethnic or religious group to remove by violent means another ethnic or religious group from certain areas".

Miliband said the official view of the government was that the Israeli occupation of the West Bank was unlawful because of the "entrenchment of its control, its intention to extend permanent sovereignty, and its expansionist agenda via illegal settlements".

He said this position, which is in line with a 2024 advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice, should be reflected in the UK's "economic relationship" with the occupied West Bank.

As a result, over the next six to nine months, the UK will introduce "a new comprehensive sanctions regime", he said.

The foreign secretary also announced a ban on advertising illegal West Bank settlements in the UK.

"The sanctions regime will target illegal settlements and settlement expansion, not Israel," Miliband added.

Later on Tuesday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the targeted measures were "aimed not at the Israeli people, but in support of the two-state solution".

Announcing the closure of the consulate - which represents the UK government in Jerusalem, the West Bank and Gaza - Israel's Foreign Minister Saar said at a press conference: "We know that we have many friends in...
body.zh: 英国宣布对被占领约旦河西岸的以色列非法定居点实施制裁，指责以色列政府对定居者对巴勒斯坦人的“种族清洗”视而不见。 外交大臣埃德·米利班德表示，此举标志着解决以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突“新方法的开始”，“不仅呼吁不公正和痛苦，而且采取行动”。 以色列外交部长吉迪恩·萨尔回应称，他散布“令人发指的谎言”，并宣布了包括关闭英国驻东耶路撒冷领事馆在内的反制措施。 英国的制裁将禁止定居点货物，但也会针对为定居点扩张提供服务的公司和个人。 这些制裁是与法国和加拿大一起发起的，法国和加拿大在与英国的联合声明中表示，这一行动“标志着我们保护两国解决方案的方法的进一步转折点”。 根据国际法，定居点是非法的，近几个月来，定居者对西岸巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为有所增加。 米利班德在给国会议员的一份声明中说：“英国政府同意定居恐怖分子在西岸地区对巴勒斯坦人进行种族清洗。 “以色列政府常常对此视而不见，更糟糕的是，其成员发表声明并采取行动支持巴勒斯坦人被迫流离失所。” 他说，联合国将种族清洗定义为“一个民族或宗教团体制定的有目的的政策，以暴力手段将另一个民族或宗教团体驱逐出某些地区”。 米利班德表示，政府的官方观点是，以色列对约旦河西岸的占领是非法的，因为“其控制的巩固、扩大永久主权的意图以及通过非法定居点的扩张主义议程”。 他表示，这一立场与国际法院2024年的咨询意见一致，应反映在英国与被占领约旦河西岸的“经济关系”中。 他表示，因此，在未来六到九个月内，英国将推出“新的全面制裁制度”。 外交大臣还宣布禁止在英国为非法西岸定居点做广告。 米利班德补充说：“制裁制度将针对非法定居点和定居点扩张，而不是以色列。” 周二晚些时候，总理安迪·伯纳姆表示，这些有针对性的措施“不是针对以色列人民，而是为了支持两国解决方案”。 以色列外交部长萨尔在新闻发布会上宣布关闭代表英国政府驻耶路撒冷、约旦河西岸和加沙的领事馆：“我们知道我们在英国有很多朋友。 "Unfortunately, we...

reflection.en: The UK's decision to sanction West Bank settlements, citing "ethnic cleansing," highlights a stark geopolitical conflict. This action, and Israel's sharp retort, underscores the difficulty of navigating justice and human rights in international relations. The call to "act justly and to love mercy" remains a profound challenge for nations and peoples locked...
reflection.zh: 英国决定对约旦河西岸定居点实施制裁，并以“种族清洗”为由，凸显了严峻的地缘政治冲突。这一行动以及以色列的尖锐回应，突显了在国际关系中处理公正和人权的困难。《雅伟》呼吁“施行公义，喜爱怜悯”仍然是深陷此类争端的国家和人民面临的严峻挑战。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

However, it will not follow the UK, France, and Canada in implementing a blanket trade ban with these settlements. Australia's Foreign Minister, Penny Wong, expressed concerns about a broad ban and indicated...

This reflects a desire to advocate for those affected by settlement policies, aligning with the biblical call to...

title.en: US slaps import ban on Canadian alcohol and other goods
title.zh: 美国禁止进口加拿大酒类及其他商品

summary.en: The US is banning a slew of Canadian products, including alcoholic spirits, dairy goods, and motor vehicles, as Canadian retaliatory tariffs on American goods come into force. This is the latest escalation in a trade war between the two countries, with no new talks scheduled since negotiations collapsed in late August.
summary.zh: 随着加拿大对美国商品实施报复性关税，美国正在禁止包括酒精饮料、乳制品和汽车在内的一系列加拿大产品。这是两国贸易战的最新升级，自8月下旬谈判破裂以来，双方未安排新的会谈。

body.en:
The US is banning a slew of Canadian products, including alcoholic spirits, dairy goods and motor vehicles, as Canadian retaliatory tariffs on American goods come into force.

In a series of executive orders on Tuesday, US President Donald Trump said that Canada is "discriminating" against the United States and outlined the import ban, to begin 29 September.

Earlier on Tuesday, Canada Prime Minister Mark Carney said in a video address that his country's pivot away from the US as its largest trading partner "will come at a cost".

Both US and Canadian officials have said they would like to strike a trade deal, but no new talks have been scheduled since negotiations collapsed in late August.

The BBC has contacted the office of the Prime Minister of Canada, Mark Carney, for comment.

The White House's new sanctions are the latest strike in a months-long trade war between the US and Canada. The sides have historically been close allies, with each a key business partner to the other.

The US is Canada's largest trading partner - generally more than two-thirds of its total exports go to its neighbour.

On the other hand, Canada is the US' second-largest trading partner, after Mexico, although its exports are far more diversified.

Business owners on both sides of the border have expressed fears over the trade war's fallout . Many expect prices of goods to rise and the number of customers to fall.

Last month, the White House had imposed 50% tariffs on around $20bn (£14.8bn) of Canadian goods after several rounds of talks had broken down.

Those tariffs hit sectors including Canada's furniture and wine industries, as well as sporting and fishing equipment businesses.

Canada responded with dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on US goods like steel, clothing and furniture. The counter-duties came into effect after midnight on Tuesday.

Canada is "discriminating" against US businesses by restricting the distribution of US goods while not doing the same to such products from other countries, the White House said when announcing the new import restrictions on Tuesday.

The response targets various alcoholic drinks and dairy products like whey, according to a series of White House statements signed by the president.

On Monday, Trump hinted at more trade restrictions to come, warning Canadian aircraft company Bombardier that it would no longer be able to sell its products in the US unless it moves manufacturing there.

Trump has long believed that tariffs will help reduce trade imbalances between the US and other countries, but his wide-ranging tariffs scheme has upset many of the States' traditional allies.

In August, Trump ordered Lake Ontario to be renamed as Lake America , resulting in uproar from Canadians and some Americans.
body.zh: 随着加拿大对美国商品征收报复性关税生效，美国正在禁止大量加拿大产品，包括烈酒、乳制品和机动车辆。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在周二发布的一系列行政命令中表示，加拿大“歧视”美国，并概述了将于 9 月 29 日开始实施的进口禁令。 周二早些时候，加拿大总理马克·卡尼在视频讲话中表示，加拿大放弃美国作为其最大贸易伙伴的地位“将付出代价”。 美国和加拿大官员均表示希望达成贸易协议，但自八月底谈判破裂以来尚未安排新的谈判。 BBC 已联系加拿大总理马克·卡尼办公室征求评论。 白宫的新制裁是美国和加拿大之间长达数月的贸易战中的最新打击。双方历来都是亲密盟友，彼此都是对方的重要商业伙伴。 美国是加拿大最大的贸易伙伴——其出口总额的三分之二以上销往其邻国。 另一方面，加拿大是美国第二大贸易伙伴，仅次于墨西哥，尽管其出口更加多元化。 边境两边的企业主都表达了对贸易战后果的担忧。许多人预计商品价格会上涨，而顾客数量会下降。 上个月，在几轮谈判破裂后，白宫对约 200 亿美元（148 亿英镑）的加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税。 这些关税打击了加拿大家具和葡萄酒行业以及体育和渔业设备行业等行业。 作为回应，加拿大对钢铁、服装和家具等美国商品征收报复性关税。反关税措施于周二午夜后生效。 白宫在周二宣布新的进口限制时表示，加拿大限制美国商品的分销，而不是对其他国家的此类产品采取同样的措施，这是对美国企业的“歧视”。 根据总统签署的一系列白宫声明，这一应对措施针对的是各种酒精饮料和乳清等乳制品。 周一，特朗​​普暗示将实施更多贸易限制，并警告加拿大飞机公司庞巴迪，除非将生产转移到美国，否则它将无法再在美国销售其产品。 特朗普长期以来一直认为关税将有助于减少美国与其他国家之间的贸易失衡，但他范围广泛的关税计划令美国许多传统盟友感到不安。 8月，特朗普下令将安大略湖更名为美洲湖，引起加拿大人和部分美国人的轩然大波。

reflection.en: The escalating trade war between the US and Canada, marked by import bans and retaliatory tariffs, highlights a breakdown in peaceful relations. The call to 'live at peace with everyone' (Romans 12:18) is a profound challenge when economic and political tensions rise, urging a pursuit of reconciliation even amidst conflict.
reflection.zh: 美加之间不断升级的贸易战，以进口禁令和报复性关税为标志，凸显了和平关系的破裂。《罗马书》12章18节呼吁“务要随众和睦”，这在经济和政治紧张局势加剧时是一个深刻的挑战，敦促人们在冲突中也要寻求和解。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Fine art thieves nab two 'priceless' Renoir paintings from French museum
title.zh: 法国博物馆两幅“无价”雷诺阿画作被盗艺术品大盗落网

summary.en: Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera on Tuesday. Local authorities described the robbery as a "wake-up call" regarding the protection of fine art.
summary.zh: 周二，两名窃贼在法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆盗走了两幅雷诺阿的画作。当地官员称此次盗窃是对艺术品展示和保护方式的一次“警钟”。

body.en:
Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera on Tuesday.

Local authorities said the pair broke in shortly before 6 am (2 pm AEST) by cutting a hole in a garden fence and entering through a window.

The stolen paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir, whose most valuable works have fetched dozens of millions of dollars at auctions, were Madame Colonna Romano and Young Woman at the Well. Both belong to Paris' famous Orsay Museum and were on loan to the museum.

The thieves had taken two more paintings, Madame Pichon and Coco Reading, a portrayal of Claude, the young son of the famous Impressionist artist, but dropped them in the gardens as police, alerted by alarms, arrived and gave chase, local mayor Bryan Masson and the Marseille prosecutor's office said.

Masson said of the paintings, "They are priceless; you cannot sell them just like that."

The Marseille prosecutor added that an investigation had been opened into theft by an organised gang.

The museum, set up in 1960 in Renoir's mansion on a hill near Nice where he died in 1919, had 13 paintings by the master on display and some 40 sculptures, items of furniture and photographs.

Masson, a member of the far-right National Rally (RN) party, called for greater security for museums around France.

"This incident should serve as a wake-up call about the protection of our museums, which are now facing a new form of crime targeting works of art," he said.

The French government has come under pressure to tackle dramatic failures in the security of the country’s museums.

A French parliamentary report this summer said museums lacked resources and were ill-prepared to safeguard precious artworks and cultural artefacts.

A culture ministry survey in 2024 found that only one in four institutions had an emergency and risk-prevention plan, and nearly half lacked any video surveillance.

Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad hoc opportunists recruited through social media, pan-European police body Europol said last month.

It cited a heist at the Louvre Museum in Paris in October last year as a prime example. Other French museums were also targeted in the past months.

"They are attacking all museums now, we must react," Luc, a neighbour of the Renoir museum, told BFM TV.

body.zh: 周二，两名小偷从法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆偷走了两幅雷诺阿的画作。 地方当局称，两人在早上 6 点（澳大利亚东部时间下午 2 点）前不久，在花园栅栏上挖了一个洞，然后从窗户进入。 皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿最有价值的作品在拍卖会上以数千万美元成交，被盗的画作是《科隆纳·罗马诺夫人》和《井边的年轻女子》。这两件作品均属于巴黎著名的奥赛博物馆，并被该博物馆借出。 当地市长布莱恩·马森(Bryan Masson)和马赛检察官办公室表示，窃贼又拿走了两幅画作《皮尚夫人》(Madame Pichon)和《可可·雷丁》(Coco Reading)，画的是著名印象派艺术家的小儿子克洛德(Claude)，但当警察接到警报后赶到并追赶时，窃贼把它们扔到了花园里。当地市长布莱恩·马森(Bryan Masson)和马赛检察官办公室表示。 马森谈到这些画作时说：“它们是无价的；你不能就这样卖掉它们。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 马赛检察官补充说，已对一个有组织团伙的盗窃行为展开调查。 该博物馆建于 1960 年，位于雷诺阿位于尼斯附近一座小山上的宅邸，雷诺阿于 1919 年在尼斯去世，馆内展出了这位大师的 13 幅画作以及约 40 件雕塑、家具和照片。 马森是极右翼国家集会党 (RN) 的成员，他呼吁加强法国各地博物馆的安全。 他说：“这一事件应该为我们的博物馆的保护敲响警钟，我们的博物馆现在面临着一种针对艺术品的新形式的犯罪​​。” 法国政府面临着解决该国博物馆安全方面严重失误的压力。 今年夏天的一份法国议会报告称，博物馆缺乏资源，而且在保护珍贵艺术品和文化文物方面准备不足。 文化部2024年的一项调查发现，只有四分之一的机构制定了应急和风险防范计划，近一半的机构没有视频监控。 泛欧警察机构欧洲刑警组织上个月表示，欧洲的艺术品窃贼正在实施更加暴力的抢劫，专业团伙已被通过社交媒体招募的临时机会主义者所取代。 它以去年十月巴黎卢浮宫博物馆发生的抢劫案为例。过去几个月，其他法国博物馆也成为攻击目标。 雷诺阿博物馆的邻居吕克告诉 BFM 电视台：“他们现在正在袭击所有博物馆，我们必须做出反应。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The audacious theft of two Renoir masterpieces, valued in the millions, speaks to the human heart's susceptibility to coveting what is not theirs. The pursuit of such 'treasures' often leads down paths of deceit and illegality, ultimately bringing no lasting good, as the proverb warns that dishonest scales are an abomination to Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 盗窃两幅价值连城的雷诺阿杰作，揭示了人心对不属于自己的东西的贪婪。对这些“珍宝”的追求常常导致欺骗和非法行为，最终不会带来任何持久的好处，正如箴言所警示的，不公的秤是雅伟所憎恶的。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Meta continues to run ads promoting child sexual abuse material in India - report
title.zh: Meta在印度继续投放宣传儿童性虐待内容的广告 - 报告

summary.en: A report by the Tech Transparency Project found that Meta ran hundreds of paid ads featuring AI-generated child sexual abuse imagery, including 274 in August alone, with many appearing in India despite a government order to remove such content.
summary.zh: 根据华盛顿特区的科技透明项目（Tech Transparency Project）的一份报告，Meta在过去10个月内投放了数百个包含人工智能生成的儿童性虐待图像的付费广告，其中274个广告于今年8月投放，许多广告出现在印度，尽管印度政府已下令移除此类内容。

body.en:
Meta ran hundreds of paid ads with artificial intelligence-generated child sexual abuse imagery, including several in India, over the past 10 months, a new report by US-based campaigners has found.

The report comes two months after the Indian government ordered Meta to remove all ads and content promoting child sexual abuse material (CSAM) on Instagram. This was in the aftermath of a BBC Eye investigation which found that Instagram was running paid adverts promoting CSAM in India.

Washington-based Tech Transparency Project (TTP) , external says it found 332 adverts with CSAM that ran on Facebook and Instagram, the majority of them (274) in August this year.

When the BBC wrote to Meta about these findings, they said in a statement, "We don't tolerate nudify apps or any kind of child exploitation, whether real or AI-generated. These criminals constantly shift tactics to evade detection, which is why we keep strengthening our detection and enforcement."

The TTP report, published on Tuesday, says that it identified several photos of real children, including a member of a European royal family, that were used in the ads and then manipulated using AI. It says more than a dozen ads appeared on Meta platforms even after TTP made the company aware of its findings.

About a quarter (84) of the ads ran in India and 78 of these were published after the Indian government's order on removing CSAM and its meeting with senior Meta officials.

After the BBC investigation, several Indian agencies including the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights and the National Human Rights Commission have said they are examining the matter.

The distribution of CSAM is a criminal offence in India, while Meta's policy states that ads must not contain content that sexually exploits or endangers children.

When the BBC contacted Meta about its investigation, it said that when it becomes aware of apparent child exploitation, it reports it to the US-based National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) in compliance with its legal obligations.

The NCMEC is the centralised global reporting system for the online sexual exploitation of children.

But Bhuwan Ribhu, the founder of Just Rights for Children, a network of more than 250 organisations working to prevent violence against children in India, says this is not enough.

Just Rights for Children has filed a petition in India's Supreme Court, citing the BBC's findings, and asked for directions to social media platforms for mandatory reporting and identification of those promoting child sexual abuse material

"Social media companies are clearly flouting Indian laws by not reporting child sexual abuse content to Indian law enforcement agencies as mandated by our child protection laws," said Ribhu.

body.zh: 美国活动人士的一份新报告发现，在过去 10 个月里，Meta 投放了数百个带有人工智能生成的儿童性虐待图像的付费广告，其中包括在印度的几个广告。 该报告发布两个月前，印度政府命令 Meta 删除 Instagram 上所有宣传儿童性虐待内容 (CSAM) 的广告和内容。这是在 BBC Eye 调查发现 Instagram 在印度投放推广 CSAM 的付费广告之后发生的。 总部位于华盛顿的技术透明度项目 (TTP) 外部表示，它发现 Facebook 和 Instagram 上投放了 332 个 CSAM 广告，其中大多数（274 个）是在今年 8 月发布的。 当 BBC 就这些发现写信给 Meta 时，他们在一份声明中表示，“我们不会容忍裸体应用程序或任何形式的儿童剥削，无论是真实的还是人工智能生成的。这些犯罪分子不断改变策略来逃避检测，这就是我们不断加强检测和执法的原因。” TTP 周二发布的报告称，它发现了广告中使用的几张真实儿童的照片，其中包括一名欧洲王室成员，然后使用人工智能进行了处理。据称，即使在 TTP 让公司了解其调查结果后，Meta 平台上仍出现了十多个广告。 大约四分之一 (84) 条广告在印度投放，其中 78 条是在印度政府下令删除 CSAM 并与 Meta 高级官员会面后发布的。 英国广播公司(BBC)调查后，包括国家保护儿童权利委员会和国家人权委员会在内的多个印度机构表示，他们正在调查此事。 在印度传播 CSAM 属于刑事犯罪，而 Meta 的政策规定，广告不得包含性剥削或危害儿童的内容。 当BBC就其调查联系Meta时，它表示，当发现明显的儿童剥削行为时，它会根据其法律义务向位于美国的国家失踪和受虐儿童中心（NCMEC）报告。 NCMEC 是针对儿童在线性剥削的集中式全球报告系统。 但“儿童正义权利”（Just Rights for Children）的创始人布万·里布（Bhuwan Ribhu）表示，这还不够。该组织由 250 多个致力于防止印度儿童遭受暴力的组织组成。 儿童正义组织已向印度最高法院提交请愿书，援引英国广播公司的调查结果，并要求社交媒体平台强制报告和识别那些宣扬儿童性虐待内容的人 里布说：“社交媒体公司没有按照儿童保护法的规定向印度执法机构报告儿童性虐待内容，这显然是对印度法律的蔑视。” TTP，一个...

reflection.en: It is deeply disturbing that paid advertisements promoting child sexual abuse material continue to appear, even after official orders to cease. This situation cries out for advocacy for the most vulnerable. We are called to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring their protection and dignity.
reflection.zh: 令人深感不安的是，宣传儿童性虐待内容的付费广告仍在出现，即使在收到官方的停止令之后。这种情况呼唤着为最脆弱的群体发声。我们被呼召为那些不能为自己发声的人说话，确保他们的保护和尊严。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Hegseth is shaking up the Pentagon as the US wages war - but at what cost?
title.zh: Hegseth 正在撼动五角大楼，美国正在打仗——但代价是什么？

summary.en: The upheaval in the military could shape the legacy of Trump's second term, writes the BBC's Tom Bateman.
summary.zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）的汤姆·贝特曼（Tom Bateman）写道，军方动荡可能会塑造特朗普第二个任期的遗产。

body.en:
First is President Donald Trump's attempt to prise the Strait of Hormuz from Iran's grip; the latest phase of his stalemated war in the Gulf which is drawing in US forces and equipment from around the globe.

The second is a culture war at home in which Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth is conducting a promised shake-up at the Pentagon, sparking bitter recriminations and a string of departures including the top civilian in charge of the US Army last week.

The upheaval has triggered questions that could shape the legacy of Trump's second term. Is the US military being stretched to a point that could risk global security? And are these shifts leaving America's extraordinary global network of alliances vulnerable?

One of its most senior political leaders, Dan Driscoll, stepped down as US Secretary of the Army .

Driscoll is not exactly a household name in America, let alone outside it. But his departure mattered. It was the latest twist in a power struggle within the fortress-like walls of the Pentagon over the future of the world's most formidable fighting force.

Driscoll had clashed repeatedly with Hegseth over the nature and speed of military reform. His departure was the latest in a long line of top leaders removed or sidelined by Hegseth.

The level of concern became clear as one Republican Senator Thom Tillis - a frequent Trump critic - called for Hegseth to be fired. "I have never witnessed more inept management of the brave men and women who serve our country," he said.

"This is not good news. You know, for our nation, for the army," H.R. McMaster, who served as Trump's National Security Adviser during his first term, told CBS when asked about Driscoll's departure. "Secretary Driscoll was pushing… a modernisation agenda to catch the army up."

The backstory of Driscoll's resignation cut deep into issues about the readiness of the US Army. Driscoll wanted urgent modernisation by adding drones throughout ordinary army formations to make it adept for 21st Century warfare.

He said the Ukraine war had shown how the battlefield had changed, with cheap drones and anti-missile systems challenging the US military with its vast bureaucracy and expensive procurement processes.

Hegseth had in fact initiated much of this modernisation plan but subsequently came into conflict with Driscoll, according to reports, as well as with others advocating its rapid expansion.

A source familiar with last week's departure said Driscoll had raised concerns within the administration about army readiness and transformation, which Driscoll said Hegseth was "blocking" specifically by firing the generals responsible.

Jon Duffy, a retired Navy captain and former White House defence policy official, said Driscoll's resignation showed how far Hegseth had "hollowed out" the...
body.zh: 首先是唐纳德·特朗普总统试图将霍尔木兹海峡从伊朗手中夺走；他在海湾地区陷入僵局的战争进入了最新阶段，美国正在从全球各地调动军队和装备。 第二个是国内的文化战争，国防部长皮特·赫格斯正在五角大楼进行承诺的改组，引发了激烈的相互指责和一系列离职，其中包括上周负责美国陆军的高级文职人员。 这场剧变引发了可能影响特朗普第二任期遗产的问题。美国军事力量是否已经紧张到可能危及全球安全的程度？这些转变是否会让美国非凡的全球联盟网络变得脆弱？ 其最高级政治领导人之一丹·德里斯科尔辞去了美国陆军部长职务。 德里斯科尔在美国并不是一个家喻户晓的名字，更不用说在国外了。但他的离开很重要。这是五角大楼堡垒般的围墙内围绕世界上最强大的战斗力量的未来展开的权力斗争的最新转折。 德里斯科尔与赫格斯在军事改革的性质和速度问题上多次发生冲突。他的离职是赫格赛斯罢免或排挤一长串高层领导人中最新的一个。 当共和党参议员汤姆·蒂利斯（Thom Tillis）——一位经常批评特朗普的人——呼吁解雇赫格塞斯时，人们的担忧程度就变得清晰起来。他说：“我从未见过对为我们国家服务的勇敢男女的管理如此无能。” “这不是好消息。你知道，对于我们的国家，对于军队，”在第一任期内担任特朗普国家安全顾问的 H.R. 麦克马斯特在被问及德里斯科尔离职一事时告诉哥伦比亚广播公司。 “德里斯科尔部长正在推动……现代化议程，以赶上军队。” 德里斯科尔辞职的背景故事深入探讨了有关美国陆军战备状态的问题。德里斯科尔希望通过在普通军队编队中增加无人机来进行紧急现代化，使其能够适应 21 世纪的战争。 他说，乌克兰战争已经表明战场发生了怎样的变化，廉价的无人机和反导弹系统对美国军方庞大的官僚机构和昂贵的采购流程构成了挑战。 据报道，赫格斯实际上发起了这一现代化计划的大部分内容，但随后与德里斯科尔以及其他主张迅速扩张的人发生了冲突。 一位熟悉上周离职的消息人士称，德里斯科尔在政府内部提出了对军队准备和转型的担忧，德里斯科尔表示，赫格塞斯通过解雇负责的将军来“阻止”这一行动。 退役海军上尉、前白宫国防政策官员乔恩·达菲 (Jon Duffy) 表示，德里斯科尔的辞职表明赫格塞斯已经“掏空”了...

reflection.en: The news describes a 'culture war' within the Pentagon and a 'stalemated war' with Iran, suggesting conflicts that extend beyond the visible. Ephesians 6:12 reminds us that our struggles are not merely against human opponents but against deeper, unseen forces. This perspective can help us approach even deeply divisive issues with a call for wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 这篇报道描述了五角大楼内部的“文化战争”以及与伊朗的“僵持战争”，暗示着超越可见范围的冲突。以弗所书6:12提醒我们，我们的争战不仅是与属血气的争战，更是与天空属灵气的恶魔争战。这种视角可以帮助我们以寻求智慧和分辨力来应对，即使是那些极具争议的问题，并认识到其中存在的属灵层面。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: 'Constantly on my mind' - 9/11 agony goes on for bereaved, 25 years on
title.zh: “时刻萦绕心头”——遇难者家属的9/11之痛仍在继续，25年后仍未平息

summary.en: As the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks approaches, families of the victims continue to grapple with their grief and the protracted wait for the trial of the alleged mastermind, fearing that justice may be delayed indefinitely.
summary.zh: 随着“9·11”袭击25周年纪念日的临近，遇难者家属仍在承受悲痛，并焦急地等待袭击的所谓主谋受审，他们担心伸张正义的时间正在流逝。

body.en:
The US government has described it as the "most egregious criminal act on American soil in modern history".

But a quarter of a century on, the trial of its alleged mastermind is yet to begin and families of those killed fear that time for justice to be delivered is running out.

Tom Resta's brother John and his wife Sylvia, who was seven months pregnant, were among the almost 3,000 people killed on 11 September 2001 when hijackers flew planes into the World Trade Center in New York City and the Pentagon in Virginia. Another crashed in a field in Pennsylvania after the passengers fought back.

The couple had been preparing their unborn baby's nursery, painting it with characters from the children's television show Blue's Clues in the days before 9/11. They had dreamed of having a baby and doted on the children of friends and family.

On the day of the attacks, the couple - both traders - were working on the 92nd floor of the north tower of the World Trade Center.

"After all this time, it still chokes me up," Resta told the BBC through tears. While 25 years have passed, he said 9/11 was "almost constantly" on his mind.

Resta has been to the US naval base of Guantanamo Bay four times to watch complex pre-trial proceedings for alleged 9/11 mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and his co-defendants - a process he describes as "laborious and tedious".

A military prison was established on the base in south-eastern Cuba during the "war on terror" that followed the 9/11 attacks, and Mohammed - often referred to as KSM - has now been held there for 20 years without ever being convicted.

Relatives of victims enter a lottery process to attend the proceedings in a high-security courtroom, where thick glass separates them and members of the press from the defendants.

The pre-trial process has been going on for so long that it has now been presided over by five different military judges.

Last month, as the 25th anniversary approached, there was a flurry of movement and something of a breakthrough, with a trial date set for Mohammed for June 2028 .

But Resta said he was bracing himself for further delays, and with so much time having passed, some of his relatives feared they would not live long enough to see the trial.

"My father will be 98 in November, and I don't think he's expecting to see it. I have a lot of family members - aunts, uncles - that would all like to see it happen. But my parents in particular, I don't think they expect to live long enough," he said.

"Hopefully all the defendants will still be alive by the time we get to trial. That's a big worry," he added.

Resta's concerns that a trial could still be further delayed were shared by relatives of other 9/11 victims.

Earlier this year, Stephan Gerhardt made his sixth trip to Guantanamo. He...
body.zh: 美国政府将其描述为“现代历史上美国领土上最令人震惊的犯罪行为”。 但四分之一个世纪过去了，对其所谓主谋的审判尚未开始，遇难者家属担心伸张正义的时间已经不多了。 2001 年 9 月 11 日，劫机者驾驶飞机撞向纽约世贸中心和弗吉尼亚五角大楼，造成近 3,000 人遇难，其中包括汤姆·雷斯塔 (Tom Resta) 的兄弟约翰 (John) 和他怀孕七个月的妻子西尔维娅 (Sylvia)。在乘客反击后，另一架飞机在宾夕法尼亚州的一个田野坠毁。 9/11 事件发生前几天，这对夫妇一直在准备他们未出生婴儿的托儿所，并用儿童电视节目《蓝色线索》中的人物来装饰。他们梦想着拥有一个孩子，并且非常宠爱朋友和家人的孩子。 袭击发生当天，这对夫妇（均为交易员）正在世贸中心北塔 92 层工作。 “过了这么久，它仍然让我感到窒息，”雷斯塔流着泪告诉英国广播公司。 25 年过去了，他说 9/11 事件“几乎一直”萦绕在他的脑海中。 雷斯塔曾四次前往美国关塔那摩湾海军基地，观看涉嫌 9/11 策划者哈立德·谢赫·穆罕默德及其同案被告的复杂预审程序，他将这一过程描述为“费力且乏味”。 9/11 袭击后的“反恐战争”期间，古巴东南部基地建立了一座军事监狱，穆罕默德（通常被称为 KSM）现已被关押在那里 20 年，从未被定罪。 受害者亲属通过抽签程序参加高度戒备的法庭诉讼，法庭上用厚厚的玻璃将他们以及媒体成员与被告隔开。 预审过程已经持续了很长时间，目前已经由五名不同的军事法官主持。 上个月，随着 25 周年纪念日的临近，出现了一系列的行动和突破，穆罕默德的审判日期定为 2028 年 6 月。 但雷斯塔表示，他正在为进一步的拖延做好准备，而且时间已经过去了很长时间，他的一些亲戚担心他们活不了多久来观看审判。 “我的父亲将在 11 月迎来 98 岁生日，我认为他不会期望看到这一天。我有很多家庭成员——阿姨、叔叔——都希望看到这一切发生。但特别是我的父母，我认为他们不会活得足够长，”他说。 “希望在我们接受审判时所有被告都还活着。这是一个很大的担忧，”他补充道。 其他 9/11 受害者的亲属也和雷斯塔一样担心审判可能会进一步推迟。 今年早些时候，斯蒂芬·格哈特第六次前往关塔那摩。他...

reflection.en: For the families of those lost on 9/11, the pain remains a constant companion, a testament to the deep wounds left by terrorism. The prolonged wait for justice underscores the difficulty of breaking cycles of violence, reminding us of the call to overcome evil not with more evil, but with enduring good.
reflection.zh: 对于在“9·11”事件中失去亲人的人们来说，伤痛依然如影随形，这是恐怖主义造成的深刻创伤的证明。漫长的司法等待过程凸显了打破暴力循环的艰难，提醒我们被呼召要以持久的善来胜过邪恶，而非以恶报恶。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Saudi oil sites hit as Houthi attacks intensify amid US-Iran fighting
title.zh: 沙特石油设施遭袭，胡塞武装袭击加剧，美伊冲突升级

summary.en: Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, injuring over 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze. Simultaneously, explosions were reported at Iran's major oil hub and in the Gulf of Oman, suggesting a potential resumption of US strikes.
summary.zh: 也门受伊朗支持的胡塞武装周二袭击了沙特阿拉伯南部四个城市，造成70多人受伤，并点燃了石油设施。与此同时，据伊朗媒体报道，伊朗主要石油枢纽哈尔格岛以及阿曼湾的杰斯克港也发生爆炸，表明美国可能在美国与伊朗的冲突暂停两天后恢复了打击行动。

body.en:
Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, a US ally, on Tuesday, injuring more than 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze in what appeared to be a significant escalation of the six-month-old conflict in the Middle East.

At the same time, explosions were reported on Kharg Island, Iran's major oil hub, and in the Gulf of Oman port of Jask, according to Iranian media, suggesting that US strikes against Iran may have resumed following a two-day pause.

Iranian news agency Tasnim reported that a US missile hit an Iranian tanker approximately 6 kilometres from Kharg Island. The vessel’s crew was reportedly being evacuated, although no casualties were reported, citing local sources.

The Pentagon did not immediately comment on the reports. However, a Fox News reporter, citing unidentified senior US officials, said the strikes were carried out by the US military.

In Saudi Arabia, the Houthis, who control most of Yemen's populated areas including the capital, said they had launched a broad operation deep into Saudi territory.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They used drones and missiles to strike a Saudi airbase in the southern city of Khamis Mushait as well as Saudi state oil company assets in the cities of Abha, Najran and Jazan.

NASA satellite images showed a thick cloud of black smoke over the Jazan refinery and a column of white smoke rising from an oil distribution centre in Abha.

Saudi authorities described blazes at the sites and said women and children were among the 73 people hurt.

The reports of such large numbers of wounded suggested the attacks were among the biggest carried out against Saudi Arabia since the US and Israel launched their war against Iran in February.

No confirmed images from the ground of the attacked Saudi cities were available, and witnesses could not be reached in a country where media is tightly controlled.

After a month of calm in August, fighting in the Gulf has resumed, with Iran and the US exchanging fire, sending global oil prices back towards the US$100 ($138.5) a barrel level passed at the war's peak.

Prices for benchmark Brent crude and US West Texas Intermediate rose and were on track for their highest closes since 23 July.

Houthi attacks on southwestern Saudi Arabia have the potential to worsen the war's global economic impact by disrupting Middle East energy supplies beyond the blockaded Strait of Hormuz.

Saudi Arabia has led an Arab coalition battling against the Houthis in Yemen for more than a decade. That war had calmed in recent years, but a ceasefire there has broken down, with the Houthis threatening shipping at the mouth of the Red Sea.

body.zh: 周二，伊朗支持的也门胡塞叛军袭击了美国盟友沙特阿拉伯南部的四个城市，造成 70 多人受伤，并点燃了石油设施，这似乎是中东六个月冲突的重大升级。 与此同时，据伊朗媒体报道，伊朗主要石油枢纽哈格岛和阿曼湾贾斯克港发生爆炸，这表明美国对伊朗的打击可能在暂停两天后恢复。 伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社报道称，一枚美国导弹击中了距离哈格岛约6公里处的一艘伊朗油轮。据当地消息人士称，该船的船员正在撤离，但没有人员伤亡的报道。 五角大楼没有立即对这些报道发表评论。不过，福克斯新闻记者援引未透露姓名的美国高级官员的话称，此次袭击是由美军实施的。 在沙特阿拉伯，控制着也门大部分人口稠密地区（包括首都）的胡塞武装表示，他们已深入沙特领土开展广泛行动。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们使用无人机和导弹袭击了南部城市海米斯穆谢特的沙特空军基地以及沙特国家石油公司在艾卜哈、纳季兰和吉赞等城市的资产。 美国宇航局卫星图像显示，吉赞炼油厂上空冒出浓浓的黑烟，艾卜哈的石油配送中心冒出一柱白烟。 沙特当局描述了现场起火情况，并表示 73 名受伤者中有妇女和儿童。 有关如此大量伤员的报道表明，这是自美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动战争以来针对沙特阿拉伯发动的最大规模的袭击之一。 目前还没有来自受袭击的沙特城市地面的确认图像，在媒体受到严格控制的国家也无法联系到目击者。 经过 8 月份一个月的平静之后，海湾地区的战斗重新开始，伊朗和美国交火，导致全球油价回到战争高峰时每桶 100 美元（138.5 美元）的水平。 基准布伦特原油 LCOc1 和美国西德克萨斯中质原油 CLc1 价格上涨，并有望创下 7 月 23 日以来的最高收盘价。 胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯西南部的袭击可能会扰乱被封锁的霍尔木兹海峡以外的中东能源供应，从而加剧战争对全球经济的影响。 十多年来，沙特阿拉伯领导阿拉伯联盟与也门胡塞武装作战。近年来，这场战争已经平静下来，但那里的停火已经破裂，胡塞武装威胁在......

reflection.en: The news from the Middle East paints a grim picture of escalating conflict, with attacks on oil facilities and potential retaliatory strikes. This cycle of violence, where each action seems to provoke a harsher response, traps communities in a spiral of destruction. The ancient wisdom reminds us that true strength lies not in mirroring aggression, but in...
reflection.zh: 中东的新闻描绘了一幅冲突升级的严峻图景，石油设施遭到袭击，可能还会有报复性打击。这种暴力循环，每一次行动似乎都在引发更严厉的回应，将社区困在毁灭的漩涡中。古老的智慧提醒我们，真正的力量不在于以暴制暴，而在于积极选择和平的道路，拒绝被邪恶压倒。

title.en: 'Absolute nightmare': Mass flight cancellations in the UK prompt calls for dismissals
title.zh: “简直是噩梦”：英国大规模航班取消引发解雇呼声

summary.en: Nearly 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled overnight due to a 'system issue'.
summary.zh: 由于“系统问题”，英国机场往返的近1100个航班在夜间被取消。

body.en:
Consumer chaos has descended on the UK's busiest airports as an air traffic glitch causes major disruptions, prompting calls to fire the head of the air traffic control service.

Almost 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled Tuesday, due to what the country's air traffic control service called a technical issue, in this latest error.

A total of 1,055 flights to and from British airports had been axed by 8pm (5am AEST) according to the aircraft tracking website FlightRadar24.

"Recovery from today's system issue has taken longer than we had hoped," Britain's air traffic control service, known as NATS, said on social media.

"Our system issue is now resolved, we are operating normally and working as hard as possible to clear the backlog of flights," it noted, adding "this is hugely frustrating and apologise unreservedly".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Tuesday's issues follow a technical glitch in July last year that saw scores of flights to and from the UK cancelled and which prompted anger from airline chiefs.

Britain saw its worst air systems failure in years in 2023, with more than 700,000 passengers affected after hundreds of flights were delayed or cancelled.

Heathrow Airport, Britain's largest and busiest airport, in west London, confirmed it was among those affected on Tuesday, along with Gatwick to the south of the UK capital.

"It's just an absolute nightmare down there," healthcare worker Josie Donoghue said of Gatwick after leaving the airport, having had to disembark her flight to Ireland after three hours stuck on the runway.

"Getting through that airport was like trying to get out of Alcatraz," she told Britain's domestic Press Association news agency.

Liverpool, Birmingham and Edinburgh airports were also affected, while Dublin Airport in Ireland said it had cancelled dozens of flights.

British Airways said it had to cancel or divert more than 100 flights, affecting tens of thousands of its customers.

Irish no-frills carrier Ryanair said more than 65,000 passengers had been disrupted and it had cancelled more than 50 flights.

Arsenal, due to play Napoli in the Champions League on Wednesday in the southern Italian city, were forced to cancel a press conference ahead of the match after the team's flight was delayed.

UK transport secretary Heidi Alexander said on X she was "seeking assurances that lessons will be learned and systems that support aviation are up to the job".

But Ryanair COO Neal McMahon repeated his calls for NATS chief executive Martin Rolfe to be fired, accusing him of having again "failed UK travellers".

body.zh: 由于空中交通故障造成重大干扰，英国最繁忙的机场出现了消费者混乱，促使人们呼吁解雇空中交通管制服务负责人。 周二，近 1,100 架往返英国机场的航班被取消，原因是该国空中交通管制部门在最新的错误中称其为技术问题。 根据飞机跟踪网站 FlightRadar24 的数据，截至晚上 8 点（澳大利亚东部标准时间上午 5 点），共有 1,055 架往返英国机场的航班被取消。 英国空中交通管制服务机构 NATS 在社交媒体上表示：“从今天的系统问题中恢复所需的时间比我们预期的要长。” 声明指出：“我们的系统问题现已解决，我们正在正常运营，并正在尽最大努力清理积压的航班。”并补充道，“这令人非常沮丧，我们深表歉意”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 周二的问题是在去年 7 月的一次技术故障之后发生的，该故障导致大量往返英国的航班被取消，并引发了航空公司负责人的愤怒。 2023 年，英国遭遇了多年来最严重的航空系统故障，数百个航班延误或取消，超过 70 万名乘客受到影响。 位于伦敦西部的英国最大、最繁忙的机场希思罗机场周二证实，该机场以及英国首都南部的盖特威克机场均受到影响。 “那里绝对是一场噩梦，”医护人员乔西·多诺霍(Josie Donoghue)离开机场后谈到盖特威克机场时说，她在跑道上滞留三个小时后不得不下机前往爱尔兰。 “通过那个机场就像试图逃离恶魔岛一样，”她告诉英国国内新闻协会通讯社。 利物浦、伯明翰和爱丁堡机场也受到影响，爱尔兰都柏林机场表示已取消了数十个航班。 英国航空公司表示，不得不取消或改道 100 多个航班，影响了数万名乘客。 爱尔兰廉价航空公司瑞安航空 (Ryanair) 表示，超过 65,000 名乘客受到影响，并取消了 50 多个航班。 阿森纳定于周三在意大利南部城市对阵那不勒斯的欧冠比赛中，由于球队的航班延误，他们被迫取消了赛前的新闻发布会。 英国交通大臣海蒂·亚历山大 (Heidi Alexander) 于 X 日表示，她“正在寻求保证，确保汲取教训，支持航空的系统能够胜任这项工作”。 但瑞安航空首席运营官尼尔·麦克马洪 (Neal McMahon) 再次呼吁解雇 NATS 首席执行官马丁·罗尔夫 (Martin Rolfe)，指责他再次“让英国旅客失望”。 “够了，英国政府是时候进行干预了……并安排某人……

body.en:
Israel ‌will close the British consulate in East Jerusalem after the United Kingdom, France and Canada announced plans to ban imports from Israeli settlements in the West Bank — something Australia has ruled out.

Israeli foreign minister Gideon Sa'ar said the UK will no longer participate in a US-led coordination mission ‌for Gaza while some British officials and nationals — including former Labour Party leader Jeremy Corbyn — would be banned from entering the country.

"The British move is morally distorted, and constitutes blatant interference in the affairs of a sovereign ‌state and its electoral process," he said.

Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong has ruled out Australian support for a similar blanket ban, saying it may have unintended consequences, but has flagged a raft of new sanctions against Israel is in the works.

Sa'ar said Israel's response had been coordinated with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

The multilateral trade action is the latest to target Israel's settlement policy and underscores the country's growing diplomatic isolation among some of its traditional allies.

The UK, Canada, and France were joined by 10 other foreign ministers from countries including Denmark, Norway, Poland, Spain and Sweden in a statement reaffirming ‌support for a negotiated two-state settlement — ‌a Palestinian state co-existing peacefully alongside Israel.

International concern is mounting over the recent rise in settlement expansion and violence in the Israeli-occupied West Bank , territory traditionally inhabited by Arab communities.

"Together, we are resolute: the two-state solution must be protected, and we will take action in pursuit of a just and lasting peace," the statement read.

Wong has warned that Netanyahu is at risk of "extinguishing the possibility" of a two-state solution as her government plans its own sanctions package.

"I can announce Australia is pursuing further targeted measures in coordination with international partners to deter illegal settlements and settler violence," Wong said during a speech in the Senate on Tuesday.

"Australia is not, at this time, pursuing a blanket-style import ban. We have concerns about the implementation of a blanket ban and unintended consequences for Australian businesses, for Palestinians and for Israelis, and we will continue to work with partners to protect the prospects of a two-state solution."

She noted that Australia "continues to call on Israel to take urgent steps to address the situation on the ground", which includes stopping settlers "destroying properties, displacing...

title.en: German economy frets about Saxony-Anhalt election results
title.zh: 德国经济因萨克森-安哈尔特州选举结果而担忧

summary.en: The AfD won the election in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt by a wide margin. While politicians and analysts debate the reasons for the far-right party's popularity, economists are sounding the alarm about the potential implications of this significant political shift.
summary.zh: 在德国东部萨克森-安哈尔特州的选举中，德国选择党（AfD）以较大优势获胜。尽管政治家和分析人士仍在辩论该极右翼政党受欢迎的原因，但经济学家们已对这一重大政治转变的潜在影响敲响了警钟。

body.en:
The AfD won the election in the eastern German state by a wide margin. While politicians and election analysts are still debating the reasons for the far-right party's popularity, economists are sounding the alarm.

The results came in as predicted: The AfD, which is considered far-right extremist in parts, won the election in Saxony-Anhalt and could now put forward the state’s minister-president and take over the  state government . 

What hardly anyone expected, however, was this: The governing CDU is now barely half as strong as it was, while the other parties have been left far behind. Calling it a landslide victory for the AfD is no exaggeration. And many commentators go so far as to call it a turning point in Germany’s postwar history.

"A state government led by the AfD would certainly be seen by many as a turning point and would further fuel the debate over how best to deal with the party," Commerzbank economist Ralph Solveen told Reuters.

At the same time, he advises waiting to see what happens, saying that things are rarely as bad as they seem.

"Many of these decisions are unlikely to affect the economy until the medium to long term," he said. "Decisions on most taxes, the structure of the labor market and social security systems are made at the federal level. That is why the AfD, in many of its pledges, only promises to advocate for something in the Bundesrat, which is unlikely to succeed given the foreseeable isolation of an AfD-led government."

Many business community concerns had already been raised before the election. It also became clear that there are differing views within the AfD, which could lead to unpredictable policies.

For example, DW reported two months ago that Hannes Loth, a member of the AfD and the mayor in Raguhn-Jessnitz, Saxony-Anhalt, sought to have six new wind turbines installed. This pledge puts him at odds with the official stance of his own party.

Whether this is a sign of internal party pluralism or simply local political pragmatism will become clear during the coming legislative term, especially if the AfD ends up in the state government. It is not, however, serving to reassure business leaders.

One issue the AfD campaigned on was a promise to limit the number of foreigners. But will the party actually be able to implement its goal? On this point, Michael Berlemann, director of the Hamburg Institute of International Economics (HWWI), remains skeptical.

"A large part of the measures it has promised cannot be implemented at the state level because the federal government is responsible for them," he said. "Another part would be illegal and would be overturned by the courts after some delay: The AfD cannot...
body.zh: 德国选择党以大幅优势赢得了德国东部各州的选举。尽管政治家和选举分析人士仍在争论极右翼政党受欢迎的原因，但经济学家已经敲响了警钟。 结果正如预期的那样：被部分视为极右极端主义的德国选择党赢得了萨克森-安哈特州的选举，现在可以推举该州部长兼总统并接管州政府。 然而，几乎没有人预料到的是：执政的基民盟现在的实力只有原来的一半，而其他政党则被远远抛在了后面。称其为德国选择党的压倒性胜利并不夸张。许多评论家甚至称其为德国战后历史的转折点。 德国商业银行经济学家拉尔夫·索尔文对路透社表示：“由德国选择党领导的州政府肯定会被许多人视为一个转折点，并将进一步加剧有关如何最好地与该党打交道的争论。” 与此同时，他建议静观其变，并表示事情很少像看上去那么糟糕。 “其中许多决定在中长期之前不太可能影响经济，”他说。 “大多数税收、劳动力市场结构和社会保障体系的决定都是在联邦层面做出的。这就是为什么选择党在其许多承诺中只承诺在联邦参议院倡导某些东西，鉴于选择党领导的政府可预见的孤立，这一点不太可能成功。” 许多商界的担忧在选举前就已经提出。很明显，德国选择党内部存在不同观点，这可能导致政策不可预测。 例如，德国之声两个月前报道称，德国选择党成员兼萨克森-安哈尔特州拉古恩-杰斯尼茨市市长汉内斯·洛斯(Hannes Loth)寻求安装六台新风力涡轮机。这一承诺使他与本党的官方立场不一致。 这究竟是党内多元化的标志，还是仅仅是地方政治实用主义的标志，将在即将到来的立法任期内变得清晰，特别是如果选择党最终入主州政府的话。然而，这并不能让企业领导人放心。 德国选择党竞选的议题之一是承诺限制外国人数量。但该党真的能够实现其目标吗？对于这一点，汉堡国际经济研究所 (HWWI) 所长迈克尔·伯勒曼 (Michael Berlemann) 仍持怀疑态度。 他说：“它所承诺的大部分措施无法在州一级实施，因为联邦政府要对它们负责。” “另一部分将是非法的，并会在拖延一段时间后被法院推翻：选择党不能……

Such dramatic political upheavals can create uncertainty and anxiety, particularly for economic stability.
