title.en: Fifty years after Mao’s death, China has transformed. DW looks at why his political legacy still matters.
title.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年，中国已发生巨变。德国之声探讨其政治遗产为何仍具影响。

summary.en: Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.
summary.zh: 毛泽东或许是20世纪中国最具影响力，也无疑是最具争议的人物。在他去世五十年后，他那个时代的遗产至今仍在影响着中国。

body.en:
Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his...
body.zh: 毛泽东也许是 20 世纪中国最有影响力、当然也是最具争议性的人物之一。即使在他去世五年后，他那个时代的遗产仍然影响着今天的中国。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强...

reflection.en: Mao Zedong's legacy is a complex tapestry, woven with threads of national independence and profound social trauma. Even fifty years after his death, the echoes of his campaigns and persecutions continue to shape China. This reminds us of the enduring challenge to overcome past evils, not by mirroring them, but by choosing the path of good, as scripture...
reflection.zh: 毛泽东的遗产是一幅错综复杂的挂毯，交织着民族独立与深重社会创伤的丝线。在他去世五十年后，他历次运动和迫害的余波至今仍在塑造着中国。这提醒我们，要克服过去的罪恶，其挑战依然存在，我们不能以恶报恶，而要选择行善的道路，正如经文所敦促的。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Ratko Mladic’s funeral casts shadow over Bosnia and Herzegovina vote
title.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的葬礼给波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的投票蒙上阴影

summary.en: The funeral of Ratko Mladic in Belgrade, attended by Serbian and Bosnian Serb leaders, has intensified regional tensions and could potentially influence the upcoming election in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Belgrade has stated it did not organize a state funeral for Mladic, who was convicted of genocide and crimes against...
summary.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德的葬礼，塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚塞族领导人出席，加剧了地区紧张局势，并可能影响波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那即将举行的选举。贝尔格莱德方面表示，并未为被判犯有种族灭绝罪和反人类罪的姆拉迪奇举行国葬，但他的遗体由司法部长陪同，并在国家控制的场所举行了带有军事荣誉的仪式，高级政治领导人出席，但没有明确谴责对死者...

body.en:
Ratko Mladic’s funeral in Belgrade, attended by Serbian and Bosnian Serb leaders, has deepened regional tensions and could affect the upcoming election in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Belgrade has made a point of insisting that it did not organize a state funeral for former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladic , who was convicted of genocide in Srebrenica and crimes against humanity in 2017.

But when the body of a war criminal is flown home accompanied by the country's justice minister, when ceremonies unfold with military honors in state-controlled venues in the presence of senior political leaders and when clear condemnation of glorification of the deceased is absent, the message is unambiguous.

In Bosnia and Herzegovina — the state created by the 1995 Dayton Peace Agreement, which comprises two entities linked by a weak central government — reactions were as deeply divided as the country itself.

Republika Srpska, the Serb-majority entity covering about 49% of the country's territory, sent its officials to the funeral .

Public discourse there was dominated by narratives of "defending the people" and "the injustice of international courts."

"Without Ratko Mladic , there would be no Republika Srpska," was the refrain among thousands of mourners at the funeral in Belgrade .

Sarajevo , the seat of the central government of Bosnia and Herzegovina, sees this approach as a continued policy of relativizing war crimes and a threat to stability.

In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the entity where Bosniaks and Croats form the majority, the response was very different and the tone sharp.

Foreign Minister Elmedin Konakovic described Serbia's official response as a conscious choice by Belgrade, not something imposed on it.

He announced measures to cool diplomatic ties with Serbia , withdrawing almost all staff from the country's embassy in Belgrade, leaving only the ambassador, explaining that he lacks the authority to close the embassy but can reduce its presence to a minimum. The move effectively froze day-to-day diplomatic communication on the ground.

"We will pull out everyone we can; consular services will be relocated to Zagreb and Podgorica," he said.

Denis Becirovic, chair of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina, called the funeral with military honors an "anti-civilizational act" and warned of far-reaching consequences for the entire region.

For representatives of Mladic's victims, any public glorification of the former general is a direct insult to the families of those killed.

At a time when both Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina are facing general elections — Bosnia on October 4 and Serbia likely just a few weeks later — emotions become a resource.

In both countries, parts of the electorate still see Mladic as a symbol of...
body.zh: 塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚塞族领导人出席了拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德举行的葬礼，这加剧了地区紧张局势，并可能影响波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那即将举行的选举。 贝尔格莱德坚称没有为前波斯尼亚塞族军队指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇举办国葬，他于2017年在斯雷布雷尼察被判犯有种族灭绝罪和危害人类罪。 但当战犯的尸体在该国司法部长的陪同下空运回国时，当在国家控制的场所在高级政治领导人在场的情况下以军事荣誉举行仪式时，当没有明确谴责美化死者时，所传达的信息是明确的。 在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那——根据 1995 年《代顿和平协议》创建的国家，由两个由薄弱的中央政府联系在一起的实体组成——人们的反应和该国本身一样存在严重分歧。 塞族共和国是一个塞族占多数的实体，覆盖该国约 49% 的领土，派出官员参加了葬礼。 那里的公共话语主要是“保卫人民”和“国际法庭的不公正”的叙述。 “没有拉特科·姆拉迪奇，就不会有塞族共和国”，这是贝尔格莱德葬礼上数千名哀悼者的口号。 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那中央政府所在地萨拉热窝认为，这一做法是一项持续的政策，使战争罪行相对化，并对稳定构成威胁。 在波斯尼亚人和克罗地亚人占多数的波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦，人们的反应截然不同，语气也很尖锐。 外交部长埃尔梅丁·科纳科维奇表示，塞尔维亚的官方回应是贝尔格莱德有意识的选择，而不是强加的。 他宣布采取措施冷却与塞尔维亚的外交关系，从该国驻贝尔格莱德大使馆撤回几乎所有工作人员，只留下大使，并解释说他无权关闭大使馆，但可以将大使馆的存在减少到最低限度。此举实际上冻结了当地的日常外交沟通。 他说：“我们将撤出我们能撤出的所有人；领事服务将转移到萨格勒布和波德戈里察。” 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那主席团主席丹尼斯·贝西罗维奇称，以军事荣誉举行的葬礼是“反文明行为”，并警告称这会给整个地区带来深远的后果。 对于姆拉迪奇受害者的代表来说，任何对这位前将军的公开颂扬都是对遇难者家属的直接侮辱。 当塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那都面临大选时——波斯尼亚将于 10 月 4 日举行，塞尔维亚可能在几周后举行——情绪成为一种资源。 在这两个国家，部分选民仍然将姆拉迪奇视为......的象征。

reflection.en: The funeral of a convicted war criminal, attended by political leaders, has stirred painful memories and deepened divisions in Bosnia and Herzegovina. In times of such heightened tension, the call to pursue peace, even when faced with actions that seem to glorify past conflict, remains a vital challenge for leaders and citizens alike. May wisdom guide those...
reflection.zh: 一位被定罪的战犯的葬礼，在政治领导人的出席下，在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那激起了痛苦的回忆并加深了分裂。在如此紧张的局势下，即使面对似乎在颂扬过去冲突的行为，追求和平的呼吁仍然是对领导人和公民 alike 的一项重要挑战。愿智慧引导那些寻求搭建桥梁而非筑墙的人。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Japan's empty temples seek new ways to survive
title.zh: 日本的空寺庙寻求生存之道

summary.en: Japan's temples are facing significant challenges due to a declining population, shrinking congregations, and economic pressures, leading to the sale or closure of many historic structures. This raises questions about the future of religion in modern Japan.
summary.zh: 由于人口下降、信徒减少和经济压力，日本的寺庙正面临严峻挑战，导致许多历史悠久的寺庙被出售或关闭。这引发了关于现代日本宗教未来的疑问。

body.en:
With a declining population, shrinking congregations and growing economic pressures, temples are struggling to stay relevant. As more temples are sold or closed, is religion in decline in modern Japan?

The 370-year-old structure has all the attributes of a classically designed Japanese temple , from the curved roof to the timber-frame walls, spacious tatami-mat prayer hall and elaborately decorated altar.

Set in manicured gardens on the Chita Peninsula in central Japan , the 350-square-meter (3,767-square-foot) property is on the market for 482 million yen (€2.66 million, US3.01 million). The estate agent's pitch says the price includes dismantling by "expert heritage craftsmen" and delivery to anywhere in Japan, where it would be fully restored into a "stunning" two- or three-bedroom home.

The sale and removal of the temple marks the end of its role in the local community in the hills above the Nagasawacho district, but it is a better fate than many places of worship across Japan.

There are around 77,000 temples across the country, but as many as 17,000 no longer have a full-time resident priest as congregations have shrunk — particularly in rural districts experiencing rapid depopulation — and financial pressures have taken their toll.

That means many temples are being sold off or simply shuttered and left to deteriorate quietly. 

Tomomi Iwayama took on the abandoned Ganshu-ji temple in Odawara, a coastal town about 80 kilometers (50 miles) southwest of Tokyo, a decade ago. Today, he is the abbot of a growing congregation.

"The temple had no abbot for 70 years before I arrived because it was just so difficult to operate, and it has taken me until now to get it financially back on track," he told DW.

"Even in a relatively large urban area such as Odawara, which has around 200,000 residents, it has been very hard," he said. "In the countryside, it is much more difficult."

Iwayama's biggest problem is the country's shrinking population : fewer worshippers and falling demand for funerals and other traditional rites make it harder to finance the temple's upkeep. He has worked hard to reach out to the local community and has had success in selling plots in the temple graveyard.

One innovation that has attracted attention is the temple's "smart graveyard," where families scan a card, and a robotic system recovers a relative's ashes from the columbarium.

"Young people in villages usually leave to go to university, and then they find a job in one of the big cities, so they rarely go back," he said. "Maybe they will go back once a year to pay their respects to their ancestors at the village temple, but that is not enough for the temple to get by on."

Equally, when the head priest of a rural temple retires, his children...
body.zh: 随着人口的减少、会众的减少和经济压力的增加，寺庙正在努力保持相关性。随着越来越多的寺庙被出售或关闭，现代日本的宗教是否正在衰落？ 这座拥有 370 年历史的建筑拥有古典设计的日本寺庙的所有特征，从弧形屋顶到木结构墙壁、宽敞的榻榻米祈祷大厅和精心装饰的祭坛。 这处占地 350 平方米（3,767 平方英尺）的房产坐落在日本中部知多半岛修剪整齐的花园中，市场售价为 4.82 亿日元（266 万欧元，301 万美元）。房地产经纪人的宣传称，价格包括由“专家遗产工匠”拆除并运送到日本任何地方，在那里它将被完全修复成“令人惊叹的”两居室或三居室住宅。 这座寺庙的出售和拆除标志着它在长泽町地区山上当地社区中的作用的结束，但它的命运比日本各地的许多礼拜场所都要好。 全国大约有 77,000 座寺庙，但由于会众数量减少（特别是在人口迅速减少的农村地区）以及财政压力造成的损失，多达 17,000 座寺庙不再有全职常驻牧师。 这意味着许多寺庙正在被出售或干脆关闭，任其静静恶化。 十年前，岩山友美 (Tomomi Iwayama) 接管了位于东京西南约 80 公里（50 英里）的沿海小镇小田原废弃的甘州寺 (Ganshu-ji)。如今，他是一个不断壮大的会众的住持。 他告诉德国之声：“在我到达之前，这座寺庙已经有70年没有方丈了，因为它的运营非常困难，直到现在我才让它的财务状况回到正轨。” “即使是在像小田原这样拥有约 20 万居民的相对较大的城市地区，情况也非常困难，”他说。 “在农村，这要困难得多。” 岩山面临的最大问题是该国人口不断减少：信徒减少，葬礼和其他传统仪式的需求下降，使得寺庙的维护变得更加困难。他努力接触当地社区，并成功出售了寺庙墓地的土地。 引起关注的一项创新是寺庙的“智能墓地”，家人可以扫描卡片，机器人系统从骨灰龛中回收亲属的骨灰。 “农村的年轻人通常会离开去上大学，然后他们在大城市找到一份工作，所以他们很少回去，”他说。 “也许他们每年都会回去村里的寺庙祭拜祖先，但这不足以让寺庙维持下去。” 同样，当乡村寺庙的住持退休时，他的孩子们......

reflection.en: The news from Japan paints a stark picture of aging populations and dwindling religious communities. As temples, some centuries old, are put up for sale, it prompts reflection on what sustains a community. The psalmist reminds us that children are a heritage from Yahweh, a blessing that speaks to continuity and vitality.
reflection.zh: 日本传来的消息描绘了一幅人口老龄化和宗教社群萎缩的严峻图景。一些拥有数百年历史的寺庙被出售，这促使人们反思是什么支撑着一个社群的延续。诗人提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是生命力和传承的祝福。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: China Desk
title.zh: 中国观察

strap.en: Policy signals, social change, and national developments inside China.
strap.zh: 聚焦中国内部政策走向、社会变化与国家动态。

title.en: Fifty years after Mao’s death, China has transformed. DW looks at why his political legacy still matters.
title.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年，中国已发生巨变。德国之声探讨其政治遗产为何仍具影响。

summary.en: Mao Zedong, a highly influential and controversial figure in 20th-century China, died fifty years ago. The era he shaped continues to impact China today, leaving a complex legacy of nation-building and profound social trauma from political campaigns.
summary.zh: 毛泽东是二十世纪中国最具影响力但也最具争议的人物之一。他逝世五十年来，他所塑造的时代至今仍在影响着中国，留下了建设国家与政治运动造成的巨大社会创伤并存的复杂遗产。

body.en:
Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his...
body.zh: 毛泽东也许是 20 世纪中国最有影响力、当然也是最具争议性的人物之一。即使在他去世五年后，他那个时代的遗产仍然影响着今天的中国。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强...

reflection.en: Mao Zedong's legacy is marked by both the founding of the People's Republic and the immense suffering caused by his campaigns. This duality speaks to the enduring human challenge of grappling with historical trauma and the temptation to repeat cycles of conflict. The call to overcome evil with good remains a vital principle as nations navigate their past.
reflection.zh: 毛泽东的遗产既包括中华人民共和国的建立，也包括他政治运动造成的巨大苦难。这种矛盾性体现了人类在处理历史创伤和克服暴力循环方面所面临的持久挑战。当国家回顾过去时，“以善胜恶”的呼吁仍然是重要的原则。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: How the Nepal-Tibet disaster became the latest victim of China’s ‘Clean Internet’ campaign
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏灾难如何成为中国“净网”运动的最新牺牲品

summary.en: The online campaign, which used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking, has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives. Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing...
summary.zh: 这场网络运动曾专注于打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但现已扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。46岁的藏族流亡者丹增·普措（Tsering...

body.en: The online campaign used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking but has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing family members on both sides of the border; those in Nepal are named in official government lists, but in Tibet he has received no information. “I have started praying for the lost ones now. I have to accept they will not return [because] … I’m not getting any information.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 这场在线运动过去的重点是打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但后来扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。次仁平措在千里之外的印度南部观看了尼泊尔西藏洪水的新闻。 46岁流亡藏人在边境两侧都有家人失踪；尼泊尔的那些人被列入政府官方名单，但在西藏，他没有收到任何信息。 “我现在开始为失踪的人祈祷。我必须接受他们不会回来的事实，[因为]……我没有得到任何信息。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the wake of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, Tsering Phuntsok faces a double tragedy: the potential loss of family members and the silencing of information. His inability to confirm their fate due to China's 'Clean Internet' campaign leaves him in agonizing uncertainty. This situation calls to mind the ancient call to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难之后，丹增·普措面临着双重悲剧：可能失去家人以及信息被噤声。由于中国“净网”运动，他无法确认家人的命运，这让他陷入痛苦的不确定之中。这种情况令人想起古老的呼吁：“为那些不能说话的人辩护，为所有贫困者伸张正义”（箴言31:8-9），敦促我们为那些声音被故意压制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
title.zh: 台风“苏德罗”导致中国东南部大规模疏散

summary.en: Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to south-east China last week, causing widespread damage and forcing mass evacuations. The city of Putian recorded 416.5mm of rain in 24 hours, leading to the evacuation of almost 600,000 people in Fujian province and affecting thousands more in other provinces.
summary.zh: 上周，台风“苏德罗”给中国东南部带来了数日的倾盆大雨，造成大范围破坏并导致大规模疏散。福建省莆田市在24小时内记录到416.5毫米的降雨量，迫使福建省近60万人撤离，另有数千人受到江西等省份的影响。

body.en: Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people. Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 暴雨造成大面积破坏；南非西北部遭遇雷暴袭击，美国中南部遭遇酷热，台风“萨德尔”上周给中国东南部的浙江、江西、福建和广东省带来连日暴雨。福建省莆田市周四至周五24小时内降雨量达416.5毫米，周边村庄同期降雨量超过500毫米。在福建，当局估计近 60 万人从高风险、洪水易发地区撤离。江西53个县12.8万人受灾，紧急疏散9000人。据报道，该地区发生了洪水、山体滑坡和基础设施损坏。周三，极端降雨导致低洼地区山洪暴发，2500多名师生被困在浙江温州一所学校大院内。据报道，莆田市周四河堤崩塌，夷为平地，至少有 1,260 人需要救援。周六，江西省遂川县一个村庄发生山体滑坡，造成三人死亡，另有九人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's torrential rains and subsequent evacuations in China underscore the harsh realities of natural disasters. In times of devastation, the human spirit is tested, yet the biblical narrative offers a path through suffering. Romans 5:3-4 reminds us that hardship can produce perseverance, character, and hope, even amidst overwhelming loss.
reflection.zh: 台风“苏德罗”带来的倾盆大雨和中国随后的大规模疏散，凸显了自然灾害的严酷现实。在毁灭性的灾难面前，人类的精神受到考验，但圣经的叙事提供了一条穿越苦难的道路。罗马书5:3-4提醒我们，即使在巨大的损失中，艰难困苦也能磨炼出忍耐、品格和盼望。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: The US now has access to more than half Australia’s military bases – could it drag the country unwillingly into war?
title.zh: 美国现在可以进入澳大利亚一半以上的军事基地——这是否可能将该国不情愿地拖入战争？

summary.en: Exclusive reports reveal that US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to over 100 facilities across Australia. Some analysts liken this extensive presence to a 'colonisation' of Australia's military capabilities, with new data mapping the significant US militarisation on Australian soil.
summary.zh: 独家报道披露，美国控制的武器公司和部队在澳大利亚拥有超过100个设施的控制权或使用权。一些分析人士将这种广泛的存在比作对澳大利亚军事力量的“殖民化”，新的数据显示了澳大利亚本土美国军事化的程度。

body.en: Exclusive: US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to more than 100 facilities across the continent, which some analysts describe as a ‘colonisation’ of Australia’s military. Find a map of them here US military presence in Australia, mapped – video Why can the US access so many Australian military bases? – podcast US military interests control or have access to more than 100 defence facilities on Australian soil, in what some analysts describe as a “saturation” – even a “colonisation” – of the Australian continent. New data compiled by the Nautilus Institute and published by Guardian Australia maps the extent of US militarisation. The US military controls 17 facilities on mainland Australia and has access to 75 more Australian-run military installations. US defence corporations have access to an additional 18. Gathering intelligence, accessing satellite data for targeting information and communications intercepts. Training, including for 2,500 marines on dry-season rotation in the Northern Territory. Pre-positioning warfighting assets such as Osprey aircraft. Logistics hubs holding weapons, munitions and fuel, stored in case of a war in the Pacific. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：美国控制的武器公司和部队控制或进入了整个非洲大陆的 100 多个设施，一些分析人士将其描述为澳大利亚军队的“殖民化”。在这里找到它们的地图 美国在澳大利亚的军事存在，已绘制 - 视频 为什么美国可以进入如此多的澳大利亚军事基地？ – 播客 美国军事利益集团控制或有权使用澳大利亚领土上的 100 多个防御设施，一些分析人士将其描述为澳大利亚大陆的“饱和”，甚至是“殖民化”。鹦鹉螺研究所编制并由澳大利亚卫报发布的新数据绘制了美国军事化的程度。美国军方控制着澳大利亚大陆的 17 个设施，并有权使用另外 75 个澳大利亚管理的军事设施。美国国防公司可以使用额外的 18 个卫星数据来收集情报、访问卫星数据以进行目标信息和通信拦截。训练，包括为 2,500 名海军陆战队员在北领地进行旱季轮换训练。预先部署鱼鹰飞机等作战资产。储存武器、弹药和燃料的后勤中心，以防太平洋发生战争。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The extensive US military presence across Australia, with access to over 100 facilities, raises profound questions about national sovereignty and the potential for entanglement in distant conflicts. Isaiah's vision of nations beating swords into plowshares offers a counterpoint, a hope for a world where military might is transformed into instruments of...
reflection.zh: 美国在澳大利亚广泛的军事存在，拥有超过100个设施的使用权，引发了关于国家主权和卷入遥远冲突的潜在问题的深刻疑问。以赛亚关于列国将刀打成犁头的异象提供了一个对照，一个关于军事力量被转化为和平与生产力工具的世界的希望。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: EU faces 300,000 factory job cuts as China ‘colonises’ supply chains, industry warns
title.zh: 欧盟面临30万个工厂工作岗位流失，行业警告中国“殖民”供应链

summary.en: An industry trade body has warned that job losses in EU manufacturing will increase significantly unless Brussels addresses the "colonisation" of industry by Chinese component manufacturers. Eurometal forecasts 300,000 manufacturing job losses by the end of 2026 due to escalating competition from China, which...
summary.zh: 一家行业贸易机构警告称，除非布鲁塞尔解决中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民”问题，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将急剧增加。欧洲金属公司预测，到2026年底，由于来自中国的竞争加剧，制造业将损失30万个工作岗位，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差已达到创纪录的每日10亿欧元。

body.en: Protest using 10 coffins to symbolise struggling manufacturing industry to take place in Brussels Job losses in EU manufacturing will rapidly increase unless Brussels stops the “colonisation” of industry by Chinese component manufacturers, a leading industry trade body has warned. Eurometal predicts 300,000 job losses in manufacturing in the rest of 2026 because of expanding competition from China, which is now enjoying a record €1bn-a-day trade surplus with the bloc. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一家领先的行业贸易机构警告说，除非布鲁塞尔停止中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民化”，否则布鲁塞尔将举行用十具棺材象征陷入困境的制造业的抗议活动，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将迅速增加。欧洲金属网预计，由于来自中国的竞争不断加剧，2026 年剩余时间制造业将有 30 万个就业岗位流失，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差每天达到创纪录的 10 亿欧元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The warning of 300,000 job losses in the EU manufacturing sector due to intense competition from China raises profound questions about economic justice and fairness. The prophet Amos declared, "Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!" This call for justice echoes in the concerns of workers facing displacement and...
reflection.zh: 由于来自中国的激烈竞争，欧盟制造业可能损失30万个工作岗位的警告，引发了关于经济公正和公平的深刻问题。先知阿摩司曾宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”（阿摩司书5:24）这种对公正的呼唤，在面对失业和经济困境的工人们的担忧中得到了回响。

title.en: China prepares £40bn stimulus for financial sector amid fears over sluggish growth

summary.zh: 北京计划向其金融业注入540亿美元（400亿英镑），旨在支持银行和保险公司应对经济增长乏力的问题。这笔资金将来自国家机构，用于补充现金储备并提振股市投资。

A host of financial institutions said they were due to receive billions of yuan in capital from state institutions including the ministry of finance and even the company that runs the country’s tobacco monopoly. Continue reading...

This action raises questions about the stewardship of national resources and the pursuit of economic justice. The prophet Micah reminds us that true governance involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that...
reflection.zh: 面对经济逆风，中国正动用巨额资金来稳定其金融市场。这一举措引发了关于国家资源管理和追求经济公正的疑问。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的治理在于秉公行义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行——这些原则为经济政策提供了永恒的标准。

title.en: The world is being driven to the brink by thugs and dictators, but there is a route to a brighter future | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 世界被暴徒和独裁者推向边缘，但通往更光明未来的道路依然存在 | 西蒙·蒂斯达尔

summary.en: The world is facing unprecedented challenges including unending wars, humanitarian crises, rising authoritarianism, dysfunctional democracies, extremism, lawlessness, economic inequality, greed, irresponsibility, dangerous AI gambles, climate breakdown, and nuclear proliferation, painting an apocalyptic global...
summary.zh: 世界正面临前所未有的挑战，包括无休止的战争、人道主义危机、日益增长的威权主义、功能失调的民主、极端主义、无法无天、经济不平等、贪婪、不负责任、危险的人工智能赌博、气候崩溃和核扩散，描绘了一幅世界末日的全球前景。然而，作者认为，普通人拥有比他们意识到的更大的力量来引导走向更光明的未来。

body.en: It’s no surprise some analysts say we are already in the midst of the third world war, but ordinary people have more power than we think Don’t look up! The world is a mess. The sky could fall in any day. Unending wars, expanding humanitarian crises, rising authoritarianism, dysfunctional democracies, rampant racial and religious extremism, and unchecked lawlessness cast a dark cloud as the west’s new political year begins. Set all that against a backdrop of staggering global economic inequality, corporate and individual greed, irresponsible government indebtedness, dangerous AI gambles, climate breakdown and proliferating nuclear weapons, and a truly apocalyptic global outlook begins to take shape. It’s enough to make anyone shut their eyes, cover their ears and utter a Munch-like scream. And it’s only getting worse. Democratic leaders who promise a better, safer, more optimistic future – what Britain’s freshly arrived prime minister, Andy Burnham, calls a “ new era of possibility ” – cannot escape this wider international context. Last week’s global bond market upheaval , sparked by external factors, left Burnham’s cash-strapped government struggling with sharply increased borrowing costs before he barely got started. The fact he chose Ukraine for his first overseas trip, while symbolically important, highlighted another grim reality. As a lead opponent of Vladimir Putin’s invasion, Britain now finds itself in a de facto state of war with Russia – and facing attack. Argentina, too, is eyeing UK defence vulnerabilities . These are not the sort of possibilities Burnham envisaged. Continue reading...
body.zh: 毫不奇怪，一些分析人士说，我们已经处于第三次世界大战之中，但普通人拥有比我们想象的更多的力量，不要抬头！世界一团糟。天随时可能塌下来。无休无止的战争、不断扩大的人道主义危机、日益抬头的威权主义、功能失调的民主国家、猖獗的种族和宗教极端主义以及不受约束的违法行为，在西方新的政治一年开始之际，蒙上了一层乌云。在全球经济严重不平等、企业和个人贪婪、不负责任的政府债务、危险的人工智能赌博、气候崩溃和核武器扩散的背景下，真正的世界末日般的全球前景开始形成。这足以让任何人闭上眼睛，捂住耳朵，发出蒙克般的尖叫声。而且情况只会变得更糟。民主党领导人许诺一个更好、更安全、更乐观的未来 — — 英国新任首相安迪·伯纳姆称之为“充满可能性的新时代” — — 无法摆脱这个更广泛的国际背景。上周由外部因素引发的全球债券市场动荡，让资金短缺的伯纳姆政府在刚刚开始执政之前就陷入了借贷成本急剧上升的困境。他选择乌克兰作为他的第一次海外访问，虽然具有重要的象征意义，但也凸显了另一个严峻的现实。作为弗拉基米尔·普京入侵的主要反对者，英国现在发现自己与俄罗斯处于事实上的战争状态 — — 并面临攻击。阿根廷也正在关注英国国防的弱点。这些不是伯纳姆设想的那种可能性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The article paints a grim picture of the world, citing 'thugs and dictators' and 'rising authoritarianism' as major drivers of global instability. This echoes the ancient wisdom that wicked rulers bring ruin. Yet, the author offers a counterpoint: ordinary people hold significant power. This reminds us that even in dark times, our choices and actions...
reflection.zh: 文章描绘了一幅严峻的世界图景，将“暴徒和独裁者”以及“日益增长的威权主义”列为全球不稳定的主要驱动因素。这呼应了古老的智慧，即邪恶的统治者会带来毁灭。然而，作者提出了一个反论：普通人拥有巨大的力量。这提醒我们，即使在黑暗的时代，我们的选择和行动也很重要，我们被呼召去寻求公义并抵制压迫，并相信雅伟的公义终将得胜。

verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Can communities be protected from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 融化的冰川能保护社区免受灾害吗？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives. High mountain glaciers are retreating and becoming unstable as climate change causes them to melt, leading to events...
summary.zh: 不断上升的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以挽救生命的工具。高山冰川正在退缩并变得不稳定，因为气候变化导致它们融化，从而引发了8月26日尼泊尔和西藏的“山体海啸”等事件，威胁着数千人的生命。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些成分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

reflection.en: The news from Nepal and Tibet paints a stark picture of creation groaning under the weight of climate change. The melting glaciers and resulting 'mountain tsunamis' are not just environmental events, but signs of a world in distress, awaiting healing. As we witness these impacts, we are reminded of the deep interconnectedness of all things and the urgent...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔和西藏的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的画面，显示受气候变化影响的受造界正在呻吟。融化的冰川和由此产生的“山体海啸”不仅仅是环境事件，更是世界痛苦的迹象，等待着治愈。当我们目睹这些影响时，我们被提醒万物之间深刻的相互联系，以及对关怀和修复的迫切需要。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Blanche d'Alpuget, acclaimed writer and wife of Bob Hawke, dies at 82
title.zh: 著名作家、鲍勃·霍克遗孀布兰奇·达尔普吉去世，享年82岁

summary.en: Blanche d'Alpuget, an acclaimed Australian writer and widow of former Prime Minister Bob Hawke, has passed away at the age of 82. Her family remembered her as a vibrant individual who "lived life on her own terms," characterized by her vitality, generosity, and curiosity.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚著名作家、前总理鲍勃·霍克的遗孀布兰奇·达尔普吉（Blanche d'Alpuget）去世，享年82岁。她的家人回忆她是一位充满活力、慷慨大方、好奇心强的人，她“按照自己的意愿生活”。

body.en:
Blanche d'Alpuget, the Australian writer and widow of former prime minister Bob Hawke, has died.

In a statement, d'Alpuget's family remembered her as someone who lived "entirely on her own terms".

"She was full of vitality, generosity and curiosity, with an extraordinary appetite for beauty, ideas, history, new places and spirited conversation. She refused to be confined by convention or by other people's expectations of who she should be," they said.

"We will miss her force, her humour, her curiosity and her love beyond measure."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They shared the words d'Alpuget lived by: “Our highest calling and greatest achievement is love, the rule of life. Love one another."

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has shared his condolences, saying Australia has lost "a true one-off".

"As a writer, she was at home in fiction as she was in non-fiction, working in each realm with a keen eye for every telling detail that opened up the humanity of her subject to her readers," he said.

"Blanche’s novels were compelling works of verve and originality, and her biographies comprehensive and definitive – most famously those she wrote of Bob Hawke, who became her great love and ultimately her husband."

In her 20s, she pursued a career in journalism and travelled the world with her first husband, Tony Pratt.

She travelled and lived in Indonesia, Malaysia and Europe before returning to Australia in her 30s.

She met Hawke in Jakarta in 1970, but reconnected later in life — taking a job writing his biography, work that would later cement her as an award-winning writer.

The pair were married in 1995, and shared over two decades together before Hawke's death in 2019.

"At 80, she returned to Indonesian waters to swim with whale sharks in Raja Ampat," her family said.

title.en: The crime more Australians are committing amid cost of living pressures
title.zh: 生活成本压力下，澳大利亚人犯罪行为增多

summary.en: A study reveals that rising living costs and stagnant wages are the primary drivers behind an increase in petrol theft in Australia, more so than fluctuating fuel prices.
summary.zh: 一项研究显示，不断上涨的生活成本和停滞不前的工资是澳大利亚汽油盗窃案增加的主要原因，其影响甚至超过了波动的燃油价格。

body.en:
Cost of living pressures are driving more people to speed away without paying at the bowser than sky-high petrol prices, a study has revealed.

The NSW Bureau of Crime Statistics has released a report that found higher living costs and decreased wages had a stronger link to rates of petrol theft than fluctuating prices.

The bureau launched its investigation after a sharp increase in petrol theft following the COVID-19 pandemic despite stable fuel prices, executive director Jackie Fitzgerald told the Australian Associated Press (AAP).

"[Cost of living pressure] tends to mount up over time, and that will encourage people to commit these kinds of crimes, but they can weather a short-term fluctuation," she said.

"It's not just a criminal subclass that is involved in these matters. It's kind of bleeding into other parts of the community."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

According to the report, a 1 per cent increase in petrol price was associated with a 1 per cent increase in thefts.

By comparison, a 1 per cent spike in living costs was linked to a 6 per cent increase in thefts.

Petrol thieves are also rather likely to get away with the crime, Fitzgerald said, with police only laying charges in 4 to 8 per cent of cases.

"People are more likely to engage in crime if they think they can get away with it," she said.

"There's clearly some people … whose economic situation is sufficiently dire that they will start to consider those options."

Rates of petrol theft in NSW peaked in 2024 — even higher than when the price of fuel skyrocketed in early 2026 due to the Iran-Israel-US conflict.

Australasian Convenience and Petroleum Marketers Association chief executive officer Rowan Lee told AAP the spike in thefts had been recorded nationwide, with no single state or territory standing out.

There had also been a rise in aggression towards service station staff, the association said.

Fitzgerald said requiring motorists to pay before filling up could help prevent thefts.

"It's inconvenient for people, but ... this study suggests you could turn on those kind of strategies when the conditions are ripe for an increase in petrol theft," she said.

title.en: Australians face 'unacceptable levels of harm' as sexual violence reaches historic high
title.zh: 澳大利亚面临“不可接受的伤害”，性暴力达到历史新高

summary.en: Australia's sexual violence commissioner has warned that sexual violence is a "distinct national problem" and not merely an extension of domestic and family violence, with rates reaching their highest level in 33 years. Progress in addressing this issue is not happening at the scale or pace needed to save lives.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的性暴力问题专员警告说，性暴力是一个“独特的国家问题”，而不是家庭暴力和家庭暴力的延伸，其发生率达到了33年来的最高水平。解决这一问题的进展并未达到拯救生命所需的规模或速度。

body.en:
This article contains references to domestic and family violence and sexual assault.

Australians are continuing to experience "unacceptable levels of harm" in the areas of sexual violence and the family law and justice systems.

The nation's Domestic, Family and Sexual Violence Commissioner, Micaela Cronin, released her third annual update to parliament on Wednesday, which found that progress made by governments and communities was not yet at the scale or pace needed to save lives.

It comes amid reports of sexual violence being at their highest level since national recording began 33 years ago.

The commission identified it as one of two "persistent" areas, alongside family law and justice systems, where people are experiencing unacceptable levels of harm.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The scale of sexual violence in Australia demands sustained national investment and action, commensurate with the scale of the problem," Cronin said.

"Collectively, we must send a clear message that these behaviours are not acceptable, and that people who have experienced sexual violence will be heard, treated with dignity and respect, and supported through their justice and healing journey."

The report notes almost six in 10 sexual assaults recorded by police occurred outside family and intimate partner relationships.

This underlined a "distinct national problem, not simply an extension of domestic and family violence".

Meanwhile, the family law system was also a "site of ongoing weaponisation and harm".

The commission pointed to "intense public and political conversation around institutional responses to sexual violence" and "misogynistic content influencing young people" as bolstering its call for sustained, rather than episodic, national attention to both sexual violence and the family law system.

It acknowledged the commitment made by political leaders at national cabinet to address sexual violence as a priority.

Eight recommendations were handed down to help inform the national plan to end violence against women and children by 2032.

Addressing Parliament on Wednesday, Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek will point to actions already taken by the federal government, such as reforming family courts and social security, so women and children can rely on the systems.

"We have changed this country before. Now is the time to move together to change it again," she will say.

"We owe the women and children who have had their lives stolen by this violence more than our horror. We owe them action."

Israel ‌will close the British consulate in East Jerusalem after the United Kingdom, France and Canada announced plans to ban imports from Israeli settlements in the West Bank — something Australia has ruled out.

Israeli foreign minister Gideon Sa'ar said the UK will no longer participate in a US-led coordination mission ‌for Gaza while some British officials and nationals — including former Labour Party leader Jeremy Corbyn — would be banned from entering the country.

"The British move is morally distorted, and constitutes blatant interference in the affairs of a sovereign ‌state and its electoral process," he said.

Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong has ruled out Australian support for a similar blanket ban, saying it may have unintended consequences, but has flagged a raft of new sanctions against Israel is in the works.

Sa'ar said Israel's response had been coordinated with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

The multilateral trade action is the latest to target Israel's settlement policy and underscores the country's growing diplomatic isolation among some of its traditional allies.

The UK, Canada, and France were joined by 10 other foreign ministers from countries including Denmark, Norway, Poland, Spain and Sweden in a statement reaffirming ‌support for a negotiated two-state settlement — ‌a Palestinian state co-existing peacefully alongside Israel.

International concern is mounting over the recent rise in settlement expansion and violence in the Israeli-occupied West Bank , territory traditionally inhabited by Arab communities.

"Together, we are resolute: the two-state solution must be protected, and we will take action in pursuit of a just and lasting peace," the statement read.

Wong has warned that Netanyahu is at risk of "extinguishing the possibility" of a two-state solution as her government plans its own sanctions package.

"I can announce Australia is pursuing further targeted measures in coordination with international partners to deter illegal settlements and settler violence," Wong said during a speech in the Senate on Tuesday.

"Australia is not, at this time, pursuing a blanket-style import ban. We have concerns about the implementation of a blanket ban and unintended consequences for Australian businesses, for Palestinians and for Israelis, and we will continue to work with partners to protect the prospects of a two-state solution."

He was young, just 13 at the time, vulnerable, with autism and a cognitive disability, and like many kids his age, he was searching for acceptance.

Court documents say he was bullied at school for his 'weird and awkward behaviour'. His parents say it began with name-calling and exclusion, before it took a turn.

"The kids started calling him a Muslim and a terrorist and Osama bin Laden," his mother said.

But Carrick knew little about the religion, or the extremist groups his classmates were talking about. His father said he went online looking for answers.

Not long after, his parents say he started using extremist language to frighten the other students and protect himself.

School staff viewed him as "a sweet boy" whose behaviour was a product of his disability and special needs. His psychologist and his school staff agreed the behaviour was an attempt to get attention, shock his classmates and fit in.

Thomas was viewing material associated with the self-proclaimed Islamic State (IS) group on school computers and had sent a female student an image of a decapitated body.

He had also taken his mother’s phone to post IS group material on TikTok. To a student who knew what he had done, he threatened: "If you tell the teacher about this I will rip your organs out," a court document read.

His parents said they looked for help, seeking the guidance of his paediatrician, and engaged a psychologist and his school, but his behaviour was escalating.

They saw him as vulnerable and feared he could be exploited. They worried his search for acceptance was taking him somewhere increasingly dangerous.

"He is very vulnerable and he can be misused. His vulnerability can be exploited to the extent that it may cause irreversible harm to him and to others," his father said.

And one day, he came home talking about how to make a bomb — the tipping point for his parents, according to the court document.

“He came back home and he says, 'Okay, mama, I know how you make a bomb.’ And he was laughing. He was telling me in a very casual way because he was a child," his mother told The Feed.

Searching for a way forward, his parents tried something they hadn't before. They walked into a Melbourne police station and asked for help. A court document says his father told police he was "prepared to sacrifice my son for the safety of the Australian community".

title.en: The taboo wealth tax debate experts say Australia can no longer ignore
title.zh: 专家称澳大利亚已无法忽视的禁忌财富税辩论

summary.en: As untaxed inheritances compound inequality, experts question if a death tax or land tax is needed to save the "fair go." Australia faces a "tsunami" of retirees unable to support themselves if it doesn't address the growing issue of untaxed intergenerational wealth transfer, advocates warn. New research from the...
summary.zh: 随着未征税的遗产加剧不平等，专家们质疑是否需要征收遗产税或土地税来挽救“公平机会”。倡导者警告说，如果澳大利亚不解决日益严重的未征税代际财富转移问题，将面临“海啸”般的退休人员无法自给自足的困境。澳大利亚家庭研究所（AIFS）的新研究表明，代际财政支持正日益加剧不平等。

body.en:
Australia faces a "tsunami" of retirees unable to support themselves if it doesn't address the growing issue of untaxed intergenerational wealth transfer, advocates warn.

New research from the Australian Institute of Family Studies (AIFS) released on Wednesday shows that intergenerational financial support — flowing from older, wealthy family members to younger ones — is increasingly driving inequality.

The report found that Australians receiving inheritance grew from 4.8 per cent to 7.2 per cent between 2001 and 2018 while the proportion receiving financial gifts grew from 10.5 per cent to 15. 8 per cent over the same period.

The timing of such financial aid has a major impact, the report emphasises, with earlier assistance shaping opportunities at critical life stages. Inheritance, while typically larger, often comes after decisions around housing have been made.

"Not all families have the same capacity to provide assistance," Dr Jody Hughes, head of families and society at the AIFS said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Understanding who can access these forms of support, and who misses out, is important for understanding broader patterns of wellbeing, financial security and inequality both between and within generations."

The new data comes as comparison site Finder revealed that 30 per cent of homeowners in Australia received financial support from family to buy their homes. Home loans expert Richard Witten noted that the "bank of mum and dad has become a major player" in the property market.

Christian charitable community services network Anglicare has been campaigning on tax reform to address inequality, with its own data finding the baby boomer generation is set to pass on roughly $5.4 trillion to their families — much of it untaxed.

Kasy Chambers, executive director of Anglicare, told SBS News that Australia's unusual lack of inheritance tax and its generous superannuation concessions allows wealth to "build and build".

"We're about to see the biggest wealth transfer ever in human history," she said. "That will concentrate wealth, which doesn't really do anybody any good because it takes it out of tax systems, it puts it in the hands of a very small amount, and it makes running any kind of government services ... very, very difficult."

Chambers noted Anglicare is seeing a rise in people using its services as precarity climbs the income ladder, driving more people to food banks.

"Normal is not enough," she notes, explaining that families on median incomes are increasingly struggling to afford the basics.

In May, the government came under fire as its reforms to trusts were branded a "death tax" by the...
body.zh: 倡导者警告说，如果不解决日益严重的免税代际财富转移问题，澳大利亚将面临退休人员无法养活自己的“海啸”。 澳大利亚家庭研究所（AIFS）周三发布的新研究表明，代际经济支持——从年长、富有的家庭成员流向年轻的家庭成员——正在日益加剧不平等。 报告发现，2001年至2018年间，接受遗产的澳大利亚人从4.8%增加到7.2%，而同期接受经济礼物的比例从10.5%增加到15. 8%。 报告强调，此类经济援助的时机具有重大影响，早期援助会在人生的关键阶段塑造机会。继承权虽然通常较大，但通常是在做出有关住房的决定之后进行的。 “并非所有家庭都有同样的能力提供援助，”AIFS 家庭和社会负责人乔迪·休斯 (Jody Hughes) 博士说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “了解谁可以获得这些形式的支持，以及谁错过了，对于了解代际之间和代内更广泛的福祉、金融安全和不平等模式非常重要。” 新数据发布之际，比较网站 Finder 显示，澳大利亚 30% 的房主在购买房屋时获得了家人的经济支持。住房贷款专家理查德·维滕指出，“父母银行已成为房地产市场的主要参与者”。 基督教慈善社区服务网络 Anglicare 一直在开展税收改革运动，以解决不平等问题，其自己的数据发现，婴儿潮一代将向其家庭转移约 5.4 万亿美元，其中大部分是免税的。 Anglicare 执行董事凯西·钱伯斯 (Kasy Chambers) 告诉 SBS 新闻，澳大利亚罕见地不征收遗产税，而且其慷慨的退休金优惠使得财富能够“不断积累”。 “我们即将看到人类历史上最大的财富转移，”她说。 “这将集中财富，这实际上对任何人都没有任何好处，因为它会将财富从税收系统中剔除，将其置于极少数人手中，并且使运行任何类型的政府服务变得......非常非常困难。” 钱伯斯指出，随着收入阶梯的不稳定，Anglicare 使用其服务的人数有所增加，促使更多人前往食品银行。 “正常是不够的，”她指出，并解释说中等收入家庭越来越难以负担基本生活。 五月份，政府因信托改革被政府称为“死亡税”而受到批评。

reflection.en: The accumulation of wealth across generations, particularly when untaxed, raises profound questions about fairness and societal well-being. Proverbs 13:22 speaks of the righteous leaving an inheritance for their children's children, suggesting a positive view of generational wealth transfer when rooted in righteousness. However, this story prompts...
reflection.zh: 跨代财富的积累，尤其是在未征税的情况下，引发了关于公平和社会福祉的深刻问题。《箴言》13:22提到义人给子孙留下的产业，暗示了当财富代际传承根植于公义时，其积极的一面。然而，这个故事促使我们反思，当这种传承不受约束时，如何会加剧不平等，并挑战“人人公平”的理想。

verse.textEn: A good person leaves an inheritance for their children's children, but a sinner's wealth is stored up for the righteous.
verse.textZh: 善人给子孙遗留产业；罪人为义人积存资财。

title.en: 'We are not the AfD': Barnaby Joyce rejects German far-right question
title.zh: “我们不是德国选择党”：巴纳比·乔伊斯否认与德国极右翼有关联

summary.en: Australian MP Barnaby Joyce has stated that One Nation is not aligned with Germany's far-right party, the AfD, following the latter's significant win in a German state election. The AfD, classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence, faces isolation as other parties refuse to cooperate with them.
summary.zh: 在德国极右翼政党德国选择党（AfD）在一场州选举中取得显著胜利后，澳大利亚议员巴纳比·乔伊斯表示，他的政党“一人党”（One Nation）与德国选择党无关。德国选择党被国内情报机构归类为“极右翼极端分子”，由于其他政党拒绝与其合作，该党在组建政府方面面临困难。

body.en:
Barnaby Joyce has sought to distance One Nation from the Alternative for Germany (AfD) party after the far-right, anti-immigration group's state election win on Sunday.

At a German state election in east-central Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD surged into first place, winning 44 per cent of the vote and delivering a significant blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives, while short of an overall majority.

The AfD, which has been classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence agencies, will have a difficult time forming government as other parties have said they will refuse to cooperate.

The party is seeking to secure a foothold to advance its agenda, which includes heavy restrictions on immigration, restoring ties with ‌Russia, cutting support for Ukraine and quitting the euro.

The election win has placed a far-right party within reach of power at the state level in Germany for the first time since World War Two.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It's the latest indication of a surge in far-right populism across Europe over recent years.

Asked whether One Nation was taking anything from the German populist party's victory, Joyce said: "I'm not — We are not the AfD. That is a different party."

"I have a completely different view about the AfD than I would to ... say Giorgia Meloni in Italy, who is just a very direct and competent lady doing a good job."

The member for New England went on to list several world leaders and the Donald Trump-linked MAGA movement described as right-wing populists.

"Well, I don't see [UK's Reform leader Nigel Farage] as dangerous at all ... the MAGA movement, they're just conservatives, and they're deciding now whether Trump's in them or not ... Then [2027 French presidential hopeful Marine] Le Pen... I suppose Le Pen is slightly to the right but, you know, tolerable."

"We are very aware of what fascism does; it's a disgusting, horrendous thing, and it's got nothing to do with One Nation or anything I would be involved with."

Thousands of people across Germany have protested against the AfD since Sunday's election.

Protesters carried banners with slogans including "Fascism is not an alternative" and "Stop AfD Nazis! End racism and social cuts," while crowds chanted: "All together against fascism!"

body.zh: 在极右翼反移民组织德国另类选择党周日赢得州选举后，巴纳比·乔伊斯试图拉开一国党与德国选择党的距离。 在德国中东部萨克森-安哈尔特州举行的州选举中，选择党以 44% 的选票飙升至第一，虽然未能获得绝对多数席位，但对德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨领导的保守派造成了沉重打击。 被国内情报机构列为“极右极端分子”的德国选择党将很难组建政府，因为其他政党已表示将拒绝合作。 该党正在寻求为推进其议程奠定基础，其中包括严格限制移民、恢复与俄罗斯的关系、削减对乌克兰的支持以及退出欧元区。 这次选举的胜利使极右翼政党自第二次世界大战以来首次获得德国州一级的权力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这是近年来欧洲极右民粹主义激增的最新迹象。 当被问及一国党是否从德国民粹主义政党的胜利中获益时，乔伊斯说：“我没有——我们不是选择党。那是一个不同的政党。” “我对德国选择党的看法与意大利的乔治亚·梅洛尼 (Giorgia Meloni) 的看法完全不同，她是一位非常直接、能干、工作出色的女士。” 新英格兰的成员接着列出了几位世界领导人和被描述为右翼民粹主义者的与唐纳德·特朗普有关的 MAGA 运动：“嗯，​​我不认为（英国改革领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇）有任何危险......MAGA 运动，他们只是保守派，他们现在正在决定特朗普是否在其中......然后是[2027 年法国总统候选人海军陆战队]勒庞......我认为勒庞稍微偏右，但你知道，可以容忍。” “我们非常清楚法西斯主义的所作所为；这是一件令人厌恶、可怕的事情，它与一国党或我参与的任何事情都没有关系。” 自周日选举以来，德国各地数千人抗议德国选择党。 抗议者举着写有“法西斯主义不是替代方案”和“阻止德国选择党纳粹！结束种族主义和社会削减”等口号的横幅，而人群则高呼：“大家一起反对法西斯主义！” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of global politics, leaders often face the challenge of defining their own identity and values, especially when confronted with the rise of extremist ideologies. Barnaby Joyce's clear rejection of association with the AfD highlights the importance of maintaining distinct political stances and seeking peaceful, constructive...
reflection.zh: 在全球政治的复杂格局中，领导人常常面临界定自身身份和价值观的挑战，尤其是在面对极端主义意识形态崛起之时。巴纳比·乔伊斯明确拒绝与德国选择党（AfD）产生关联，这凸显了保持政治立场独立性，并寻求和平、建设性交往的重要性，而非与分裂性的力量为伍。

title.en: Govt to help firms set up childcare in NM: Chris Sun
title.zh: 政府将在北部都会区帮助企业设立托儿所：孙玉菡

summary.en: Labour and Welfare Secretary Chris Sun announced that the government will provide support for companies to establish childcare centers in the Northern Metropolis. This initiative is part of a broader strategy to encourage families and address the declining birth rate in Hong Kong.
summary.zh: 劳工及福利局局长孙玉菡表示，政府将支持企业在北部都会区设立托儿中心。此举是鼓励家庭并应对香港出生率下降更广泛计划的一部分。

body.en: Labour and Welfare Secretary Chris Sun says the government will support companies setting up childcare centres in the Northern Metropolis as part of a wider push to encourage families amid a falling birth rate. In an interview with RTHK's "Vision 15: Hong Kong's Chapter", Sun suggested that childcare centres in the Northern Metropolis could follow the model of the Airport Preschool, which provides childcare for airport employees. He acknowledged that childcare centres must meet certain legal standards, but said the government is ready to assist firms that want to set one up for its staff. "The Northern Metropolis is industry‑driven, and it also has a university town. People who work there will be more educated, they'll be technical staff or elites in their fields. Their childcare needs may be different," he said. "If companies with the capability are interested in running their own childcare centres, we will give them our full support." As for other districts across the city, Sun said the focus will be on providing more diverse childcare options especially for toddlers under two. He noted some parents may prefer childcare centres close to their workplaces, making it easier for them to pick up and drop off their children. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 劳工和福利部长克里斯·孙(Chris Sun)表示，政府将支持公司在北部大都市设立托儿中心，作为在出生率下降的情况下更广泛地鼓励家庭的一部分。孙在接受香港电台《愿景15：香港分会》采访时建议，北都市区的托儿中心可以效仿机场幼儿园的模式，为机场员工提供托儿服务。他承认托儿中心必须符合某些法律标准，但表示政府已准备好帮助那些希望为其员工设立托儿中心的公司。 “北方都市是工业主导型的，也有大学城。在那里工作的人受教育程度会更高，他们会成为各自领域的技术人员或精英。他们的育儿需求可能会有所不同。”他说。 “如果有能力的企业有兴趣经营自己的托儿中心，我们会全力支持。”至于全市的其他地区，孙说重点将是提供更多样化的托儿选择，特别是针对两岁以下的幼儿。他指出，一些家长可能更喜欢靠近工作场所的托儿中心，这样他们更容易接送孩子。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong grapples with a declining birth rate, the government's initiative to support businesses in creating childcare facilities highlights the value placed on families and children. The Psalmist reminds us that children are a heritage from Yahweh, a blessing to be nurtured and cherished. May this effort not only address demographic challenges but also...
reflection.zh: 随着香港应对出生率下降的挑战，政府支持企业设立托儿设施的举措凸显了对家庭和儿童的重视。诗人提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是应当被培育和珍爱的福分。 愿这项努力不仅能应对人口结构性挑战，更能营造一个让家庭感到支持、儿童得以茁壮成长的环境。

verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

His office confirmed his passing on Tuesday, stating he died surrounded by loved ones at the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital. Tung also served as a vice-chairman of the Chinese People's...

According to a statement from his office issued in the early hours on Wednesday, he died on Tuesday at the age of 89, surrounded by his loved ones. It is understood that he died at the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital. Tung was also a vice-chairman of China’s top political advisory body, the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference. In this live blog, the South China Morning...
body.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华去世，他领导香港于 1997 年回归中国。根据他的办公室周三凌晨发布的一份声明，他于周二在亲人的陪伴下去世，享年 89 岁。据了解，他于养和医院去世。董建华还曾担任中国最高政治咨询机构中国人民政治协商会议的副主席。在这个实时博客中，《南华早报》...

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that 'man is destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.' This truth calls us to reflect on the brevity of life and the importance of how we live it.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生以89岁高龄辞世的消息，提醒我们所有人都将面对生命的终点。希伯来书9章27节说道：“人人都有一死，死后且有审判。”这一真理促使我们反思生命的短暂，以及我们如何度过此生的重要性。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Marriage equality strengthens Hong Kong families and communities
title.zh: 婚姻平權強化香港家庭與社區

summary.en: Hong Kong's debate over same-sex relationships is often framed as a question of constitutional law, social values, or individual rights, but it also impacts public health. A year after the Legislative Council rejected the Registration of Same-sex Partnerships Bill, the legal uncertainty surrounding same-sex couples...
summary.zh: 香港關於同性伴侶關係的辯論常被框定為憲法、社會價值或個人權利的問題，但這也關乎公眾健康。在立法會否決《同性伴侶關係登記條例草案》一年後，同性伴侶的法律認證問題仍未解決。亨利·李（Henry Li）在丈夫去世後，不得不經歷漫長的法律訴訟，以爭取應有的保障，這凸顯了該未決問題給同性伴侶帶來的壓力。

body.en: Hong Kong’s debate over same-sex relationships is often framed as a question of constitutional law, social values, or individual rights. But it is also a question of public health. Henry Li and Edgar Ng’s wedding in 2017. Photo: Supplied. A year after the Legislative Council rejected the Registration of Same-sex Partnerships Bill, the legal recognition of same-sex couples remains unresolved – and that uncertainty places unnecessary stress on same-sex couples. It is plainly not in society’s interest to witness another heart-breaking situation like that faced by Henry Li , who was forced into lengthy legal proceedings after the death of his husband simply to secure protections that should never have been in doubt. The consequences deserve to be considered not only in legal terms, but also in terms of health, well-being, and social cohesion. Mental health has become an increasingly important policy concern in Hong Kong, particularly among younger people. Yet public discussions often focus on individual interventions while paying less attention to the structural conditions that influence health, including social inclusion, protection from discrimination and legal recognition of non-traditional family relationships. At first glance, marriage may not appear to be a public health issue. Yet public health has long recognized that health is shaped not only by healthcare services or individual choices, but also by the social conditions in which people live. Laws influence access to security, social support, and equal treatment. In other words, the law itself forms part of the environment in which one’s health is determined. This matters because the health disparities experienced by LGBTQ+ people in Hong Kong remain significant. A 2025 survey by researchers from the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the University of Hong Kong found that 30.8 per cent of LGBTQ+ respondents reported symptoms of moderate-to-severe depression, while 24 per cent reported moderate-to-severe anxiety. These figures were virtually unchanged from a comparable survey conducted seven years earlier. The persistence of these disparities suggests that greater visibility alone has not eliminated the structural and social factors associated with poorer mental health outcomes. The researchers described the findings as evidence of a long-neglected problem requiring broader societal and policy responses. Beyond symbolism One often-overlooked factor is the legal environment in which LGBTQ+ people live. The minority stress framework describes how persistent experiences of discrimination, stigma, and exclusion create chronic psychological pressures that contribute to poorer health outcomes among sexual minorities. Importantly, the problem does not arise from sexual orientation itself,...
body.zh: 香港关于同性关系的争论常常被视为宪法、社会价值观或个人权利的问题。但这也是一个公共卫生问题。 2017 年，亨利·李 (Henry Li) 和埃德加·吴 (Edgar Ng) 的婚礼。照片：提供。立法会否决《同性伴侣登记条例草案》一年后，同性伴侣的法律承认问题仍未解决——这种不确定性给同性伴侣带来了不必要的压力。目睹李亨利所面临的另一种令人心碎的情况显然不符合社会利益，他在丈夫去世后被迫进入漫长的法律诉讼程序，只是为了获得本不应该受到怀疑的保护。其后果不仅应从法律角度考虑，还应从健康、福祉和社会凝聚力角度考虑。心理健康已成为香港日益重要的政策关注点，特别是在年轻人中。然而，公众讨论往往侧重于个人干预措施，而较少关注影响健康的结构性条件，包括社会包容、免受歧视以及对非传统家庭关系的法律承认。乍一看，婚姻似乎并不是一个公共健康问题。然而，公共卫生部门早已认识到，健康不仅取决于医疗保健服务或个人选择，还取决于人们生活的社会条件。法律影响获得安全、社会支持和平等待遇的机会。换句话说，法律本身就构成了决定个人健康的环境的一部分。这很重要，因为香港 LGBTQ+ 人群所经历的健康差异仍然很大。香港中文大学和香港大学的研究人员在 2025 年进行的一项调查发现，30.8% 的 LGBTQ+ 受访者报告有中度至重度抑郁症状，而 24% 的人报告有中度至重度焦虑症状。这些数字与七年前进行的可比调查相比几乎没有变化。这些差异的持续存在表明，仅仅提高可见度并不能消除与较差的心理健康结果相关的结构性和社会因素。研究人员将这些发现描述为一个长期被忽视的问题的证据，需要更广泛的社会和政策应对措施。超越象征意义 一个经常被忽视的因素是 LGBTQ+ 人群生活的法律环境。少数群体压力框架描述了持续的歧视、耻辱和排斥经历如何造成慢性心理压力，从而导致性少数群体的健康状况较差。重要的是，问题并不是由性取向本身引起的，......

reflection.en: The unresolved legal status of same-sex partnerships in Hong Kong creates profound hardship, as seen in Henry Li's struggle for protections after his husband's death. This situation underscores the need to advocate for those facing systemic injustice and to ensure that all families receive the recognition and support they deserve. Isaiah 1:17 calls us to...
reflection.zh: 香港同性伴侶關係法律地位懸而未決，造成了深重困苦，正如亨利·李在丈夫去世後為爭取保障而經歷的艱難。這種情況凸顯了為那些面臨體制性不公的人辯護，並確保所有家庭獲得應有的認可和支持的必要性。 以賽亞書 1:17 呼籲我們「你們要學習行善，尋求公平，解救受欺壓的，給孤兒伸冤，為寡婦之冤。」願我們被這些故事感動，積極捍衛弱勢群體，並倡導維護所有家庭尊嚴和安全的政策。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Hong Kong agencies warn of lingering Jakarta flight delays after volcano eruption

GLC (Manado) Employment Service...
summary.zh: 一些香港的就业和旅游公司警告说，在雅加达国际机场因火山喷发而关闭后重新开放，但航空公司仍在处理积压航班的情况下，雅加达的空中交通可能会继续面临中断。GLC（万鸦老）就业服务公司创始人兼董事朱锡贤告诉《南华早报》，尽管所有机场已恢复运营，但他不会急于为客户的家庭佣工预订机票。

GLC (Manado) Employment Service founder and director Chu Shek-yin told the South China Morning Post that he would not rush to book an air ticket for his client’s helper despite the resumption of operations at all...
