reflection.en: The unexpected eruption of Mount Ruang has caused significant travel disruptions, impacting employment and daily life for many. This situation reminds us that even in unforeseen circumstances, our work and our efforts to navigate challenges can be offered to God. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to perform all tasks, whether planning a trip or managing a...
reflection.zh: 鲁昂山火山的意外喷发造成了重大的旅行中断，影响了许多人的就业和日常生活。这种情况提醒我们，即使在不可预见的困难中，我们的工作和应对挑战的努力也可以奉献给神。《歌罗西书》3章23节鼓励我们，无论是在规划行程还是管理业务，都要勤奋诚实地完成所有任务，如同服事主一样。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists to be sentenced on Friday, facing max. penalty of 10 years’ jail
title.zh: 香港“六四”烛光晚会案活动人士周五判刑，最高可判十年监禁

summary.en: Three Hong Kong activists convicted under the national security law for their roles in commemorating the Tiananmen Square crackdown will be sentenced on Friday. They face a maximum of 10 years in prison each. The activists, former leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, were found guilty of inciting subversion.
summary.zh: 三名因纪念天安门镇压事件而被判有罪的香港活动人士，将于周五被判刑。他们根据国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪，每人最高可判处十年监禁。这些活动人士曾是香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会（支联会）的领导人。

body.en: Three Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists convicted under the national security law will be sentenced this Friday, with each of them facing maximum penalties of 10 years behind bars. Former Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China Albert Ho (left), Lee Cheuk-yan (centre) and Chow Hang-tung (right) at Victoria Park in Hong Kong on June 4, 2020, after the annual Tiananmen vigil was banned on public health grounds because of Covid-19. Photo: Anthony Wallace/AFP. Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan and Albert Ho will appear at the West Kowloon Law Courts Building, according to the Judiciary’s court schedule. The trio are former leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, which used to organise annual Tiananmen vigils in Causeway Bay’s Victoria Park until they were banned in 2020 and 2021. Chow and Lee, a former lawmaker, pleaded not guilty to inciting subversion, and sat through a trial earlier this year. They were found guilty last month , with the judges saying they had “all along been hostile towards the [Chinese Communist Party] and the Central Government under its leadership.” Hong Kong police set up a cordon outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on August 21, 2026, ahead of the verdict hearing of the trial of two Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tang and Lee Cheuk-yan on national security charges. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Both of them have been remanded in custody since September 2021. Ho, also a former lawmaker, pleaded guilty when the trial began in January. Unlike Chow and Lee, he was initially granted bail after being charged, but was remanded in March 2023 after a magistrate ruled he had violated bail conditions . The Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China announced its disbandment in September 2021 amid the enactment of the national security law. The group itself was also prosecuted, and convicted along with Chow and Lee last month.
body.zh: 三名根据国家安全法被定罪的香港天安门守夜活动人士将于本周五被判刑，他们每人将面临最高 10 年监禁的刑罚。 2020 年 6 月 4 日，前香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟何俊仁（左）、李卓人（中）和周恒东（右）在香港维多利亚公园，一年一度的天安门守夜活动因 Covid-19 以公共卫生为由被禁止。照片：安东尼·华莱士/法新社。根据司法机构的法庭时间表，周恒东、李卓人及何俊仁将在西九龙法院大楼出庭。这三人是香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟的前领导人，该联盟曾在铜锣湾维多利亚公园组织一年一度的天安门守夜活动，直到2020年和2021年被禁止。周和李是前立法会议员，他们对煽动颠覆罪不认罪，并在今年早些时候接受了审判。他们上个月被判有罪，法官称他们“一直敌视[中国共产党]及其领导的中央政府”。 2026 年 8 月 21 日，在对两名天安门守夜活动人士周行棠和李卓人以国家安全罪名进行审判之前，香港警方在西九龙法院大楼外设置了警戒线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。自 2021 年 9 月起，两人均被还押候审。同为前议员的何先生在 1 月份审判开始时认罪。与周和李不同，他最初在受到指控后获得保释，但在地方法官裁定他违反保释条件后于 2023 年 3 月被还押。香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟于2021年9月随着国家安全法的颁布而宣布解散。该组织本身也受到起诉，并于上个月与周和李一起被定罪。

reflection.en: The sentencing of these three activists brings into sharp focus the tension between civic duty and conscience. They face significant prison time for actions rooted in remembrance and advocacy. The principle of obeying God rather than human authorities, when they conflict, speaks to the deep moral choices individuals face when laws and deeply held beliefs...
reflection.zh: 这三名活动人士的判刑，将公民责任与良心之间的紧张关系推到了聚光灯下。他们因根植于纪念和倡导的行为而面临漫长的牢狱之灾。《使徒行传》5章29节的原则——‘顺从神，过于顺从人’——触及了当法律与个人坚定的信念发生冲突时，个体所面临的深刻道德抉择。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Former CE Tung Chee-hwa dies at 89
title.zh: 前特首董建華逝世，享年89歲

summary.en: Former Hong Kong Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa has passed away at the age of 89. His office confirmed his peaceful death on Tuesday, surrounded by family. The statement highlighted his lifelong dedication to serving the nation and noted that his legacy endures. Tung was the first chief executive of the Hong Kong...
summary.zh: 香港前行政長官董建華昨日（週二）在家人的陪伴下安詳離世，享年89歲。他的辦公室發布聲明，指董建華畢生致力於服務國家，其精神遺澤永存。董建華於1997年至2005年間擔任香港特別行政區首任行政長官，之後擔任中國人民政治協商會議全國委員會副主席。

body.en: Former chief executive Tung Chee-hwa has died at the age of 89. His office said Tung passed away peacefully on Tuesday, surrounded by family members. The statement added that he dedicated his life to serving the nation, and his legacy lives on. Tung served as the SAR's first chief executive from 1997 to 2005. He later served as vice chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. Edited by Cecil Wong
body.zh: 前行政长官董建华去世，享年 89 岁。他的办公室表示，董建华于周二在家人的陪伴下安详离世。声明还说，他一生致力于为国家服务，他的遗产将继续存在。董建华于1997年至2005年担任香港特别行政区第一任行政长官，其后担任中国人民政治协商会议副主席。黄塞西尔编辑

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that it is appointed for man to die once. As we reflect on a life dedicated to public service, we are reminded of the finite nature of our time on earth and the enduring legacy that follows.
reflection.zh: 董建華先生以89歲高齡離世的消息，提醒我們死亡是人類共同的經歷。希伯來書9章27節指出，人人都有一死。在我們回顧他為公眾服務的一生時，也應銘記生命短暫，而身後留下的影響則會延續。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong’s first chief executive, dies aged 89
title.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华逝世，享年89岁

summary.en: Tung Chee-hwa, the first chief executive of Hong Kong and a former vice-chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), has died at the age of 89. His office confirmed his passing on Tuesday.
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官、中国人民政治协商会议前副主席董建华于周二逝世，享年89岁。其办公室于周三凌晨发布声明确认了这一消息。

body.en: Tung Chee-hwa, who served as Hong Kong’s first chief executive and oversaw the 1997 return of the city to Chinese rule, has died. The former vice-chairman of China’s top political advisory body, the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), died at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital on Tuesday at the age of 89, according to a statement from his office issued in the early hours on Wednesday. “Mr Tung dedicated his life with an unwavering commitment to the service of the Nation and...
body.zh: 曾担任香港首任特首并监督香港于 1997 年回归中国统治的董建华已经去世。据其办公室周三凌晨发布的声明，中国最高政治咨询机构中国人民政治协商会议（CPPCC）前副主席于周二去世，享年 89 岁。董建华先生是一位忠心耿耿、一心为国的人，他的品格高尚，...

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human journey toward mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that death comes to all. In this moment, we acknowledge the end of a significant public life and reflect on the finite nature of our own time.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生以89岁高龄辞世的消息，提醒我们所有人终将面对的生命终点。希伯来书9章27节指出，人人都有一死，这是人类共同的命运。此刻，我们缅怀一位重要公众人物的生命历程，并反思我们自己生命的有限。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: 'Global innovation index recognises GBA's strengths'
title.zh: 全球创新指数认可大湾区优势

summary.en: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster has maintained its top position in the latest Global Innovation Index, reaffirming the Greater Bay Area's comprehensive innovation strength. This success is seen as a reflection of Hong Kong's research capabilities and the increasing collaboration between Hong Kong and mainland...
summary.zh: 最新的全球创新指数显示，深圳—香港—广州集群保持了其首位，重申了大湾区全面的创新实力。根据香港思汇政策研究所的说法，这一成功反映了香港的研究能力以及香港与大湾区内地城市日益增长的合作。

body.en: Local think tank Our Hong Kong Foundation said the latest Global Innovation Index, of which the Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster retained the top spot, reaffirmed the comprehensive innovation strength of the Greater Bay Area. The result was published by the World Intellectual Property Organisation on Tuesday. “It reflects not only Hong Kong’s distinctive strengths in basic research, but also the sustained recognition by an authoritative international institution of closer I&T collaboration in recent years between Hong Kong and mainland GBA cities,” the foundation's deputy research director Victor Kwok said. He said China leads all nations with the most clusters in the ranking for the fourth straight year – showcasing the effectiveness of its policies in science, technology and innovation. The SAR should lure more global I&T investment to the city and the GBA through the government's HK$10 billion innovation fund and its international capital networks, Kwok added. Meanwhile, DAB lawmaker Elizabath Quat said the result showed that the GBA has already formed a complete innovation ecosystem encompassing research, transformation and capital. She said that moving forward, deepening cooperation between Hong Kong and other GBA cities will boost the nation's overall I&T development. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 本地智库团结香港基金会表示，最新的全球创新指数中，深港广集群蝉联榜首，再次肯定了大湾区的综合创新实力。世界知识产权组织周二公布了这一结果。该基金会副研究总监郭伟表示：“这不仅反映了香港在基础研究方面的独特优势，也体现了国际权威机构对香港与大湾区内地城市近年来更加紧密的创科合作的持续认可。”他表示，中国连续第四年在集群数量最多的国家排名中名列前茅，显示了其科技创新政策的有效性。郭补充说，特区应通过政府100亿港元的创新基金及其国际资本网络，吸引更多全球科技投资到香港和大湾区。与此同时，民建联议员Elizabath Quat表示，这一结果表明，大湾区已经形成了涵盖研究、转化和资本的完整创新生态系统。她表示，展望未来，香港与大湾区其他城市深化合作将推动国家整体创科发展。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster's continued leadership in innovation is a testament to focused effort and collaboration. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us that committing our plans and work to Yahweh is key to their success. May this achievement inspire continued dedication and wisdom in pursuing innovation for the common good.
reflection.zh: 深圳—香港—广州集群在创新领域持续领先，是专注努力和协作的证明。箴言16:3提醒我们，将我们的计划和工作交托给雅伟是成功的关键。愿这一成就激励人们继续致力于创新，以促进共同福祉。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: A vicarious calibration model enables quantitative applications of Fengyun-3 satellite ocean color data
title.zh: 一种指示校准模型可实现风云三号卫星海洋颜色数据的定量应用

summary.en: Ocean color remote sensing is crucial for tracking global ocean carbon sinks and primary productivity. However, current satellite sensor calibration accuracy is insufficient, and the weak marine signals, which constitute only about 10% of the received signals, lead to significant uncertainties in applications. China's...
summary.zh: 海洋颜色遥感是监测全球海洋碳汇和初级生产力的重要工具。然而，目前的卫星传感器在轨校准精度不足，微弱的海洋信号仅占接收信号的约10%，导致海洋颜色遥感应用存在显著的不确定性。中国装备了MERSI传感器的风云三号D星和F星卫星面临着挑战。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Ocean color remote sensing is a vital tool for monitoring global ocean carbon sinks and primary productivity. However, the on-orbit calibration accuracy of satellite sensors is insufficient, and weak marine signals account for only approximately 10% of the signals received by satellites, leading to significant uncertainties in ocean color remote-sensing applications.

China's Fengyun-3D (FY-3D) and Fengyun-3F (FY-3F) satellites, both equipped with Medium Resolution Spectral Imager (MERSI) sensors, have faced a persistent "weak signal, strong interference" dilemma in their ocean color observation channels, calling for a dedicated, targeted calibration solution.

Recently, a joint research team led by the National Satellite Meteorological Center in China and the Aerospace Information Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Sciences developed a vicarious calibration model for the MERSI sensors aboard FY-3D and FY-3F. The model effectively corrected radiometric biases in the ocean color channels of the two satellites, significantly improving the accuracy of retrieved ocean remote-sensing reflectance.

The findings mark a major step forward for Chinese satellite ocean color data, enhancing quantitative application capabilities, and were recently published in Atmospheric and Oceanic Science Letters .

"Limited on-orbit sensor calibration, along with atmospheric interference, has introduced considerable biases in the observation of weak ocean signals, thereby restricting the quantitative application of ocean color remote sensing," explained Professor Chong Shi, corresponding author of the study.

"Our approach leverages high-precision ground-based observations as a reference and integrates radiative transfer simulations with regression analysis to calibrate the ocean color channels. By taking into account the sensors' spectral response characteristics, this method accurately disentangles atmospheric path-radiance contributions and corrects water-leaving radiance. This study is expected to provide more reliable remote-sensing data to support ocean color observation research."

The research team plans to extend the proposed vicarious calibration framework to more complex aquatic environments, such as turbid coastal waters, and conduct time-series analyses to monitor the long-term stability of the calibration coefficients. The study not only establishes a basis for the quantitative use of FY-3 ocean color data but also provides a technical reference for calibrating China's ocean color remote-sensing data.

Ni An et al, Vicarious calibration of the weak-signal ocean color...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 海洋颜色遥感是监测全球海洋碳汇和初级生产力的重要工具。然而，卫星传感器在轨定标精度不足，海洋信号较弱仅占卫星接收信号的10%左右，导致海洋颜色遥感应用存在较大不确定性。 搭载中分辨率光谱成像仪（MERSI）传感器的中国风云三号D（FY-3D）和风云三号F（FY-3F）卫星的海洋颜色观测通道一直面临“信号弱、干扰强”的困境，需要专门的、有针对性的校准解决方案。 近日，由国家卫星气象中心和中国科学院空天信息研究院牵头的联合研究团队开发了风云三号D和风云三号F上MERSI传感器的替代标定模型。该模型有效校正了两颗卫星海洋颜色通道的辐射偏差，显着提高了反演海洋遥感反射率的精度。 该研究结果标志着中国卫星海洋颜色数据的定量应用能力迈出了重要一步，并于近期发表在《大气与海洋科学快报》上。 该研究通讯作者石崇教授解释说：“有限的在轨传感器校准以及大气干扰，在微弱海洋信号的观测中引入了相当大的偏差，从而限制了海洋颜色遥感的定量应用。” “我们的方法以高精度地面观测为参考，将辐射传输模拟与回归分析相结合，以校准海洋颜色通道。通过考虑传感器的光谱响应特性，该方法准确地解开大气路径辐射的贡献并校正水离开的辐射。这项研究有望为海洋颜色观测研究提供更可靠的遥感数据。” 研究团队计划将所提出的替代校准框架扩展到更复杂的水生环境，例如浑浊的沿海水域，并进行时间序列分析以监测校准系数的长期稳定性。该研究不仅为FY-3海洋颜色数据的定量使用奠定了基础，而且为我国海洋颜色遥感数据的校准提供了技术参考。 倪安等，弱信号海洋颜色的替代校准...

reflection.en: The pursuit of understanding our planet's oceans through advanced technology reflects a deep human drive to explore and comprehend the intricate systems of creation. This scientific endeavor, like all efforts to observe and learn from the natural world, can be seen as a way of discerning the wisdom inherent in Yahweh's handiwork. May this improved data help...
reflection.zh: 通过先进技术探索我们星球的海洋，体现了人类深入了解和认识受造界复杂系统的内在驱动力。这项科学探索，如同所有观察和学习自然界的工作一样，可以看作是辨识雅伟作品中固有的智慧的一种方式。 愿这些改进的数据能帮助我们更好地管理地球上至关重要的海洋生态系统，并认识到一切知识的最终指向造物主。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Why does Southeast Asia keeps breathing the same haze—and can ASEAN do more to stop it?
title.zh: 东南亚为何持续呼吸着同样的雾霾——东盟能做更多来阻止它吗？

summary.en: Southeast Asia has been trying to tackle haze from forest fires for decades, but the region finds itself breathing it again every few years. This transboundary environmental problem has become a recurrent phenomenon, with recent fires in Indonesia sending smoke across Malaysia, Brunei Darussalam, and other parts of...
summary.zh: 东南亚几十年来一直在努力应对森林火灾造成的雾霾，但每隔几年，该地区就会再次呼吸到雾霾。这种跨界环境问题已成为一种反复出现的现象，最近印度尼西亚的火灾将烟雾吹向马来西亚、文莱达鲁萨兰和其他东南亚地区，导致区域性雾霾警报。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Southeast Asia has spent decades trying to tackle haze from forest fires. Yet every few years, the region finds itself breathing it again. The transboundary environmental problem has become a recurrent phenomenon in the region.

The latest episode is no exception. Forest and land fires in Indonesia have sent smoke across parts of Malaysia, Brunei Darussalam and other parts of Southeast Asia. On Aug. 26, the ASEAN Specialized Meteorological Center raised the regional haze alert to Level 3 as smoke from hotspots in Kalimantan, the Indonesian territory that makes up the majority of the island of Borneo, spread across borders.

Indonesia bears the primary responsibility for preventing and fighting fires on its territory. But once the smoke crosses national borders, haze becomes more than a domestic environmental problem. Malaysia and Brunei Darussalam have agreed to take this matter to the ASEAN level.

This issue has now become a test of whether ASEAN can help its members manage problems that no country can contain alone.

Transboundary haze is hardly new. Historical records show that smoke from fires in Indonesia has affected neighboring countries since at least the 1970s. The 1997 and 2015 fires were among the region's most severe.

Scientific research points to a combination of human activity and environmental conditions. Land clearing through burning can ignite fires, while drained and degraded peatlands are particularly vulnerable. Once dry, peat can burn underground and produce thick, persistent smoke that is difficult to extinguish.

Weather can make the situation worse. Prolonged dry conditions, including those associated with El Niño, can dry out vegetation and peatlands, allowing fires to spread more easily. In the current crisis, below-normal rainfall and strong dry-season conditions are helping sustain the fires and carry smoke across borders.

This means the haze cannot be solved simply by responding when fires are already burning. Prevention, land management and enforcement matter just as much.

Indonesia is central to the problem because many of the fires generating transboundary smoke occur within its territory, particularly on the islands of Sumatra and Kalimantan. This places the primary responsibility on the Indonesian government to prevent fires, enforce environmental regulations and hold those responsible accountable.

Indonesia already has laws and institutions aimed at preventing forest and land fires. Research also shows that the government has strengthened peatland protection and related institutions since 2016.

The recurring fires show how...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 东南亚几十年来一直在努力解决森林火灾造成的雾霾问题。然而每隔几年，该地区就会发现自己再次呼吸到这种空气。跨界环境问题已成为该地区反复出现的现象。 最新一集也不例外。印度尼西亚的森林和土地火灾已导致马来西亚、文莱达鲁萨兰国和东南亚其他地区的部分地区冒出浓烟。 8月26日，东盟专业气象中心将区域霾警报提升至3级，原因是来自印度尼西亚领土加里曼丹（占婆罗洲岛大部分面积）的热点地区烟雾蔓延至边境。 印度尼西亚对其领土上的火灾预防和扑救负有首要责任。但一旦烟雾跨越国界，雾霾就不仅仅是一个国内环境问题了。马来西亚和文莱达鲁萨兰国已同意将此事提交至东盟层面。 这个问题现在已经成为考验东盟是否能够帮助其成员国解决任何国家都无法单独遏制的问题。 跨境雾霾并不是什么新鲜事。历史记录显示，至少从 20 世纪 70 年代起，印度尼西亚火灾产生的烟雾就已经影响到了邻国。 1997 年和 2015 年的火灾是该地区最严重的火灾之一。 科学研究指出人类活动和环境条件的结合。通过燃烧清理土地可能会引发火灾，而干涸和退化的泥炭地尤其容易受到伤害。一旦干燥，泥炭就会在地下燃烧并产生难以扑灭的浓浓而持久的烟雾。 天气会使情况变得更糟。长期的干旱条件，包括与厄尔尼诺现象有关的条件，会使植被和泥炭地干燥，使火灾更容易蔓延。在当前的危机中，低于正常水平的降雨量和强烈的旱季条件正在帮助维持火势并将烟雾带过边境。 这意味着仅在火灾已经燃烧时做出反应就无法解决雾霾问题。预防、土地管理和执法同样重要。 印度尼西亚是这一问题的核心，因为许多产生跨境烟雾的火灾发生在其领土内，特别是在苏门答腊岛和加里曼丹岛。这使得印度尼西亚政府负有预防火灾、执行环境法规并追究责任人责任的首要责任。 印度尼西亚已经制定了旨在预防森林和土地火灾的法律和机构。研究还显示，自2016年以来，政府加强了泥炭地保护和相关机构建设。 反复发生的火灾表明......

reflection.en: The persistent haze blanketing Southeast Asia is a stark reminder of our shared responsibility for the environment. Psalm 24:1 declares that the earth and its fullness belong to Yahweh. This truth calls us to be faithful stewards, recognizing that the air we breathe and the lands we inhabit are not ours to exploit but are entrusted to us for care.
reflection.zh: 笼罩东南亚的持续雾霾，鲜明地提醒我们对环境负有共同的责任。《诗篇》24:1宣告：“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。”这一真理呼召我们成为忠实的管家，认识到我们呼吸的空气和居住的土地并非可以任我们剥削，而是托付给我们去照管的。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: New computational method pushes cryo-electron microscopy beyond traditional resolution limits
title.zh: 新计算方法将冷冻电子显微镜推向传统分辨率极限之外

summary.en: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) is a powerful technique for determining the structures of proteins, viruses, and molecular complexes at near-atomic resolution. However, its resolution is fundamentally limited by the Nyquist sampling frequency. A new computational method has been developed to overcome this...
summary.zh: 冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）已成为一种强大的工具，可以近原子分辨率确定蛋白质、病毒和分子复合物的结构。然而，其分辨率受到奈奎斯特采样频率的根本限制。一种新的计算方法已被开发出来，以克服这一限制，有可能使研究人员在无需以更高放大倍率重新收集数据的情况下获得更高的分辨率，从而节省时间和资源。

body.en: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a powerful tool for determining the structures of proteins, viruses and molecular complexes at near-atomic resolution. However, achievable resolution is fundamentally limited by the Nyquist sampling frequency, which is determined by detector pixel size and microscope magnification. Once this physical limit is reached, researchers typically must recollect data at higher magnification, requiring additional microscope time, increased storage capacity and often fewer particles per image.
body.zh: 冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 已成为以近原子分辨率确定蛋白质、病毒和分子复合物结构的强大工具。然而，可实现的分辨率从根本上受到奈奎斯特采样频率的限制，奈奎斯特采样频率由探测器像素大小和显微镜放大倍率决定。一旦达到这个物理极限，研究人员通常必须以更高的放大倍数重新收集数据，这需要额外的显微镜时间、增加的存储容量，并且通常每张图像的颗粒更少。

reflection.en: The Psalmist asks, 'Who does not fear you, Yahweh, and glorify your name? For only you are holy. All nations will come and worship before you.' This scientific advancement, born from human ingenuity observing the intricate world, reminds us of the profound wisdom embedded in creation itself. It is a testament to the order and complexity that points to a...
reflection.zh: 诗人问道：“雅伟啊，谁不敬畏你，不将荣耀归于你的名呢？惟独你是圣洁的。万国都必来敬拜你。”这项科学进步源于人类的智慧对复杂世界的观察，它提醒我们创造本身所蕴含的深刻智慧。它是秩序和复杂性的证明，指向一位创造者，邀请我们怀着敬畏之心去更深入地理解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Tiny backpacks reveal the secret, sometimes circuitous migrations of small songbirds
title.zh: 微型背包揭示小型鸣禽秘密的、有时是曲折的迁徙

summary.en: Researchers are using tiny backpacks to track the migration patterns of small songbirds, revealing that their journeys are often more complex and circuitous than previously understood. These observations offer new insights into avian behavior and ecology.
summary.zh: 研究人员正在使用微型背包追踪小型鸣禽的迁徙模式，揭示它们的旅程通常比以前所理解的更为复杂和曲折。这些观察为了解鸟类行为和生态学提供了新的见解。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Squinting through my binoculars, I scanned the dense branches of a black spruce, trying my best to catch a glimpse of the thin legs of a small black, white and yellow songbird. I was on the hunt for a yellow-rumped warbler—a bird affectionately called "butter-butt" by birdwatchers after the distinctive buttery yellow patch of feathers above its tail.

Once I spotted a flash of red on one of the bird's legs, I knew that this individual was special—in fact, it was one that I already knew well. That's because I had placed identifying bands on it the previous year as part of my Ph.D. research , and it was carrying a very important piece of new technology.

I played the high-pitched "warble" of its song through a speaker placed below a mist net of fine, nearly invisible mesh. Thinking another male had intruded on his territory, the bird quickly descended. My tactic worked—he got caught in the net. As I gently removed him, I breathed a sigh of relief as I saw the Tic Tac-size device sitting on his back.

Over the past year, this warbler carried a multisensor geolocator backpack throughout his migratory journey, recording the long trek from his breeding grounds in Anchorage, Alaska, to an as-yet-unknown winter refuge and back again. Working with my Ph.D. adviser, evolutionary biologist David Toews, I deployed dozens of these cutting-edge tags to illuminate the migratory journeys of these high-latitude breeding warblers at a scale not previously possible for small birds.

Researchers began tracking the movements of migrating birds in the late 1960s using radio telemetry, a technique that requires tagged birds to be physically followed with receiver equipment, sometimes aided by a small aircraft.

Then, as GPS became more widely available in the early 2000s, satellite tags let researchers accurately track birds remotely. However, GPS transmitters are hefty—even just the battery that powers them is too heavy to be carried by the majority of small migratory songbirds, which often weigh less than a spoonful of sugar.

To address this problem, researchers developed ingenious little light-level geolocators. These miniature tags minimize weight by containing only a tiny battery, clock, computer chip and light sensor. They store data internally rather than transmitting it—hence my need to recapture tagged birds a year later. Researchers infer a bird's locations from the timing of sunrise and sunset, which vary predictably across the globe and throughout the year.

Light-level geolocators have opened new windows into the migrations of small birds , but they also have limitations: Their...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 我眯起眼睛，用双筒望远镜扫视着黑云杉茂密的枝条，尽力瞥见一只黑白黄相间的小鸣鸟细细的腿。我当时正在寻找一只黄腰莺，这种鸟被观鸟者亲切地称为“黄油屁股”，因为它尾巴上方有一块独特的黄油黄色羽毛。 当我在鸟的一条腿上看到一抹红色时，我就知道这个人很特别——事实上，我已经很熟悉了。那是因为我在前一年在它上面放置了识别带，作为我博士学位的一部分。研究，它携带着一项非常重要的新技术。 我通过放置在几乎看不见的细网雾网下方的扬声器播放了它的歌曲的高音“颤音”。这只鸟以为另一只雄性侵犯了它的领地，于是迅速下降。我的策略奏效了——他被网缠住了。当我轻轻地把他移开时，当我看到他背上有一个 Tic Tac 大小的设备时，我松了一口气。 在过去的一年里，这只莺在整个迁徙旅程中都携带了一个多传感器地理定位器背包，记录了从阿拉斯加安克雷奇的繁殖地到一个未知的冬季避难所并再次返回的长途跋涉。和我的博士一起工作。在进化生物学家大卫·托斯（David Toews）顾问的指导下，我部署了数十个这样的尖端标签，以以前小型鸟类不可能实现的规模来阐明这些高纬度繁殖莺的迁徙旅程。 研究人员在 20 世纪 60 年代末开始使用无线电遥测技术追踪候鸟的活动，这种技术需要使用接收设备对标记的鸟类进行跟踪，有时还需要一架小型飞机的辅助。 随后，随着 GPS 在 2000 年代初变得更加广泛使用，卫星标签使研究人员能够准确地远程追踪鸟类。然而，GPS 发射器很重，即使是为其供电的电池也太重，大多数小型迁徙鸣禽无法携带，因为它们的重量通常还不到一勺糖。 为了解决这个问题，研究人员开发了巧妙的小型光级地理定位器。这些微型标签仅包含微型电池、时钟、计算机芯片和光传感器，从而最大限度地减轻了重量。它们在内部存储数据而不是传输数据，因此我需要在一年后重新捕获标记的鸟类。研究人员根据日出和日落的时间来推断鸟类的位置，这些时间在全球范围内和全年都有可预测的变化。 光级地理定位器为观察小鸟类的迁徙打开了新的窗口，但它们也有局限性：它们的……

reflection.en: The intricate design and behavior of even the smallest creatures, like the yellow-rumped warbler, speak volumes about the Creator's wisdom. As these tiny backpacks unveil the marvels of their migrations, we are reminded that all of creation, from the grandest star to the smallest bird, declares the glory of Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 即使是最小的生物，如黄臀鹀，其精巧的设计和行为也充分彰显了造物主的智慧。当这些微型背包揭示它们迁徙的奇迹时，我们被提醒，所有被造之物，从最宏伟的星辰到最小的鸟儿，都在宣告雅伟的荣耀。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Watch: Downed trees and flooding as Hurricane Lowell batters western Hawaii
title.zh: 观看：飓风洛厄尔袭击夏威夷西部，树木倒塌，洪水泛滥

summary.en: The storm brought damaging winds and torrential rain to parts of the island on Monday and Tuesday, triggering concerns about flash flooding and mudslides.

In moments of such overwhelming force, when homes are threatened and landscapes transformed by wind and rain, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer solace: 'God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.' This divine presence offers a...

title.en: Why a wetter Tibetan Plateau still faces 'hot-dry' extremes: The roles of ENSO and the North Atlantic
title.zh: 为何湿润的青藏高原仍面临“干热”极端：ENSO和北大西洋的作用

summary.en: Since the 1950s, the Tibetan Plateau has experienced pronounced warming and wetting. However, an overall shift toward wetter conditions does not necessarily mean that drought risk has diminished. On the contrary, against the backdrop of continued warming, compound hot-dry events—characterized by the simultaneous...
summary.zh: 自20世纪50年代以来，青藏高原经历了显著的变暖和湿润。然而，总体趋于湿润的状况并不一定意味着干旱风险已经减小。相反，在持续变暖的背景下，高温和干旱同时发生的复合性干热事件已成为高原上日益重要的气候风险。

body.en: Since the 1950s, the Tibetan Plateau has experienced pronounced warming and wetting. However, an overall shift toward wetter conditions does not necessarily mean that drought risk has diminished. On the contrary, against the backdrop of continued warming, compound hot-dry events—characterized by the simultaneous occurrence of high temperatures and drought—have become an increasingly important climate risk across the plateau.
body.zh: 自20世纪50年代以来，青藏高原经历了明显的变暖和湿润。然而，总体向湿润条件的转变并不一定意味着干旱风险已经减少。相反，在持续变暖的背景下，以高温和干旱同时发生为特征的复合干热事件已成为青藏高原日益重要的气候风险。

As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or the fish in the sea, and they will explain to you.' This research...

title.en: Some black holes grow much faster than their galaxies
title.zh: 一些黑洞的增长速度远超其星系

summary.en: Nearly every galaxy hosts a supermassive black hole, with the rare exceptions being galaxies that have had their black holes ejected during collisions. This suggests a co-evolutionary relationship between galaxies and their central black holes, though the exact sequence of formation is still debated.
summary.zh: 几乎每个星系都有一个超大质量黑洞，少数没有的星系是在星系碰撞中被将其黑洞弹出。这表明星系与其中心黑洞之间存在共同演化的关系，尽管其形成的具体顺序仍在争论中。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Nearly every galaxy has a supermassive black hole. The few that don't have had theirs ejected during a galactic collision. That's because galaxies and their black holes have formed hand in hand. There is still some debate as to whether galaxies formed around the seeds of supermassive black holes or the other way around, but there is plenty of evidence to support the idea that the two evolve together.

One point of evidence is the fact that supermassive black holes generally have about 0.5% of a galaxy's mass. The mass correlation between black holes and galaxies suggests a strong connection in how they form. In the same way, the correlation between the size of a city and the number of people who live there suggests a connection between structural size and population.

But a recent study found oversized galactic black holes, challenging our understanding of their evolution. For this study, published in Astronomy & Astrophysics , the team used the eROSITA X-ray telescope and other observations to look at more than 20,000 quasars. Quasars are powered by active supermassive black holes.

As the black holes consume nearby material, they emit a tremendous amount of light, such as X-rays and radio waves. The intensity of a quasar is related to the mass of the black hole, so quasars are a great way to study the distribution of black hole masses. For many quasars, we also know the mass of their galaxies. By observing the region of a quasar in visible and infrared light, we can determine the brightness of the galaxy, which is proportional to its mass.

When the team compared galaxy masses with the masses of their black holes, eight quasars stood out. Rather than the usual mass ratio of 200 to 1, these systems had a ratio of 20 to 1. In other words, the mass of these black holes makes up about 5% of the galaxy's mass. Not only that, three of the quasars were among the brightest in the sample, meaning they are consuming matter at an exceptional pace. The authors estimate these particular black holes could double in mass in just a billion years.

One distinct feature of these unusual black holes is that their galaxies are particularly faint. This means they don't contain nearly the number of stars as, say, the Milky Way. It's possible that more stars will form over time. It's also possible that the black hole will consume enough material that later stars can't form. We don't have enough observations to determine which.

Based on the observations we do have, it seems there is a mechanism by which black hole growth can quickly outstrip galaxy growth, at least for a time. So while there...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 几乎每个星系都有一个超大质量黑洞。少数没有的飞船在银河碰撞中被弹出。那是因为星系和它们的黑洞是齐头并进形成的。关于星系是围绕超大质量黑洞的种子形成还是相反，仍然存在一些争论，但有大量证据支持两者一起演化的观点。 证据之一是超大质量黑洞的质量通常约为星系质量的 0.5%。黑洞和星系之间的质量相关性表明它们的形成方式存在密切的联系。同样，城市规模与居住在那里的人口数量之间的相关性表明结构规模与人口之间存在联系。 但最近的一项研究发现了超大的星系黑洞，挑战了我们对其演化的理解。在这项发表在《天文学与天体物理学》上的研究中，研究小组使用 eROSITA X 射线望远镜和其他观测手段观察了 20,000 多个类星体。类星体由活跃的超大质量黑洞提供动力。 当黑洞消耗附近的物质时，它们会发出大量的光，例如 X 射线和无线电波。类星体的强度与黑洞的质量有关，因此类星体是研究黑洞质量分布的好方法。对于许多类星体，我们也知道它们星系的质量。通过在可见光和红外光下观察类星体的区域，我们可以确定星系的亮度，该亮度与其质量成正比。 当研究小组将星系质量与其黑洞质量进行比较时，八个类星体脱颖而出。这些系统的质量比不是通常的 200 比 1，而是 20 比 1。换句话说，这些黑洞的质量约占星系质量的 5%。不仅如此，其中三个类星体是样本中最亮的，这意味着它们正在以异常的速度消耗物质。作者估计这些特殊黑洞的质量可能在短短十亿年内翻倍。 这些不寻常的黑洞的一个显着特征是它们的星系特别微弱。这意味着它们所包含的恒星数量几乎不及银河系。随着时间的推移，可能会形成更多的恒星。黑洞也有可能会消耗足够的物质，使后来的恒星无法形成。我们没有足够的观察来确定哪个。 根据我们现有的观察，似乎存在一种机制，通过这种机制，黑洞的增长可以快速超过星系的增长，至少在一段时间内是这样。所以当在那里...

reflection.en: The universe reveals its intricate design and interconnectedness in ways that inspire awe. As we observe how galaxies and their supermassive black holes develop in tandem, we are reminded of the profound wisdom embedded in creation, inviting us to seek understanding through careful observation and study.
reflection.zh: 宇宙以激发敬畏的方式揭示其错综复杂的设计和相互联系。当我们观察星系及其超大质量黑洞如何协同发展时，我们被提醒了创造中蕴含的深刻智慧，这邀请我们通过仔细观察和研究来寻求理解。

title.en: The trail of clues that our planet might be heating faster than we realised
title.zh: 地球变暖速度可能超乎我们想象的线索踪迹

summary.en: A dispute on social media over this summer's heatwaves has revealed a concerning shift in climate science, suggesting the planet might be warming faster than previously understood.
summary.zh: 今年夏天的热浪引发了一场网络争论，揭示了气候科学领域一个令人担忧的转变，表明地球变暖的速度可能比之前认为的更快。

body.en:
This July, during Britain's record-breaking hot summer, a curious row broke out on X over climate science.

Reform's deputy leader Richard Tice shared a Telegraph article headlined: "Heatwaves caused by fall in pollution." He said cleaner air, rather than carbon dioxide, was behind higher temperatures and claimed the public had been "gaslit".

He was wrong to suggest that carbon dioxide is not the primary driver of global warming. But the science he was distorting is real - and much more interesting than his original claim.

The fossil fuels that we've been burning for more than a century produce two very different kinds of pollution. As is well known, carbon dioxide warms the Earth. But less well-known is sulphur pollution, which forms vast numbers of tiny particles in the air and reflects sunlight back into space, partly counteracting the warming effect of carbon.

Thanks to clean-air policies around the world - like the US's Acid Rain Program in the early 1990s, that reduced gas pollution from power plants - sulphur emissions are falling sharply while carbon dioxide emissions remain near record highs.

Scientists increasingly believe the loss of that cooling effect is slightly speeding up global warming.

The past three years were the three warmest ever recorded, and the Met Office says 2027 is "very likely" to replace 2024 as the warmest year on record.

And away from social media, the argument over Tice's tweet raised an even more interesting - and worrying - question. Is it possible that our planet is actually more sensitive to greenhouse gases than we imagined?

Global temperatures jump around naturally from year to year. El Niño, for example, a natural warming of the Pacific Ocean, can temporarily push them higher. So a run of record hot years does not necessarily mean the underlying rate of global warming has increased.

Reto Knutti and his team at ETH Zurich have tried to strip out the effects of El Niño and other natural fluctuations to reveal the underlying trend.

"It's pretty clear that the rate of warming has accelerated," says Knutti, a professor of climate physics at the Swiss university and a former co-ordinating lead author for the IPCC - the UN-backed body that produces the world's most authoritative assessments of climate science.

A separate study published this year reached a similar conclusion after accounting for several major natural influences.

Burning coal and oil releases sulphur dioxide, which forms tiny particles known as sulphate aerosols. These particles are bright and reflect some sunlight before it can reach and warm the planet's surface.

You've probably heard the greenhouse analogy used to explain global warming. Gases like carbon dioxide make it harder for heat to escape from the Earth, rather like the glass...
body.zh: 今年七月，在英国破纪录的炎热夏季期间，X 网上爆发了一场关于气候科学的奇怪争论。 改革党副领导人理查德·泰斯分享了一篇《每日电讯报》文章，标题为“污染下降引发热浪”。他说，高温背后的原因是更清洁的空气，而不是二氧化碳，并声称公众受到了“煤气灯”的影响。 他错误地认为二氧化碳不是全球变暖的主要驱动因素。但他歪曲的科学是真实的——而且比他最初的主张有趣得多。 我们一个多世纪以来一直燃烧的化石燃料产生了两种截然不同的污染。众所周知，二氧化碳使地球变暖。但不太为人所知的是硫污染，它在空气中形成大量微小颗粒，并将阳光反射回太空，部分抵消了碳的变暖效应。 得益于世界各地的清洁空气政策（例如 20 世纪 90 年代初美国的酸雨计划减少了发电厂的气体污染），硫排放量急剧下降，而二氧化碳排放量仍接近历史最高水平。 科学家们越来越相信，冷却效应的丧失正在略微加速全球变暖。 过去三年是有记录以来最热的三年，英国气象局表示，2027 年“很有可能”取代 2024 年，成为有记录以来最热的一年。 除了社交媒体之外，关于泰斯推文的争论还引发了一个更有趣、也更令人担忧的问题。我们的星球是否有可能实际上对温室气体比我们想象的更敏感？ 全球气温逐年自然跳跃。例如，厄尔尼诺现象（太平洋的自然变暖）可能会暂时推高它们。因此，连续创纪录的炎热年份并不一定意味着全球变暖的潜在速度有所加快。 苏黎世联邦理工学院的雷托·克努蒂（Reto Knutti）和他的团队试图排除厄尔尼诺现象和其他自然波动的影响，以揭示潜在的趋势。 瑞士大学气候物理学教授、IPCC 前协调主要作者克努蒂说：“很明显，变暖的速度正在加快。”IPCC 是联合国支持的机构，负责对气候科学进行世界上最权威的评估。 今年发表的另一项研究在考虑了几个主要的自然影响后得出了类似的结论。 燃烧煤炭和石油会释放二氧化硫，形成称为硫酸盐气溶胶的微小颗粒。这些粒子很明亮，在到达地球表面并使其变暖之前会反射一些阳光。 您可能听说过用来解释全球变暖的温室类比。二氧化碳等气体使热量更难从地球逸出，就像玻璃一样......

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of understanding in climate science, as seen in the debate over heatwave data, reflects the prophecy that 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This surge in information calls for discernment, seeking wisdom to understand and respond to the complex challenges facing our planet....
reflection.zh: 许多人往来奔走，知识就增长。气候科学中关于热浪数据的争论，以及对地球变暖速度的新见解，正体现了这一点。这种知识的激增呼唤着分辨力，以及寻求智慧来理解和应对我们星球面临的复杂挑战。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Are rich people really worse behaved? Here’s the science – video
title.zh: 富人真的行为更差吗？科学是这么说的——视频

summary.en: A study, which found that wealthy individuals are more likely to engage in unethical behavior, was a winner of the Ig Nobel prizes. The research suggests potential reasons for this phenomenon, alongside other award-winning studies.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，富裕人士更有可能做出不道德的行为，并获得了2026年搞笑诺贝尔奖。该研究探讨了这一现象的潜在原因，并介绍了其他获奖研究。

body.en: Who’s more likely to steal sweets from a child? According to science, it’s the rich. A study seemingly confirming our suspicions about the moral behaviour of the wealthy was one of the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, which honour research that makes you laugh and then think. Science editor Ian Sample tells Madeleine Finlay what the researchers think could be behind the phenomenon, and they explore some of the other awards, including one for a surprising quality we look for in our friends and another for a biomechanical definition of kissing Continue reading...
body.zh: 谁更有可能偷孩子的糖果？根据科学，这是有钱人。一项似乎证实了我们对富人道德行为的怀疑的研究成为 2026 年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获得者之一，该奖项旨在表彰那些让你开怀大笑并引发思考的研究。科学编辑伊恩·萨普告诉玛德琳·芬利，研究人员认为这一现象背后可能存在什么，他们还探讨了其他一些奖项，其中一个奖项是为了我们在朋友身上寻找的令人惊讶的品质，另一个奖项是为了对接吻的生物力学定义继续阅读...

reflection.en: This research, honored by the Ig Nobel prizes, raises questions about the relationship between wealth and morality. It prompts us to consider whether the pursuit of material gain can sometimes overshadow ethical considerations, echoing the ancient wisdom that one cannot serve both God and Mammon.
reflection.zh: 这项搞笑诺贝尔奖所表彰的研究，引发了关于财富与道德之间关系的疑问。它促使我们思考，对物质财富的追求是否有时会掩盖道德考量，这呼应了古老的智慧：人不能同时事奉神和玛门。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: 'River is flowing better than it has for 25 years'
title.zh: 25年来河流状况最佳

summary.en: The River Deben is flowing better than it has in 25 years following major restoration efforts. Excavation and tree removal, part of a community and multi-agency initiative, have improved water flow after a weir collapse and bridge damage caused water levels to drop significantly.
summary.zh: 经过大规模修复工程后，德本河的河流状况比过去25年来都要好。挖掘和移除树木是多方机构和社区共同努力的一部分，在堰坝倒塌和桥梁损坏导致水位大幅下降后，这些工作改善了河流的流速。

body.en:
A river is flowing better than it has for a quarter of a century after a major restoration but the next stage of works will be "really critical", according to a parish councillor.

Water levels in the River Deben in Suffolk dropped by more than a metre after heavy rain caused a weir structure at Ufford, near Woodbridge, to fall away and a bridge to partially collapse.

While they are still to be fixed, water in the river is again running freely after a multi-agency and community effort saw vital excavations and tree removal take place.

Councillor David Findley, river warden at Ufford Parish Council, said it was a "really exciting moment to actually see the water flowing" again.

"This section of the river used to be cleaned out every five to 10 years, so it's not been like this for 25 years," he said.

"Now, you can see gravel bits and silt bits, and so it's actually creating a really potentially dynamic river."

The collapse in April caused a water-filled crater known as Ufford Hole to drain on to surrounding land, including on a side channel towards the East Suffolk railway line.

It happened after tree roots grew into the weir, which subsequently "fell to pieces", Finley said, resulting in "all the water" rushing towards the Hawkeswade/Lower Ufford Bridge which "cracked" it.

The Essex & Suffolk Rivers Trust said it caused "significant damage to habitats along a large stretch of the river".

A wooden walkway next to the bridge, which allows people to follow a footpath on the river bank, had to be closed off and it is still awaiting repair.

Trevor Gill, from the Lower Deben Riparian Owners Group, said the collapse had a detrimental effect on biodiversity.

"It had a really big impact on nature, but also on people who love this, people who've been fishing and swimming here for decades," he said.

"People were worried about fish dying, which did happen, and it was pretty barren.

"What we've done so far shows people that we are here to get behind this problem and fix it."

After the incident, councils and a consortium of landowners and farmers worked with the Environment Agency and others to form an action plan.

The first phase of that focused on clearing the dried-out channel from Old Melton Mill to Ufford Hole to allow water to flow back to the mill.

Now that has been achieved, attention has turned to repairing the weir before the "winter flood" and also the footpath to restore access.

"The really critical bit is getting this weir sorted out so the water doesn't just accelerate the channel and create real problems further down the river," Findley said.

River level plunges with drought. Video, 00:04:00 River level plunges with drought
body.zh: 一位教区议员表示，经过重大修复后，河流的流量比四分之一个世纪以来的情况要好，但下一阶段的工程将“非常关键”。 大雨导致伍德布里奇附近的乌福德的一个堰结构脱落，一座桥梁部分倒塌，萨福克郡德本河的水位下降了一米多。 虽然它们仍有待修复，但在多机构和社区的努力下进行了重要的挖掘和树木清除后，河水再次自由流动。 乌福德教区议会河流管理员、议员大卫·芬利表示，“再次看到水流流动真是令人兴奋的时刻”。 他说：“这一段河以前每五到十年就会被清理一次，所以已经有 25 年没有这样了。” “现在，你可以看到砾石和淤泥，因此它实际上正在创造一条真正具有潜在活力的河流。” 4 月份的塌陷导致一个名为 Ufford Hole 的充满水的火山口流到周围的土地上，包括通往东萨福克铁路线的侧通道。 芬利说，树根长进堰后，堰随后“碎裂”，导致“所有的水”涌向霍克斯瓦德/下乌福德大桥，导致堰“破裂”。 埃塞克斯和萨福克河信托基金表示，它“对沿河大片河段的栖息地造成了严重破坏”。 桥旁的一条木制走道允许人们沿着河岸的人行道行走，但不得不关闭，目前仍在等待修复。 下德本河岸业主小组的特雷弗·吉尔表示，塌方对生物多样性产生了不利影响。 “它对自然产生了巨大的影响，也对热爱这里的人们，几十年来一直在这里钓鱼和游泳的人们产生了巨大的影响，”他说。 “人们担心鱼类死亡，这种情况确实发生了，而且那里非常贫瘠。 “到目前为止，我们所做的事情向人们表明，我们是来支持这个问题并解决它的。” 事件发生后，议会以及土地所有者和农民组成的财团与环境局和其他机构合作制定了一项行动计划。 第一阶段的重点是清理从老梅尔顿磨坊到乌福德洞的干涸通道，让水流回磨坊。 既然已经实现了这一目标，人们的注意力就转向在“冬季洪水”到来之前修复堰以及恢复通道的人行道。 芬利说：“真正关键的一点是解决这个堰，这样水就不会加速河道流速，并在河流下游造成真正的问题。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、Instagram、external 和 X, external 上关注萨福克新闻。 河流水位因干旱而下降。视频，00:04:00 河流水位因干旱而暴跌

reflection.en: It is encouraging to see the River Deben flowing freely again after significant restoration work. This success, achieved through collaborative effort, reminds us of the goodness of creation and our role in its care. May this restoration inspire continued stewardship and a deep appreciation for the natural world Yahweh has made.
reflection.zh: 看到德本河经过大规模修复工程后再次自由流淌，令人鼓舞。这项通过共同努力取得的成功，提醒我们受造物的良善以及我们在其照管中的作用。愿这次修复能激励我们继续尽责，并深深地欣赏雅伟所造的自然世界。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Scientists discover a powerful new antivenom hidden in rattlesnake blood
title.zh: 科学家在响尾蛇血液中发现强效新抗蛇毒剂

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that combinations of toxin-blocking proteins naturally present in rattlesnake blood can effectively neutralize venom from several dangerous snake species. Laboratory tests showed these mixtures were approximately 10 times more potent than a current commercial antivenom, suggesting a...
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，响尾蛇血液中天然存在的毒素阻断蛋白组合能够有效中和多种危险蛇类的毒液。实验室测试表明，这些混合物的效力约为当前市售抗蛇毒剂的10倍，为治疗蛇咬伤开辟了一条有前景的新途径。

body.en:
University of Maryland researchers have identified a promising new way to treat venomous snakebites by borrowing from snakes' own natural defenses. Their approach uses toxin-blocking proteins that western diamondback rattlesnakes evolved to protect themselves from venom.

By combining specific proteins found in rattlesnake blood, the researchers achieved unusually strong protection against venom from several dangerous snake species.

The study was led by Distinguished University Professor of BiologySean B. Carroll and published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences . The findings could help researchers develop more powerful antivenoms for deadly snakebites, which remain a major health threat in some regions of the world.

"This is one of those great stories when nature has already solved a problem we've been grappling with for decades," said Carroll, who also holds the Andrew and Mary Balo and Nicholas and Susan Simon Endowed Chair at UMD.

Snakebite is considered one of the world's most neglected tropical diseases. According to the World Health Organization, venomous snakes kill an estimated 80,000 to 140,000 people annually, while hundreds of thousands of survivors are left with permanent disabilities. Many of those affected live in rural areas where effective antivenom can be difficult to obtain.

Existing antivenoms save lives, but they also have major drawbacks. They are typically produced by exposing large animals to snake venom and then collecting the antibodies those animals generate. Manufacturing these treatments can be costly, their quality and effectiveness can vary, and they may not work equally well against the many different toxins found in venom from different snake species. They can also cause serious immune reactions.

Those limitations have pushed scientists to search for better options. In this case, the researchers turned to snakes themselves for clues.

"We've known from anecdotes for 100 years that vipers tend to be resistant to their own venom," Carroll said. "But for a long time, nobody knew what exactly was circulating in their blood that protected them."

In 2022, Carroll's laboratory found part of the answer: a protein called FETUA-3. The researchers discovered that it could block the activity of many metalloproteinase toxins found in western diamondback rattlesnake venom. It could also bind to and inhibit toxins from the venoms of several other rattlesnake species.

"Here was evolution's way for snakes to protect themselves from accidental self-envenomation," he said, which prompted a follow-up question. "Why rely on horse antibodies when nature has packaged an effective antidote right there in the snake?"

For the new research, co-authors including Elda Sánchez, director of the National Natural...
body.zh: 马里兰大学的研究人员利用蛇自身的自然防御能力，发现了一种治疗毒蛇咬伤的有前途的新方法。他们的方法使用西方小菜斑响尾蛇进化来的毒素阻断蛋白来保护自己免受毒液的侵害。 通过结合响尾蛇血液中发现的特定蛋白质，研究人员获得了针对几种危险蛇类毒液的异常强大的保护作用。 该研究由杰出大学生物学教授肖恩·B·卡罗尔（Sean B. Carroll）领导，并发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。这些发现可以帮助研究人员开发出更强大的抗蛇毒血清来治疗致命的蛇咬伤，蛇咬伤仍然是世界某些地区的主要健康威胁。 “这是一个伟大的故事，大自然已经解决了我们几十年来一直在努力解决的问题，”卡罗尔说，他也是马里兰大学安德鲁和玛丽巴洛以及尼古拉斯和苏珊西蒙捐赠主席。 蛇咬伤被认为是世界上最被忽视的热带疾病之一。据世界卫生组织称，毒蛇每年导致约 80,000 至 140,000 人死亡，数十万幸存者留下永久性残疾。许多受影响者生活在农村地区，那里很难获得有效的抗蛇毒血清。 现有的抗蛇毒血清可以挽救生命，但它们也有重大缺点。它们通常是通过将大型动物暴露于蛇毒中，然后收集这些动物产生的抗体来产生的。制造这些治疗方法可能成本高昂，其质量和效果也各不相同，而且它们对于不同蛇类毒液中发现的多种不同毒素的效果可能不同。它们还会引起严重的免疫反应。 这些限制促使科学家寻找更好的选择。在这种情况下，研究人员转向蛇本身寻找线索。 卡罗尔说：“我们从 100 年来的轶事中得知，毒蛇往往对自己的毒液有抵抗力。” “但很长一段时间，没有人知道他们的血液中到底循环着什么来保护他们。” 2022 年，卡罗尔的实验室找到了部分答案：一种名为 FETUA-3 的蛋白质。研究人员发现，它可以阻止西方小菜斑响尾蛇毒液中发现的许多金属蛋白酶毒素的活性。它还可以结合并抑制其他几种响尾蛇物种的毒液中的毒素。 “这是蛇的进化方式，可以保护自己免受意外的自我毒害，”他说，这引发了一个后续问题。 “当大自然已经在蛇体内包装了有效的解毒剂时，为什么还要依赖马抗体呢？” 对于这项新研究，合著者包括国家自然科学中心主任埃尔达·桑切斯……

reflection.en: The natural world is a testament to Yahweh's intricate design and wisdom. In this case, the very creatures that possess dangerous venom also hold the key to its neutralization within their own biology. This discovery reminds us that by observing and understanding creation, we can uncover profound solutions and appreciate the Creator's ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 大自然是雅伟精妙设计和智慧的明证。在此案例中，拥有剧毒的生物本身也蕴藏着中和毒液的关键。这一发现提醒我们，通过观察和理解受造界，我们可以揭示深刻的解决方案，并欣赏创造者的奇思妙想。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Your personality may be more genetic than scientists realized
title.zh: 你的个性可能比科学家们意识到的更具遗传性

summary.en: A study has identified over 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits, suggesting a significant genetic link between personality and various life outcomes such as health, longevity, careers, and income. The research involved an international collaboration analyzing data from 46 cohorts...
summary.zh: 一项研究确定了与“大五”人格特质相关的1200多个基因变异，表明人格与健康、寿命、职业和收入等多种生活结果之间存在显著的遗传联系。该研究涉及一项国际合作，分析了来自全球46个研究队列的数据。

body.en:
An international team of scientists has identified more than 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits. The findings also suggest that many of the same genetic patterns connected to personality are related to a wide range of life outcomes, including health, longevity, education, careers, and income.

The study, led by the Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium, brought together data from 46 research cohorts around the world. Participants provided DNA samples and completed questionnaires designed to measure the Big Five personality traits: openness to experience, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism.

These traits describe relatively stable patterns in how people tend to think, feel, and behave. Researchers compared participants' genetic data with differences in their personality scores to identify genetic variants associated with each trait.

"There is no single 'personality gene,'" said Ted Schwaba, lead author of this study and faculty at MSU's Department of Psychology. "Personality traits are associated with many genetic variants, but even the largest effects of individual genetic variants are still very small. However, even though any individual genetic variant makes very little difference in personality, the effects of many variants together can be more sizeable."

Although the influence of any one genetic variant was tiny, the researchers found that their combined effects were more substantial and consistent. The genetic patterns also appeared to hold across very different groups of people.

For instance, variants associated with extraversion in a young adult living in the Netherlands could also help predict extraversion in an older retired adult in the United States. By using methods that compared relatives with one another, the team found evidence that these genetic associations could not simply be explained by growing up in the same environment.

Even so, genetics is only part of the picture. The findings also reinforced the important role that a person's environment plays in shaping personality.

The researchers found that genetic variants associated with personality overlap with genetic patterns connected to many other areas of life. These include mental and physical health, longevity, education, career choices and outcomes, as well as the way people are viewed by those close to them.

Some of the links involved everyday habits. Genetic variants associated with conscientiousness were also related to being more active during the daytime. Meanwhile, variants associated with openness to experience and extraversion were connected with a greater tendency to be a night owl.

The results also highlight how genetics and environment can interact with one another rather than operating...
body.zh: 一个国际科学家团队已鉴定出 1,200 多种与“大五人格”特征相关的基因变异。研究结果还表明，许多与性格相关的相同遗传模式与广泛的生活结果相关，包括健康、长寿、教育、职业和收入。 这项研究由复兴人格基因组学联盟 (Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium) 领导，汇集了来自全球 46 个研究队列的数据。参与者提供了 DNA 样本并完成了旨在衡量五大人格特征的调查问卷：开放性、责任心、外向性、宜人性和神经质。 这些特征描述了人们如何思考、感受和行为的相对稳定的模式。研究人员将参与者的遗传数据与他们的性格评分差异进行比较，以确定与每个特征相关的遗传变异。 “不存在单一的‘人格基因’，”这项研究的主要作者、密歇根州立大学心理学系的教员泰德·施瓦巴 (Ted Schwaba) 说。 “人格特征与许多遗传变异有关，但即使单个遗传变异的最大影响仍然很小。然而，即使任何单个遗传变异对人格的影响很小，但许多变异加在一起的影响可能会更大。” 尽管任何一种遗传变异的影响都很微小，但研究人员发现它们的综合影响更为实质性和一致。这些遗传模式似乎也适用于非常不同的人群。 例如，与生活在荷兰的年轻人的外向性相关的变异也可以帮助预测美国老年退休成年人的外向性。通过使用相互比较亲属的方法，研究小组发现证据表明这些遗传关联不能简单地用在同一环境中长大来解释。 即便如此，遗传学只是问题的一部分。研究结果还强调了一个人的环境在塑造人格方面所发挥的重要作用。 研究人员发现，与性格相关的遗传变异与与生活许多其他领域相关的遗传模式重叠。这些因素包括身心健康、寿命、教育、职业选择和结果，以及亲近的人看待人们的方式。 有些链接涉及日常习惯。与责任心相关的基因变异也与白天更加活跃有关。与此同时，与开放经验和外向性相关的变异与夜猫子的更大倾向有关。 结果还强调了遗传和环境如何相互作用而不是操作......

reflection.en: This research reveals a deep genetic connection to our personalities, suggesting that much of who we are is woven into our very being. It echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself, in its intricate design, speaks of the Creator's profound knowledge and the complex tapestry of human life.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了与我们个性深厚的遗传联系，表明我们很大程度上是被编织进我们自身的存在中的。它呼应了古老的智慧，即创造本身，以其错综复杂的设计，诉说着造物主深邃的知识和人类生命的复杂织锦。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Ozempic and Wegovy may have an unexpected mental health benefit
title.zh: 奥泽平与韦戈维可能带来意想不到的心理健康益处

summary.en: Semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, has been linked in a large Swedish study to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization among nearly 15,000 individuals with bipolar disorder. Researchers hypothesize that its effects on inflammation and biological pathways in the brain may contribute to...
summary.zh: 在奥泽平（Ozempic）和韦戈维（Wegovy）中发现的司美格鲁肽（Semaglutide）成分，在一项对近15,000名双相情感障碍患者的大型瑞典研究中，与精神科住院风险降低21%相关。研究人员推测，其对炎症和大脑生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，尽管其他GLP-1类药物未显示出相同的关联性。

body.en: Semaglutide, the drug behind Ozempic and Wegovy, may have benefits that extend well beyond weight loss and diabetes. In a large Swedish study of nearly 15,000 people with bipolar disorder, its use was linked to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization. Researchers think effects on inflammation and brain-related biological pathways could help stabilize mood, though other GLP-1 drugs did not show the same association.
body.zh: Ozempic 和 Wegovy 背后的药物索马鲁肽的益处可能远远超出减肥和糖尿病的范围。瑞典一项针对近 15,000 名双相情感障碍患者的大型研究显示，使用该药物可将精神病住院风险降低 21%。研究人员认为，对炎症和大脑相关生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，但其他 GLP-1 药物并未显示出相同的关联。

reflection.en: This news offers a glimmer of hope for individuals navigating the complexities of bipolar disorder. The potential for a medication, primarily known for weight management, to also contribute to mental stability and reduce psychiatric hospitalizations is a significant development. It reminds us that healing can come through unexpected avenues, and that...
reflection.zh: 这一消息为那些应对双相情感障碍复杂性的人们带来了一线希望。一种主要以体重管理而闻名的药物，竟然也能帮助稳定精神状态并减少精神科住院，这是一个重要的进展。它提醒我们，治愈可能来自意想不到的途径，并且持续的研究不断揭示支持心理健康的新方法。

verse.textEn: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verse.textZh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。

title.en: Giant new dinosaur discovered beneath construction site in Brazil
title.zh: 巴西建筑工地发现巨型新恐龙

summary.en: Scientists have identified a giant new dinosaur species in Brazil, named Dasosaurus tocantinensis, which lived approximately 120 million years ago and measured about 20 meters in length. Its fossils were unearthed during construction work, and its evolutionary connection to a Spanish dinosaur suggests ancient land...
summary.zh: 科学家在巴西发现了一种新的巨型恐龙物种，名为“托坎廷斯达氏恐龙”（Dasosaurus tocantinensis），生活在大约1.2亿年前，体长约20米。其化石是在建筑工地施工期间出土的，它与一种西班牙恐龙的进化联系表明，古老的陆桥促进了这些生物跨大陆的传播。

body.en:
A newly identified dinosaur species discovered during construction work in northeastern Brazil is offering fresh clues about how giant dinosaurs spread across ancient continents.

The species, named Dasosaurus tocantinensis , is described in a study published in the Journal of Systematic Palaeontology . The animal measured about 20 meters long and lived roughly 120 million years ago. Its fossils were found at the site of a road rail terminal under construction in Davinópolis, a city in the state of Maranhão.

One of the most striking aspects of the discovery is the dinosaur's evolutionary connection to Europe. Its closest known relative lived in what is now Spain, suggesting that these animals belonged to a broader lineage that once occupied regions that are now separated by the Atlantic Ocean.

Researchers propose that the ancestors of Dasosaurus tocantinensis reached South America by moving through North Africa sometime between 140 and 120 million years ago. At the time, these landmasses were still connected within the supercontinent Gondwana.

"It's the largest known dinosaur for Maranhão, which has other species, but not sauropods like this one; rather, it has smaller ones, such as the diplodocid Amazonsaurus maranhensis , which was about 10 meters long," says Elver Luiz Mayer, a professor at the Federal University of the São Francisco Valley (UNIVASF) in the state of Bahia.

Mayer normally studies mammals from the Quaternary period, which is far more recent than the age of the dinosaur fossils. He became involved with the find in 2021 while working in São Félix do Xingu in the state of Pará, where he was then a professor at the Federal University of Southern and Southeastern Pará (UNIFESSPA)

The fossils had been uncovered by archaeologists who were monitoring the Davinópolis construction project as part of environmental licensing requirements. At first, the remains were thought to belong to large prehistoric mammals that may have lived alongside ancient humans.

"Given its depth of about eight meters, I realized that it was much older. The age of the geological formation was already known from previous research and indicated that it was material from the transition from the Lower to the Upper Cretaceous, about 120 million years ago," says Mayer. He then contacted various specialists and formed a multidisciplinary group to study the specimen.

The fossils went through an extensive preparation process before being analyzed in Pará. Afterward, the specimen was returned to Maranhão. It is now kept in São Luís, the state capital, at the State Center for Natural History and Archaeology Research, which also took part in the research.

The preserved skeleton...
body.zh: 在巴西东北部的建筑工程中发现的一种新发现的恐龙物种为巨型恐龙如何在古代大陆上传播提供了新的线索。 《系统古生物学杂志》上发表的一项研究描述了该物种，名为 Dasosaurus tocantinensis。这种动物身长约 20 米，生活在大约 1.2 亿年前。它的化石是在马拉尼昂州达维诺波利斯市正在建设的公路铁路终点站现场发现的。 这一发现最引人注目的方面之一是恐龙与欧洲的进化联系。它的已知近亲生活在现在的西班牙，这表明这些动物属于一个更广泛的谱系，这个谱系曾经占据了现在被大西洋隔开的地区。 研究人员推测，托坎蒂大索龙的祖先在 140 至 1.2 亿年前的某个时间穿过北非到达南美洲。当时，这些大陆在冈瓦纳超大陆内仍然是相连的。 巴伊亚州圣弗朗西斯科河谷联邦大学 (UNIVASF) 教授埃尔弗·路易斯·梅耶尔 (Elver Luiz Mayer) 表示：“它是马拉尼昂州已知最大的恐龙，马拉尼昂州还有其他物种，但没有像这样的蜥脚类恐龙；相反，它有较小的恐龙，例如梁龙科亚马逊龙 maranhensis，长约 10 米。” 梅耶尔通常研究第四纪时期的哺乳动物，该时期比恐龙化石的时代要晚得多。 2021 年，他在帕拉州圣费利克斯杜辛古 (São Félix do Xingu) 工作时参与了这一发现，当时他是帕拉州南和东南联邦大学 (UNIFESSPA) 的教授 这些化石是由考古学家发现的，他们正在监测达维诺波利斯建设项目，作为环境许可要求的一部分。起初，这些遗骸被认为属于大型史前哺乳动物，它们可能与古人类生活在一起。 “考虑到它的深度约为八米，我意识到它的年龄要大得多。从之前的研究中已经知道了地质构造的年龄，并表明它是大约 1.2 亿年前从下白垩纪到上白垩纪过渡的物质，”梅耶尔说。然后，他联系了多位专家，组建了一个多学科小组来研究该标本。 这些化石在帕拉州进行分析之前经过了广泛的准备过程。随后，标本被送回马拉尼昂州。它现在保存在州首府圣路易斯的国家自然历史和考古研究中心，该中心也参与了这项研究。 保存完好的骨架...

reflection.en: The discovery of Dasosaurus tocantinensis, unearthed by chance during construction, reminds us that the earth holds many secrets, waiting to be revealed through diligent study. Job 12:7-9 speaks of asking the animals and birds, the fish and the earth, for wisdom, for all of them teach us. This new dinosaur, bridging continents through ancient land...
reflection.zh: 在建筑施工中偶然发现的托坎廷斯达氏恐龙，提醒我们大地隐藏着许多秘密，等待着通过勤奋的研究被揭示。约伯记12:7-9说，你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们也会告诉你。这些古老陆桥连接的跨大陆恐龙，证明了当我们观察和学习创造时，可以揭示生命的复杂历史。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists observe Einstein’s gravity in the quantum world for the first time
title.zh: 科学家首次在量子世界中观测到爱因斯坦的引力

summary.en: Physicists have directly observed a long-predicted quantum effect of gravity, confirming a key aspect of Einstein's theory of gravity under quantum conditions. The experiment involved splitting an atom's quantum wave, with one part held stationary and the other falling freely.
summary.zh: 物理学家首次直接观测到了引力的一个长期预测的量子效应，在量子条件下对爱因斯坦引力理论的一个关键方面进行了验证。该实验涉及将一个原子的量子波一分为二，一部分保持静止，另一部分自由下落。

body.en:
An international team that includes Nobel Prize-winning physicist Professor Sir Roger Penrose has directly observed a long-predicted gravitational effect in a falling quantum object for the first time. The finding shows that a central principle of Einstein's theory of gravity continues to agree with quantum behavior under the conditions tested. The research, led by Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, the University of Ulm and the University of Oxford, was published September 2 in Science Advances .

Modern physics rests on two remarkably successful frameworks. Quantum mechanics describes the unusual behavior of atoms and other extremely small objects, while Einstein's theory of gravity explains falling bodies and the large-scale structure of the Universe. Despite their individual success, physicists still do not have a complete theory that brings the two together.

The new experiment explores a region where these two descriptions overlap. Researchers measured a specific change in the quantum properties of atoms as they moved under the influence of gravity. The effect matched the prediction that follows when Einstein's equivalence principle, one of the foundations of his theory of gravity, is extended to a quantum object.

The equivalence principle says that gravity should effectively vanish locally for an observer in free fall. A person falling freely in a lift, for example, would experience weightlessness. The principle has been confirmed with extraordinary precision using ordinary matter, but testing it directly with quantum objects has been much more difficult because quantum objects can behave like waves and can effectively follow more than one path at the same time.

To make such a test possible, the team built an instrument called the Quantum Galileo Interferometer. The device allowed the researchers to split the quantum wave associated with an atom into two separate paths. One part could be kept in place while the other was allowed to fall freely. The two were then brought back together so the researchers could determine how gravity had affected the falling wave.

The experiment was carried out at Ben-Gurion University using clouds of rubidium atoms cooled to temperatures just above absolute zero. The atoms were manipulated near the surface of a specially designed atom chip.

The experimental team, including PhD student Or Dobkowski, began by using microwave pulses to place the ultracold atoms into a quantum superposition. This effectively allowed each atom to follow two paths at once.

Tiny electrical wires built into the chip then generated carefully controlled magnetic fields. One part of the atomic wave interacted with the magnetic field, allowing the researchers to create an upward force that precisely balanced the downward pull of...
body.zh: 包括诺贝尔奖获得者物理学家教授罗杰·彭罗斯爵士在内的国际团队首次直接观察到了下落量子物体中长期预测的引力效应。这一发现表明，爱因斯坦引力理论的核心原理在测试条件下仍然与量子行为一致。这项研究由内盖夫本古里安大学、乌尔姆大学和牛津大学领导，于 9 月 2 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上。 现代物理学依赖于两个非常成功的框架。量子力学描述了原子和其他极小物体的异常行为，而爱因斯坦的引力理论则解释了下落物体和宇宙的大尺度结构。尽管物理学家取得了个人的成功，但他们仍然没有一个完整的理论将两者结合在一起。 新实验探索了这两种描述重叠的区域。研究人员测量了原子在重力影响下移动时量子特性的特定变化。这一效应与爱因斯坦引力理论的基础之一——等效原理扩展到量子物体时所做出的预测相符。 等效原理表明，对于自由落体的观察者来说，重力应该有效地局部消失。例如，一个人在电梯里自由落体时会体验到失重的感觉。这一原理已通过普通物质以极高的精度得到证实，但直接用量子物体对其进行测试要困难得多，因为量子物体的行为可以像波一样，并且可以有效地同时遵循多个路径。 为了使这样的测试成为可能，该团队建造了一种称为量子伽利略干涉仪的仪器。该设备允许研究人员将与原子相关的量子波分成两个独立的路径。一部分可以固定在适当的位置，而另一部分则可以自由落下。然后将两者重新放在一起，以便研究人员能够确定重力如何影响下落的波浪。 该实验是在本古里安大学进行的，使用冷却至略高于绝对零温度的铷原子云。原子在专门设计的原子芯片表面附近被操纵。 包括博士生 Or Dobkowski 在内的实验团队首先使用微波脉冲将超冷原子置于量子叠加态。这有效地允许每个原子同时遵循两条路径。 芯片内置的微小电线会产生精心控制的磁场。原子波的一部分与磁场相互作用，使研究人员能够产生一种向上的力，精确地平衡向下的拉力……

reflection.en: The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh, and the deep things of creation reveal His wisdom. This experiment, observing gravity's quantum effects, is a testament to the intricate order of the universe that scientists continue to uncover. It reminds us that even in the smallest, most complex realms, the Creator's handiwork is evident, inviting awe and further...
reflection.zh: 诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，创造的深奥之处彰显祂的智慧。这项观测引力量子效应的实验，证明了宇宙精妙的秩序，科学家们正不断揭示它。这提醒我们，即使在最小、最复杂的领域，造物主的作为也是显而易见的，引人惊叹并进一步探索。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: How meteorologists recreated weather that helped decide second world war
title.zh: 气象学家如何重现了决定第二次世界大战的天气

summary.en: Meteorologists assisted in recreating weather scenes for the film 'Pressure,' which dramatizes the critical period leading up to the D-day landings in June 1944. The film focuses on the true story of meteorologist Gp Capt James Stagg, who had to advise General Eisenhower on the suitability of weather conditions for...
summary.zh: 气象学家协助重现了电影《压力》中的天气场景，该片描绘了1944年6月诺曼底登陆前夕的关键时期。电影聚焦于气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格（James Stagg）的真实故事，他必须就天气条件是否适合入侵向艾森豪威尔将军提供建议，而一场迫近的风暴使这一决定变得复杂。

body.en: Experts helped guide weather scenes in Pressure – a film depicting dramatic buildup to 1944’s D-day landings Dressed in a Royal Air Force uniform and sporting a trim moustache, Andrew Scott looks slightly queasy – as well he might. Behind him is a huge map of the Channel, and in front of him is Brendan Fraser, looming with a request: “I need a forecast,” he says. Starring in the film Pressure, based on a true story, Scott plays the meteorologist Gp Capt James Stagg – the man who must tell Gen Eisenhower – played by Fraser – whether conditions will be suitable for the D-day landings scheduled to take place on 5 June 1944. But a large storm is approaching the Normandy coast. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们帮助指导了《压力》中的天气场景——这部影片描绘了 1944 年诺曼底登陆的戏剧性场面。安德鲁·斯科特穿着皇家空军制服，留着整齐的小胡子，看起来有点恶心——他可能也有这种感觉。他身后是一张巨大的英吉利海峡地图，面前是布伦丹·弗雷泽 (Brendan Fraser)，他若隐若现地提出请求：“我需要天气预报，”他说。在根据真实故事改编的电影《压力》中，斯科特饰演气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格上尉，他必须告诉弗雷泽饰演的艾森豪威尔将军，条件是否适合计划于 1944 年 6 月 5 日进行的诺曼底登陆。但是一场大风暴正在逼近诺曼底海岸。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story of the D-day landings hinges on a critical forecast, a moment where human knowledge met the unpredictable forces of nature. In the face of immense pressure and uncertainty, the need for wisdom was paramount. James 1:5 reminds us that when faced with such weighty decisions, we can ask Yahweh for the discernment needed to navigate complex...
reflection.zh: 诺曼底登陆的故事围绕着一次关键的天气预报展开，那是人类知识与不可预测的自然力量交汇的时刻。面对巨大的压力和不确定性，智慧的需求至关重要。雅各书1:5提醒我们，当面对如此重大的决定时，我们可以向雅伟祈求所需的洞察力，以应对复杂的情况。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: Site investigated over medical waste dumping claims
title.zh: 一处地点因涉嫌非法倾倒医疗废物而受到调查

summary.en: The Environment Agency is investigating a site near Wadborough, Worcestershire, following claims that medical waste was illegally dumped and spread using farm equipment. The land is adjacent to Great Blaythorn Meadow, a Site of Special Scientific Interest.
summary.zh: 在有指控称医疗废物被非法倾倒并使用农用设备散播之后，环境署正在调查伍斯特郡瓦德伯勒附近的一处地点。该地块毗邻被列为特殊科学价值保护区的格雷特·布莱瑟恩草甸。

body.en:
Land that borders a protected nature site is being investigated over claims it is being used as an illegal site to dump medical waste.

The Environment Agency (EA) said it was investigating the site off Mill Lane, near Wadborough, in Worcestershire. The land is near Great Blaythorn Meadow, which is a Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI).

A resident in the area, who asked not to be named, told the BBC a muck spreader, which are normally used to distribute farmyard manure, had been used to spread medical waste.

The EA said it was investigating alongside West Mercia Police, Wychavon District Council and Worcestershire County Council.

An EA spokesperson said: "Waste crime scars communities and the environment and, in line with our 10-point plan, we're acting quickly to tackle illegal activity."

The resident said they were concerned by how close the site was in relation to Great Blaythorn Meadow, which Natural England lists as an SSSI. , external

Natural England considers the land special for its biological interest, specifically wanting to protect its rare lowland meadow and grassland habitat.

The resident claimed "local residents of Wadborough and Drakes Broughton had identified some of the spread waste as medical in origin" and "estimated that 300 tonnes of contaminated waste has been spread on the field".

However, the EA has not confirmed the nature of the waste or how much waste has been dumped.

Photos said to be taken at the scene show small scraps of metal and plastic scattered across the area which is under investigation.

In December 2025, the BBC revealed a site off Mill Lane was under investigation for illegal waste dumping .

At the time, it became the third site in Worcestershire being investigated for illegal waste dumping.

The EA said it was "pulling every lever available" to "disrupt those who profit from the harm illegal waste sites cause".

Follow BBC Hereford & Worcester on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external .
body.zh: 与自然保护区接壤的土地正在接受调查，因为据称该土地被用作倾倒医疗废物的非法场所。 环境局（EA）表示正在调查伍斯特郡沃德伯勒附近米尔巷附近的现场。该土地靠近大布莱索恩草甸 (Great Blaythorn Meadow)，该草甸是一个具有特殊科学价值 (SSSI) 的地点。 该地区一位不愿透露姓名的居民告诉英国广播公司，一台通常用于分发农家肥的撒粪机已被用来撒播医疗废物。 EA 表示正在与西麦西亚警方、Wychavon 地区议会和伍斯特郡议会一起进行调查。 EA 发言人表示：“废物犯罪给社区和环境带来了创伤，根据我们的 10 点计划，我们正在迅速采取行动打击非法活动。” 该居民表示，他们对该地点与 Great Blaythorn Meadow 的距离有多近感到担忧，而 Great Blaythorn Meadow 被《自然英格兰》列为 SSSI。 , 外部 自然英格兰认为这片土地因其生物利益而特殊，特别希望保护其稀有的低地草甸和草原栖息地。 该居民声称，“沃德伯勒和德雷克斯布劳顿的当地居民已确定一些散布的废物是医用废物”，并“估计现场散布了 300 吨受污染的废物”。 然而，环境署尚未确认废物的性质或倾倒了多少废物。 据称在现场拍摄的照片显示，正在调查的区域散布着细小的金属和塑料碎片。 2025 年 12 月，BBC 透露米尔巷附近的一处地点因非法倾倒废物而正在接受调查。 当时，它成为伍斯特郡第三个因非法倾倒垃圾而受到调查的地点。 EA 表示，它正在“动用一切可用的手段”来“扰乱那些从非法垃圾场造成的危害中获利的人”。 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Hereford & Worcester。

reflection.en: The report of medical waste being improperly handled raises concerns about accountability and the health of the environment. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh, reminding us that our stewardship of creation and our treatment of communities are matters of deep spiritual significance. May this investigation bring clarity...
reflection.zh: 关于医疗废物处理不当的报道，引发了对问责制和环境健康的担忧。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，提醒我们，我们对受造界的管理和对社区的对待，都是具有深远属灵意义的事情。 愿此次调查带来清晰，并确保责任人受到追究，从而保护自然界和附近居民的福祉。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Shetland spaceport project secures £30m of UK government investment
title.zh: 萨克萨沃德太空港项目获得英国政府3000万英镑投资

summary.en: The UK government has announced an investment of £30 million in the SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland, which will be used to construct two additional launchpads. This funding is part of a new national space strategy and is expected to unlock further private investment.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布向设在设得兰群岛的萨克萨沃德太空港投资3000万英镑，这笔资金将用于建造另外两个发射台。这项投资是国家太空战略的一部分，预计还将吸引更多的私人投资。

body.en:
The UK government has announced investment of £30m in SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland as part of a new national space strategy.

A spaceport spokesperson said the funding was a "hugely significant" vote of confidence and would unlock a further £30m of private investment.

Several companies hope to use SaxaVord in Unst, the northernmost point in the UK, as a launch site for small commercial rockets.

A government spokesperson said space was "an increasingly important domain" for keeping the country safe.

SaxaVord is the UK's first fully-licensed spaceport and has regulatory approval for up to 30 rocket launches a year.

The company said the £60m public-private investment package would be used to design and build a second hangar and two more launchpads.

Chief executive officer Scott Hammond said the funding would take the company to the next stage of its development.

"We are building the spaceport for the thousandth as much as the first launch," he said.

"We're trying to create a successful, safe and sustainable business. This is direct investment into Shetland."

Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) is working towards its first vertical orbital test flight from UK soil. In August, SaxaVord paused plans for a test launch after RFA said it had "encountered an issue".

A five-week "launch window" had been due to begin, with temporary traffic restrictions introduced in the event of a flight attempt.

A second company, HyImpulse Technologies GmbH (HyImpulse), plans the second flight of its SR75 suborbital launch vehicle from Shetland this year.

Derek Harris, head of programmes at Space Scotland, said he was not concerned about the timescale of the launch, adding that the £30m investment was a "good starter".

"The technology is difficult to master but you would prefer it to be there and be reliable so if the timescale slips into next year, I do not see that as a failure," he told BBC Radio Scotland Breakfast .

"I see that as a very well-maintained programme to make sure health and safety and reliability are at the forefront."

Harris said rain and storms could also impact the process and it was important to remain open minded.

He added: "It will take time and a lot of money but once it launches, the benefits it unlocks for Scotland and the UK will be amazing."

SaxaVord Spaceport has confirmed that it is in discussions with other companies.
