The UK government said the new space strategy would "drive growth, strengthen security and back the technologies that underpin modern life".

Ministers said they wanted to create jobs and help Britain and its partners launch satellites without relying on countries "further afield".

The money for the Shetland project is part of a £148m investment across Europe which ministers said would help UK space technology firms...
body.zh: 英国政府宣布向设得兰群岛的 SaxaVord 太空港投资 3000 万英镑，作为新国家太空战略的一部分。 太空港发言人表示，这笔资金是一次“意义重大”的信任投票，将进一步释放 3000 万英镑的私人投资。 多家公司希望利用位于英国最北端安斯特的 SaxaVord 作为小型商业火箭的发射场。 一位政府发言人表示，太空对于维护国家安全来说是“一个日益重要的领域”。 SaxaVord 是英国第一个获得完全许可的太空港，并获得监管部门批准，每年最多可进行 30 次火箭发射。 该公司表示，6000万英镑的公私投资计划将用于设计和建造第二个机库和另外两个发射台。 首席执行官斯科特·哈蒙德表示，这笔资金将带领公司进入下一发展阶段。 他说：“我们正在建造太空港，这与第一次发射的次数一样多。” “我们正在努力创建一个成功、安全和可持续的企业。这是对设得兰群岛的直接投资。” 奥格斯堡火箭工厂（RFA）正在努力从英国本土进行首次垂直轨道试飞。 8 月，在 RFA 表示“遇到问题”后，SaxaVord 暂停了测试发射计划。 为期五周的“发射窗口”原定开始，在尝试飞行时会实施临时交通限制。 第二家公司 HyImpulse Technologies GmbH (HyImpulse) 计划今年从设得兰群岛进行第二次 SR75 亚轨道运载火箭飞行。 SaxaVord Spaceport 已证实正在与其他公司进行讨论。 英国政府表示，新的太空战略将“推动增长、加强安全并支持支撑现代生活的技术”。 部长们表示，他们希望创造就业机会并帮助英国及其合作伙伴发射卫星，而不依赖“更远的”国家。 设得兰群岛项目的资金是整个欧洲 1.48 亿英镑投资的一部分，部长们表示，该投资将帮助英国太空技术公司获得更多工作。 苏格兰大臣道格拉斯·亚历山大 (Douglas Alexander) 表示：“苏格兰建造的卫星数量已经超过欧洲其他任何地方，在英国政府 3000 万英镑的投资推动下，SaxaVord 现在准备提供欧洲大陆多达四分之三的轨道发射位。” 他补充说，国防、安全和经济增长是该计划的核心。 Heartland 通过其投资部门 Wild Ventures 持有 SaxaVord Spaceport 的多数股权，其首席执行官 Lise Kaae 表示：“我们非常高兴欢迎英国政府作为投资者和合作伙伴。”

reflection.en: This significant investment in the SaxaVord Spaceport represents a bold step into the future of commercial spaceflight. As this ambitious project moves forward, may its leaders commit their endeavors to Yahweh, seeking His guidance and blessing for success and for the responsible development of this new frontier. May their work be a testament to human...
reflection.zh: 这项对萨克萨沃德太空港的巨额投资，标志着商业航天领域迈出了大胆的一步。随着这个雄心勃勃的项目向前推进，愿其领导者将他们的事业托付给雅伟，寻求祂的指引和祝福，以期取得成功并负责任地开发这一新领域。愿他们的工作成为人类智慧在神圣智慧引导下的明证。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Are rich people really worse behaved? Here’s the science – podcast
title.zh: 富人真的行为更差吗？科学是这么说的——播客

summary.en: Research suggests that wealthy individuals are more prone to unethical behavior, such as stealing sweets from children. This finding, which won an Ig Nobel prize, prompts reflection on the relationship between wealth and morality, with scientists exploring potential underlying reasons for this phenomenon.
summary.zh: 研究表明，富裕人士更容易做出不道德行为，例如偷窃儿童的糖果。这项获得搞笑诺贝尔奖的研究促使人们反思财富与道德之间的关系，科学家们正在探索这种现象背后可能的原因。

body.en: Who’s more likely to steal sweets from a child? According to science, it’s the rich. A study seemingly confirming our suspicions about the moral behaviour of the wealthy was one of the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, which honour research that makes you laugh and then think. Science editor Ian Sample tells Madeleine Finlay what the researchers think could be behind the phenomenon, and they explore some of the other awards, including one for a surprising quality we look for in our friends and another for a biomechanical definition of kissing Rich people more likely to steal children’s sweets, finds Ig Nobel prize-winning study Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 谁更有可能偷孩子的糖果？根据科学，这是有钱人。一项似乎证实了我们对富人道德行为的怀疑的研究成为 2026 年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获得者之一，该奖项旨在表彰那些让你开怀大笑并引发思考的研究。科学编辑伊恩·萨普告诉玛德琳·芬利，研究人员认为这一现象背后可能存在什么，他们还探讨了其他一些奖项，其中一个奖项是为了我们在朋友身上寻找的令人惊讶的品质，另一个奖项是为了亲吻的生物力学定义，搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究发现有钱人更有可能偷孩子的糖果支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: This Ig Nobel prize-winning study humorously highlights a potential disconnect between wealth and ethical conduct, suggesting that affluence might correlate with a greater willingness to transgress. It prompts us to consider the societal implications of such findings and the importance of justice and mercy in all walks of life, regardless of economic status.
reflection.zh: 这项搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究以幽默的方式揭示了财富与道德行为之间可能存在的脱节，暗示富裕可能与更强的越轨意愿相关。它促使我们思考此类发现的社会影响，以及无论经济地位如何，在所有生活领域中公正和怜悯的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘This is dangerous’: slime moulds and the bitter debate over the nature of intelligence
title.zh: “这很危险”：黏菌与关于智能本质的激烈辩论

summary.en: Scientists are debating whether simple organisms like slime molds should be considered intelligent, a discussion that could fundamentally alter our perception of the natural world and humanity's place within it. This debate has been ongoing for decades, stemming from observations of slime molds that challenge...
summary.zh: 科学家们正在争论像黏菌这样的简单生物是否应被视为“智能”，这场辩论可能会重塑我们对自然世界的理解以及我们在其中的位置。这场争论已持续数十年，源于对黏菌的观察，这些观察挑战了对智能的传统定义。

body.en: Scientists are battling over whether supposedly simple organisms should be considered ‘intelligent’. The outcome could reshape our understanding of the natural world – and our own place within it Forty years ago, as an undergraduate in Hokkaido, Toshiyuki Nakagaki came upon a lemon-yellow stain in a petri dish. That encounter turned him into a doyen of slime mould research – and fed a storm of biological and philosophical debate about the meanings of life and intelligence that persists to this day. Before, no one would have called a slime mould “intelligent”; the popular adjective, in fact, was “simple”. “A simple mass of protoplasm,” one 1895 description ran; “among the most simple of organisms”, said another. And it was hard to argue otherwise. A slime mould can appear to be just a small cell, capable only of feeding and reproducing. Simple is as simple does. Of that first meeting, Nakagaki said: “I was just impressed with how fast it moved.” Physarum polycephalum , the slime mould species in that petri dish, has a top speed of 1cm an hour. For amoebic organisms, that’s gold-medal standard. At first glance, Physarum seems to spread as irregularly as ink on blotting paper, but in fact it senses its meals of bacteria or other microbes and reaches for them with a long, thin finger of protoplasm – which not only digests its food but then forages further or pulls back into the rest of the mould. It’s impossible to watch a slime mould over many days without sensing some deliberation at play. Continue reading...
body.zh: 科学家们正在争论所谓的简单有机体是否应该被视为“智能”。这一结果可能会重塑我们对自然世界以及我们自己在其中的地位的理解。 四十年前，作为北海道的一名本科生，Toshiyuki Nakagaki 在培养皿中发现了柠檬黄色的污渍。那次遭遇使他成为粘菌研究的元老，并引发了一场关于生命和智力意义的生物学和哲学争论，这场争论一直持续到今天。以前，没有人会称粘菌为“智能”；现在，它已经成为一种智能。事实上，流行的形容词是“简单”。 1895 年的一篇描述写道：“一团简单的原生质”； “是最简单的生物体之一”，另一个人说。很难反驳其他观点。粘菌看起来只是一个小细胞，只能进食和繁殖。简单就是简单。谈到第一次会面，中垣说：“会议进展之快给我留下了深刻的印象。”多头绒泡菌 (Physarum polycephalum) 是该培养皿中的粘菌种类，其最高速度为每小时 1 厘米。对于阿米巴生物来说，这是金牌标准。乍一看，绒泡菌似乎像吸墨纸上的墨水一样不规则地传播，但事实上，它感知到了细菌或其他微生物的食物，并用细长的原生质手指触碰它们——它不仅消化了它的食物，还进一步觅食或拉回霉菌的其余部分。观察粘菌很多天，你不可能不感受到其中的深思熟虑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ongoing scientific debate about the intelligence of slime molds invites us to consider the profound wisdom embedded within creation itself. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or the fish in the sea, and they will explain to you.' (Job...
reflection.zh: 关于黏菌智能的科学争论，邀请我们思考造物本身所蕴含的深刻智慧。正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教训你；飞鸟，也可告诉你；或与地说话，地也必指教你；海中的鱼，也必向你说明。”（约伯记 12:7-8）。这次探索提醒我们，雅伟精妙的设计即使在最简单的生命形式中也得以展现，只要我们愿意观察和学习，就能从中获得教诲。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Author Correction: Contrasting roles of histone 3 lysine 27 demethylases in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia
title.zh: 作者勘误：组蛋白3赖氨酸27去甲基化酶在急性淋巴细胞白血病中的对比作用

summary.en: An author correction is published for a study in Nature concerning the contrasting roles of histone 3 lysine 27 demethylases in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, with the publication details provided.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志发表了关于组蛋白3赖氨酸27去甲基化酶在急性淋巴细胞白血病中对比作用的研究的作者勘误，并提供了出版详情。

reflection.en: Scientific research, like the correction published here, is a testament to humanity's capacity to observe and understand the intricate systems of creation. Through careful study and revision, we gain deeper insights into the complex mechanisms of life, reflecting the wisdom inherent in the natural world. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and they will...
reflection.zh: 科学研究，如同此处发表的勘误，证明了人类观察和理解生命复杂系统的能力。通过细致的研究和修正，我们对生命复杂的机制有了更深入的认识，这反映了自然界固有的智慧。 正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教导你；飞鸟，也可告诉你；或与地说话，地就必指教你；海中的鱼，也必向你说明。”这种对知识的不懈追求，即使是通过修正，也揭示了所有生命中深刻的秩序和设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Put patients at the centre of medical AI governance
title.zh: 将患者置于医疗人工智能治理的中心

summary.en: An editorial in Nature argues for centering patients in the governance of artificial intelligence (AI) within healthcare, emphasizing the need for ethical frameworks that prioritize human well-being and rights as AI becomes more integrated into medical practices.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志的一篇社论主张在医疗保健领域的人工智能（AI）治理中以患者为中心，强调随着人工智能越来越多地融入医疗实践，需要制定符合伦理的框架来优先考虑人类的福祉和权利。

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence advances into complex fields like healthcare, the question of what constitutes 'intelligence' and 'personhood' becomes increasingly relevant. Genesis 1:27 reminds us that humanity is uniquely created in the image of God, a foundational truth that should guide our development and governance of powerful technologies like AI,...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能在医疗保健等复杂领域不断发展，关于“智能”和“人格”的定义问题变得越来越重要。创世记 1:27 提醒我们，人类是按照雅伟的形象独特创造的，这一根本真理应该指导我们开发和治理像人工智能这样强大的技术，确保它们服务于人类尊严，而不是削弱它。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Nepal disaster is a wake-up call to take compound climate risks seriously
title.zh: 尼泊尔灾难敲响警钟：认真对待复合气候风险

summary.en: A recent disaster in Nepal, exacerbated by compound climate risks, serves as a stark warning that the interconnected and cascading effects of climate change demand serious attention and proactive measures.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔最近发生的一场灾难，由于复合气候风险的加剧，敲响了严峻的警钟，表明气候变化的相互关联和连锁效应需要认真对待和积极应对。

reflection.en: The report from Nepal speaks to a world groaning under the weight of climate change, a reality echoed in Romans 8:22. Creation itself, in its intricate systems, cries out under the strain of human impact and escalating disasters. May we heed these warnings and work towards healing and restoration, recognizing our deep connection to the earth and its future.
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔的报道，呼应了罗马书8章22节中“万物都在一同叹息，一同疼痛，直到如今”的景象。受人类活动和日益加剧的灾难所累，受造界本身正在承受重负而发出呻吟。愿我们警醒，并致力于修复与重建，认识到我们与大地及其未来的深层联系。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Sideline vested interests to reform China’s research
title.zh: 排除既得利益，改革中国科研

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02797-7 Sideline vested interests to reform China’s research
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，2026年9月8日在线发表；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02797-7 排除既得利益，改革中国科研

reflection.en: Scientific research, as highlighted in this Nature editorial, is a noble pursuit. The quest to understand the world around us, to uncover its secrets, and to push the boundaries of knowledge is a testament to human curiosity and ingenuity. This pursuit is not merely about accumulating facts, but about the inherent glory and dignity found in discovery...
reflection.zh: 正如《自然》杂志的这篇社论所强调的，科学研究是一项崇高的事业。探索我们周围的世界，揭开它的奥秘，并拓展知识的边界，是人类好奇心和创造力的证明。这种追求不仅仅是积累事实，更是关于发现本身固有的荣耀和尊严，反映了一种等待被理解的神圣秩序。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
title.zh: 在预测市场上对临床试验结果下注受限

summary.en: The use of prediction markets to bet on the outcomes of clinical trials is becoming more common, but concerns are being raised about the potential for these markets to influence or be influenced by the trials themselves.
summary.zh: 利用预测市场对临床试验结果下注的做法日益普遍，但人们对这些市场可能影响或被试验本身影响的潜在风险表示担忧。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology and data analysis, as seen in the use of prediction markets for clinical trials, reflects a world where knowledge is indeed increasing. As Daniel prophesied, 'many will run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This surge in information and predictive power calls us to seek wisdom and discernment, ensuring our...
reflection.zh: 正如但以理所预言的，“必有多人来往奔走，知识就必增长”。科技和数据分析的飞速发展，例如在临床试验中使用预测市场，正体现了知识的快速增长。这种信息和预测能力的激增，要求我们寻求智慧和分辨力，确保我们对知识的追求能够服务于人类的福祉和道德的完整性。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Cravings ‘like heroin withdrawal’: what happens when weight-loss drugs don’t work?
title.zh: 减肥药不起作用时，渴望‘像海洛因戒断’：会发生什么？

summary.en: GLP-1 medications have been a gamechanger in the fight against obesity. But for a minority of patients, their impact is negligible. Why? When Mercedes was told by her doctor that she could be prescribed GLP-1 weight loss jabs in 2024, she broke down. “[When] she said yes, I cried in her office. And I didn’t really...
summary.zh: GLP-1药物在抗击肥胖方面取得了革命性的进展。但对少数患者来说，它们的影响微乎其微。为什么呢？当梅赛德斯在2024年被医生告知可以给她开GLP-1减肥针剂时，她崩溃了。“当她说可以时，我在她办公室里哭了。我整整一周都没停止哭泣，”她说。“终于，在我一生都超重之后，这将拯救我。我的挣扎、我的负担、我的羞耻感终于要结束了...

body.en: GLP-1 medications have been a gamechanger in the fight against obesity. But for a minority of patients, their impact is negligible. Why? When Mercedes was told by her doctor that she could be prescribed GLP-1 weight loss jabs in 2024, she broke down. “[When] she said yes, I cried in her office. And I didn’t really stop crying for a week,” she said. “Finally, after being overweight my entire life, this was going to save me. My struggle, my burden, my shame was finally going to come to an end.” Continue reading...
body.zh: GLP-1 药物已成为对抗肥胖的游戏规则改变者。但对于少数患者来说，其影响可以忽略不计。为什么？当梅赛德斯的医生告诉她可以在 2024 年接受 GLP-1 减肥注射时，她崩溃了。 “当她答应的时候，我在她的办公室里哭了。整整一周我都没有真正停止哭泣，”她说。 “最后，在我一生都超重之后，这将拯救我。我的挣扎、我的负担、我的耻辱终于要结束了。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: For some, the promise of weight-loss medication brings immense hope, a potential end to a lifelong struggle with shame and burden. When these treatments prove ineffective, the disappointment can be crushing, leading to deep emotional distress. In these moments, the psalmist's plea to his soul, 'Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me?',...
reflection.zh: 对一些人来说，减肥药物的承诺带来了巨大的希望，可能结束他们一生与羞耻和负担的斗争。当这些治疗无效时，失望可能是毁灭性的，导致深切的情感痛苦。在这些时刻，诗篇作者对他灵魂的呼求‘我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？’，与对抗绝望的深刻内心挣扎产生了共鸣。

verse.textEn: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
verse.textZh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神，因我还要称赞他。他是我脸上的光荣，是我的神。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Meta continues to run ads promoting child sexual abuse material in India - report
title.zh: Meta 报告继续在印度推广儿童性虐待材料

summary.en: A report by the Tech Transparency Project found that Meta ran hundreds of paid advertisements featuring AI-generated child sexual abuse imagery on Facebook and Instagram over the past 10 months, with a significant number appearing in India, despite a government order to remove such content.
summary.zh: 根据华盛顿特区的 Tech Transparency Project（TTP）的报告，Meta 在过去 10 个月内，在 Facebook 和 Instagram 上投放了数百个包含人工智能生成的儿童性虐待图像的付费广告，其中相当一部分出现在印度。尽管印度政府已下令删除此类内容，但该问题依然存在。

body.en:
Meta ran hundreds of paid ads with artificial intelligence-generated child sexual abuse imagery, including several in India, over the past 10 months, a new report by US-based campaigners has found.

The report comes two months after the Indian government ordered Meta to remove all ads and content promoting child sexual abuse material (CSAM) on Instagram. This was in the aftermath of a BBC Eye investigation which found that Instagram was running paid adverts promoting CSAM in India.

Washington-based Tech Transparency Project (TTP) , external says it found 332 adverts with CSAM that ran on Facebook and Instagram, the majority of them (274) in August this year.

When the BBC wrote to Meta about these findings, they said in a statement, "We don't tolerate nudify apps or any kind of child exploitation, whether real or AI-generated. These criminals constantly shift tactics to evade detection, which is why we keep strengthening our detection and enforcement."

The TTP report, published on Tuesday, says that it identified several photos of real children, including a member of a European royal family, that were used in the ads and then manipulated using AI. It says more than a dozen ads appeared on Meta platforms even after TTP made the company aware of its findings.

About a quarter (84) of the ads ran in India and 78 of these were published after the Indian government's order on removing CSAM and its meeting with senior Meta officials.

After the BBC investigation, several Indian agencies including the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights and the National Human Rights Commission have said they are examining the matter.

The distribution of CSAM is a criminal offence in India, while Meta's policy states that ads must not contain content that sexually exploits or endangers children.

When the BBC contacted Meta about its investigation, it said that when it becomes aware of apparent child exploitation, it reports it to the US-based National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) in compliance with its legal obligations.

The NCMEC is the centralised global reporting system for the online sexual exploitation of children.

But Bhuwan Ribhu, the founder of Just Rights for Children, a network of more than 250 organisations working to prevent violence against children in India, says this is not enough.

Just Rights for Children has filed a petition in India's Supreme Court, citing the BBC's findings, and asked for directions to social media platforms for mandatory reporting and identification of those promoting child sexual abuse material

"Social media companies are clearly flouting Indian laws by not reporting child sexual abuse content to Indian law enforcement agencies as mandated by our child protection laws," said Ribhu.

The TTP, a...
body.zh: 美国活动人士的一份新报告发现，在过去 10 个月里，Meta 投放了数百个带有人工智能生成的儿童性虐待图像的付费广告，其中包括在印度的几个广告。 该报告发布两个月前，印度政府命令 Meta 删除 Instagram 上所有宣传儿童性虐待内容 (CSAM) 的广告和内容。这是在 BBC Eye 调查发现 Instagram 在印度投放推广 CSAM 的付费广告之后发生的。 总部位于华盛顿的技术透明度项目 (TTP) 外部表示，它发现 Facebook 和 Instagram 上投放了 332 个 CSAM 广告，其中大多数（274 个）是在今年 8 月发布的。 当 BBC 就这些发现写信给 Meta 时，他们在一份声明中表示，“我们不会容忍裸体应用程序或任何形式的儿童剥削，无论是真实的还是人工智能生成的。这些犯罪分子不断改变策略来逃避检测，这就是我们不断加强检测和执法的原因。” TTP 周二发布的报告称，它发现了广告中使用的几张真实儿童的照片，其中包括一名欧洲王室成员，然后使用人工智能进行了处理。据称，即使在 TTP 让公司了解其调查结果后，Meta 平台上仍出现了十多个广告。 大约四分之一 (84) 条广告在印度投放，其中 78 条是在印度政府下令删除 CSAM 并与 Meta 高级官员会面后发布的。 英国广播公司(BBC)调查后，包括国家保护儿童权利委员会和国家人权委员会在内的多个印度机构表示，他们正在调查此事。 在印度传播 CSAM 属于刑事犯罪，而 Meta 的政策规定，广告不得包含性剥削或危害儿童的内容。 当BBC就其调查联系Meta时，它表示，当发现明显的儿童剥削行为时，它会根据其法律义务向位于美国的国家失踪和受虐儿童中心（NCMEC）报告。 NCMEC 是针对儿童在线性剥削的集中式全球报告系统。 但“儿童正义权利”（Just Rights for Children）的创始人布万·里布（Bhuwan Ribhu）表示，这还不够。该组织由 250 多个致力于防止印度儿童遭受暴力的组织组成。 儿童正义组织已向印度最高法院提交请愿书，援引英国广播公司的调查结果，并要求社交媒体平台强制报告和识别那些宣扬儿童性虐待内容的人 里布说：“社交媒体公司没有按照儿童保护法的规定向印度执法机构报告儿童性虐待内容，这显然是对印度法律的蔑视。” TTP，一个...

reflection.en: It is deeply disturbing that paid advertisements promoting child sexual abuse material continue to appear on Meta's platforms, especially in India. This highlights a profound failure to protect the most vulnerable. We must advocate for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring their safety and dignity are paramount.
reflection.zh: 令人深感不安的是，推广儿童性虐待材料的付费广告仍在 Meta 的平台上出现，尤其是在印度。这凸显了在保护最弱势群体方面存在的严重失职。我们必须为那些无法为自己发声的人发声，确保他们的安全和尊严至关重要。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Should promotion depend on how workers use AI?
title.zh: 人工智能的使用是否应取决于员工的表现？

summary.en: More companies are tying career progression to AI use: is that fair? Duncan Trevithick, who works in marketing for an AI training data company, questions whether using AI to increase his output, which then becomes the new baseline, is truly beneficial when the financial rewards do not match the increased productivity.
summary.zh: 越来越多的公司将职业发展与人工智能的使用挂钩：这公平吗？在一家人工智能训练数据公司从事市场营销工作的邓肯·特里维西克（Duncan Trevithick）质疑，当他使用人工智能提高工作产出，而这产出又成为新的基准时，这是否真的有益，因为经济回报与生产力的提高并不匹配。

body.en:
It's in Duncan Trevithick's interest to be good at using AI at work - if he can use it to get more tasks done, faster, he'll qualify for a bonus at the end of the year.

On the surface, it's a great incentive. But he's questioning what's really in it for him.

"The uncomfortable interpretation is that employees are being assessed on how effectively they can participate in their own redundancy," says Spain-based Trevithick, 34, who works in marketing for an AI training data company.

But if he uses AI to take care of two days worth of work each week, he says the financial rewards don't add up.

"I do not receive two days off or a 40% pay rise. The higher output simply becomes the new baseline. In the short term, that may help me get promoted. In the longer term, I have helped prove how much of my job no longer requires me," he says.

"I'm just trying to view myself as a manager, and I'm managing some people, and I'm also managing AI agents, or AI loops, or whatever you want to call it."

Using employees' AI abilities as a measure of whether they should get a bonus, promoted - or even sacked - is fast becoming more common.

Accenture CEO Julie Sweet told the Rapid Response podcast in March: "Today, AI at Accenture is how we do work. So if you want to get promoted, you've got to do the things that we do in order to operate at Accenture."

And big names like Disney, Meta, JP Morgan and KPMG have introduced "AI leaderboards" to track and rank employees' usage of the array of LLMs and platforms at their disposal, according to media reports , external . Crypto trading platform Coinbase has already fired engineers who didn't complete AI training, as requested by the chief executive, Brian Armstrong , external .

It demonstrates how eager business leaders are to see a return from their AI investments, especially when 94% of companies have yet to see significant value from AI, according to a report , external by consultants McKinsey.

Employees feel they have to get on board, thanks to the current state of the jobs market - in the UK, vacancies have hit a five-year low .

Meanwhile, 75% of the 1,881 UK jobseekers polled in July by recruiter Gi Group say they would not be put off applying to an organisation that had introduced AI proficiency into individual performance reviews. Around 22% said it would be off-putting.

"It's like being in the sea and you see a giant wave coming. You can get out a surfboard and try and ride it as long as possible, or you can just let it take you under. But you can't stop the wave," says Trevithick.

But what's going on at the large consultancy Pamela (her name has been changed to protect her identity) works for isn't sitting right with her.

She's a US-based senior executive who has observed that, while there isn't a formal...
body.zh: 邓肯·特雷维西克 (Duncan Trevithick) 的兴趣在于善于在工作中使用人工智能 - 如果他能够利用它更快地完成更多任务，他将有资格在年底获得奖金。 从表面上看，这是一个很大的激励。但他质疑这对他来说到底有什么好处。 34 岁的西班牙特雷维希克 (Trevithick) 在一家人工智能培训数据公司从事营销工作，他表示：“令人不安的解释是，正在评估员工参与裁员的有效性。” 但他表示，如果他每周使用人工智能来处理两天的工作，那么经济回报就不会增加。 “我没有休息两天，也没有加薪 40%。更高的产出只是成为新的基准。在短期内，这可能会帮助我升职。从长远来看，我已经帮助证明了我的工作有多少不再需要我了，”他说。 “我只是想把自己视为一名经理，我正在管理一些人，我也在管理人工智能代理，或者人工智能循环，或者任何你想称之为的东西。” 使用员工的人工智能能力来衡量他们是否应该获得奖金、晋升甚至解雇，正迅速变得越来越普遍。 埃森哲首席执行官朱莉·斯威特 (Julie Sweet) 在 3 月份的快速反应播客节目中表示：“如今，埃森哲的人工智能就是我们的工作方式。因此，如果你想升职，你就必须做我们为在埃森哲运营而做的事情。” 据外部媒体报道，迪士尼、Meta、摩根大通和毕马威等大牌公司推出了“人工智能排行榜”，以跟踪和排名员工对一系列法学硕士和平台的使用情况。加密货币交易平台 Coinbase 已按照首席执行官布莱恩·阿姆斯特朗 (Brian Armstrong) 的要求，解雇了未完成人工智能培训的工程师（外部）。 咨询公司麦肯锡对外发布的一份报告显示，这表明企业领导者多么渴望从人工智能投资中获得回报，尤其是在 94% 的公司尚未看到人工智能的巨大价值的情况下。 由于目前的就业市场状况，员工们觉得他们必须加入——在英国，职位空缺已创五年来新低。 与此同时，招聘机构 Gi Group 7 月份对 1,881 名英国求职者进行了调查，其中 75% 的人表示，如果组织将人工智能熟练程度引入个人绩效评估，他们不会推迟申请。大约 22% 的人表示这会令人反感。 “这就像在海里，你看到巨浪袭来。你可以拿出冲浪板，尝试尽可能长时间地滑行，或者你也可以让它把你带入水中。但你无法阻止波浪，”特雷维希克说。 但帕梅拉（她的名字已被更改以保护她的身份）工作的大型咨询公司所发生的事情却让她感到不舒服。 她是一位驻美国的高级管理人员，她观察到，虽然没有正式的……

reflection.en: The story of Duncan Trevithick raises questions about how we integrate powerful new tools like AI into our work lives. The narrative echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition and technological prowess outstripped wisdom, leading to confusion. As we harness AI for greater efficiency, we must ask if our ultimate goal is simply more output, or if...
reflection.zh: 邓肯·特里维西克的故事引发了关于如何将人工智能等强大新工具融入我们工作生活的疑问。这个故事呼应了古老的巴别塔故事，其中人类的野心和技术实力超越了智慧，导致了混乱。当我们利用人工智能提高效率时，我们必须扪心自问，我们最终的目标仅仅是更多的产出，还是人类的繁荣和利益的公正分配。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: LG TV shown scanning LAN for third-party phones and other devices
title.zh: LG电视被曝扫描局域网以查找第三方手机和其他设备

summary.en: LG TVs are under scrutiny following a video that appears to show their ability to track users even when the TVs are off. Researchers and security experts analyzed LG TVs, including the G5 OLED model, and found evidence of them scanning local networks for other devices like smartphones and smartwatches, some belonging...
summary.zh: LG电视因一段视频显示其在关闭状态下仍能追踪用户而受到审查。研究人员和安全专家分析了包括LG G5 OLED在内的LG电视，发现它们会扫描本地网络以查找其他设备，如智能手机和智能手表，其中一些设备属于不知情的员工。

body.en: LG TVs are facing scrutiny due to a video seemingly showing the devices’ capability to track users when the TVs are off. YouTube channel Gamers Nexus worked with Level1Techs, a technology-focused YouTube channel, and security researchers to analyze LG TVs’ tracking capabilities. They shared packet captures that pointed to the TVs, including LG’s pricey G5 OLED TV, scanning the LAN for other devices. “The [G5] crawled our entire network and found dozens of unrelated devices, including smartwatches and phones of our staff who didn't even know we were working on this,” Steve Burke, Gamers Nexus' editor-in-chief, said. Read full article Comments
body.zh: LG 电视正面临审查，因为一段视频似乎显示该设备能够在电视关闭时跟踪用户。 YouTube 频道 Gamers Nexus 与专注于技术的 YouTube 频道 Level1Techs 以及安全研究人员合作，分析 LG 电视的跟踪功能。他们分享了指向电视（包括 LG 昂贵的 G5 OLED 电视）的数据包捕获，扫描 LAN 中是否有其他设备。 “[G5] 爬行了我们的整个网络，发现了数十个不相关的设备，包括我们员工的智能手表和手机，他们甚至不知道我们正在做这件事，”Gamers Nexus 的主编 Steve Burke 说。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen with LG TVs scanning networks, brings both convenience and concern. Daniel's prophecy speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times. As our ability to connect and gather information grows, so does the responsibility to use this knowledge ethically and with respect for privacy.
reflection.zh: LG电视扫描网络的事件，反映出科技的飞速发展既带来便利也引发担忧。但以理书预言末世知识必增长。随着我们连接和收集信息的能力不断增强，我们更有责任以合乎道德的方式并尊重隐私来运用这些知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: OpenAI claims to have solved maths problem that stumped humans for decades
title.zh: OpenAI 声称已解决困扰人类数十年的数学难题

summary.en: OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, announced it has solved the Navier-Stokes problem, a significant mathematical challenge that has perplexed humans for nearly a century. The company utilized 10,000 of its AI systems, which reportedly cracked the problem in 88 hours after millions of dollars in investment.
summary.zh: ChatGPT 的开发公司 OpenAI 宣布，他们已经解决了困扰人类近一个世纪的重大数学难题——纳维-斯托克斯方程。该公司动用了 10,000 个其人工智能系统，据称在投入数百万美元后，仅用 88 小时就攻克了该问题。

body.en: Company behind ChatGPT says 10,000 of its AI systems cracked the Navier-Stokes problem in 88 hours OpenAI claims to have solved a major mathematics problem that has stumped humans for nearly a century after spending millions of dollars on the artificial intelligence-led endeavour. The company behind ChatGPT said it had cracked the Navier-Stokes problem, one of seven Millennium Prize Problems published by the Clay Mathematics Institute to highlight some of the biggest unsolved puzzles in the field. Continue reading...
body.zh: ChatGPT 背后的公司表示，其 10,000 个人工智能系统在 88 小时内破解了纳维-斯托克斯问题。 OpenAI 声称在花费数百万美元进行人工智能主导的努力后，已经解决了一个困扰人类近一个世纪的重大数学问题。 ChatGPT 背后的公司表示，它已经破解了纳维-斯托克斯问题，这是克莱数学研究所发布的七个千年奖问题之一，旨在强调该领域一些最大的未解决难题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in OpenAI's claimed solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, mirrors the biblical observation that "many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase" (Daniel 12:4). This era of accelerating discovery calls us to pursue not just knowledge, but also the wisdom to use it for good.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如 OpenAI 所声称的解决了纳维-斯托克斯方程一样，呼应了《圣经》中“必有多人来往奔走，知识也必增长”（但以理 12:4）的预言。这个加速发现的时代，呼唤我们不仅追求知识，更要追求运用知识行善的智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: GOG brings back "big box" PC games, one printable template at a time
title.zh: GOG 以一种可打印模板的方式，重现了“大盒装”PC游戏

summary.en: Preservation "goodies" also includes downloadable 3D models for desktop perusal.
summary.zh: 保存的“好东西”还包括可供桌面欣赏的下载式 3D 模型。

body.en: Those who remember PC gaming in the days before Steam may have fond memories of the "big box" packaging that made those games stand out as shelf eye candy and sought-after in-home collectibles . Today, PC gaming platform GOG is hoping to reignite some of the nostalgia for those days by adding downloadable 3D models and printable, foldable high-res packaging scans for a handful of PC games on the platform. Thus far, the "Printable Big Box" collection on GOG is limited to just five games: Armikrog , Descent , Hitman: Codename 47 , Myst , and Star Trek: 25th Anniversary . Players browsing those games on the GOG store will now see "3D Boxes" listed among the included "Goodies" before purchase. Owners of those games on GOG can download a ZIP file containing a version of the box art as an animated 3D object file (in an easy-to-open GLB format ) and a "flat printable template" in PDF, SVG, and Adobe Illustrator formats. Those downloads allow for what GOG calls "a proper papercraft project for anyone who misses shelves full of PC game boxes." The 3D model animates to show the front flap opening. Credit: GOG "Physical media doesn’t survive the way software can—boxes get lost, crushed, thrown out," GOG writes in today's announcement . "Scanning them, and letting you print your own, is preservation in a different shape: the same mission that keeps these games running on modern PCs, applied to the objects they used to come in." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 那些还记得 Steam 出现之前的 PC 游戏的人可能对“大盒子”包装有着美好的回忆，正是这种包装使这些游戏成为货架上的抢手货和抢手的家庭收藏品。如今，PC 游戏平台 GOG 希望通过为平台上的少数 PC 游戏添加可下载的 3D 模型和可打印、可折叠的高分辨率包装扫描，重新点燃人们对那些日子的怀旧之情。到目前为止，GOG 上的“Printable Big Box”合集仅限于五款游戏：《Armikrog》、《Descent》、《Hitman: Codename 47》、《Myst》和《Star Trek: 25th Anniversary》。现在，在 GOG 商店浏览这些游戏的玩家在购买前将看到“3D Boxes”列在包含的“好东西”中。 GOG 上这些游戏的所有者可以下载一个 ZIP 文件，其中包含作为动画 3D 对象文件（易于打开的 GLB 格式）的盒装艺术版本以及 PDF、SVG 和 Adob​​e Illustrator 格式的“平面可打印模板”。这些下载可以实现 GOG 所说的“对于那些错过货架上摆满 PC 游戏盒的人来说，这是一个合适的纸艺项目”。 3D 模型以动画方式显示前翻盖开口。图片来源：GOG “物理媒体无法像软件那样生存——盒子会丢失、被压碎、被扔掉，”GOG 在今天的公告中写道。 “扫描它们并让你打印自己的，是以不同的形式保存：使这些游戏在现代 PC 上运行的相同使命，应用于它们曾经使用的对象。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In an age dominated by digital downloads, GOG's initiative to offer printable "big box" game packaging taps into a deep appreciation for tangible history. It reminds us that even in the digital realm, there is value in craftsmanship and the careful preservation of what once was, allowing us to "do everything for Yahweh's glory."
reflection.zh: 在数字下载占主导的时代，GOG 提供可打印的“大盒装”游戏包装的举措，触及了对有形历史的深刻欣赏。它提醒我们，即使在数字领域，工艺和对往昔事物的精心保存也具有价值，使我们能够“凡事都为雅伟的荣耀而行”。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Why this month's Microsoft patch release is a doozy
title.zh: 为何本月微软补丁发布如此棘手

summary.en: Security experts are rushing to release patches ahead of an anticipated surge in AI-powered attacks.
summary.zh: 安全专家正争先恐后地发布补丁，以应对预期中人工智能驱动的攻击浪潮。

body.en: Microsoft’s patch for September is a doozy, with a record number of roughly 972 vulnerabilities fixed and 112 of them meeting the high critical-severity threshold. It was only two months ago that Microsoft patched a then-record 570 vulnerabilities. Then, last month, Microsoft patched some 620 of them. Google and other companies have also published record numbers of vulnerabilities in recent months. Two weeks ago, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Web Services, Google, Microsoft, and 100 companies and organizations published an open letter warning of a narrowing window for patching vulnerabilities ahead of an expected tsunami of AI-enabled attacks that actively exploit them first. The industry is taking the threat seriously by pumping out unprecedented numbers of patches in their software. Welcome to the new normal Dustin Childs, a researcher at the Zero Day Initiative, calls the spikes the “new normal” and also cautions that despite them, the damage that’s likely to result from AI-assisted attacks could eventually be substantial. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 微软 9 月份的补丁非常出色，修复了大约 972 个漏洞，创历史新高，其中 112 个漏洞达到了高危阈值。仅仅两个月前，微软就修复了当时创纪录的 570 个漏洞。然后，上个月，微软修复了其中约 620 个补丁。近几个月来，谷歌和其他公司也发布了创纪录数量的漏洞。两周前，OpenAI、Anthropic、亚马逊网络服务、谷歌、微软以及 100 家公司和组织发布了一封公开信，警告在预计首先主动利用这些漏洞的人工智能攻击海啸之前，修补漏洞的窗口正在缩小。该行业正在认真对待这一威胁，在其软件中发布了数量空前的补丁。欢迎来到新常态“零日计划”的研究员达斯汀·柴尔兹（Dustin Childs）将这种峰值称为“新常态”，并警告说，尽管如此，人工智能辅助攻击可能造成的损害最终可能是巨大的。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid pace of technological advancement, particularly in AI, presents both opportunities and challenges. As Microsoft releases a record number of security patches, it underscores the escalating complexity of the digital landscape. This era of increasing knowledge, as described in Daniel, calls for wisdom and diligence in navigating its potential...
reflection.zh: 技术进步的快速步伐，尤其是在人工智能领域，既带来了机遇也带来了挑战。微软发布创纪录数量的安全补丁，凸显了数字环境日益增长的复杂性。正如但以理书所描述的这个知识日益增长的时代，要求我们在驾驭其潜在陷阱时，要充满智慧和勤勉。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: OpenAI says it cracked 90-year-old maths problem in 88 hours
title.zh: OpenAI称其在88小时内解决了90年前的数学难题

summary.en: OpenAI claims to have solved parts of the Navier-Stokes equations using a new AI model and thousands of AI bots, a feat that has sparked controversy.
summary.zh: OpenAI声称使用新的人工智能模型和数千个AI机器人解决了纳维-斯托克斯方程的部分问题，这一壮举引发了争议。

body.en:
OpenAI says it has found a solution to a decades-old advanced maths problem in a matter of hours using a new artificial intelligence (AI) model and thousands of AI bots.

The ChatGPT-maker said on Tuesday , external that by focusing a group of roughly 10,000 AI agents, or AI bots that undertake tasks somewhat autonomously, it solved a notoriously difficult maths problem in just 88 hours.

The problem was part of the Navier-Stokes equations , external , which concern how fluids move. For 90 years important aspects of the problems have lacked a proof, the argument underlying a correct math equation.

OpenAI called the solution which it found a "milestone" and evidence that AI tools are improving quickly.

OpenAI's solution has yet to be verified independently or publicly accepted by The Clay Mathematics Institute, a maths organization based in the US which runs the Millennium Prize that offers big money to the first to solve certain mathematical conundrums.

The company said that at the end of August, it started to train a new model that quickly showed that it was adept at maths. AI models are computer programs trained on huge amounts of data to recognize and predict patterns in information.

While the new OpenAI model remains a tool only used within the company, as it is "significantly more capable" than the company's most recent AI model release, its researchers decided to use it on certain notable advanced maths problems.

OpenAI admitted that last week on 1 September, it had "heard rumors that two Millennium Prize problems had been resolved" and so decided to put thousands of AI bots trained on the new internal model to work attempting to solve some of the remaining problems.

By Sept 5, or roughly 88 hours after it had set 10,000 AI bots to the task, OpenAI had found a solution to what's referred to as the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem.

The problem is at the heart of turbulence, which is a phenomenon that is still not well understood.

Although it took the AI bots seemingly little time to reach a solution, OpenAI said the bots exchanged nearly 3 million messages and used up 130 billion output tokens, or the individual lines of text and code an AI model produces in answers, on Navier–Stokes alone.

Such an effort would have cost roughly $10m (£7.3m), based on OpenAI's own pricing , external for output from its most advanced models.

The solution that OpenAI says it has now reached for the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem resolved two out of the four statements in the proof that the Millennium Prize had demanded. The prize is worth $1m to a winner.

"Our goal in releasing this result is to report on the substantial progress of our AI models", OpenAI said on Tuesday. "We do not intend to claim the Millennium Prize for...
body.zh: OpenAI 表示，它使用新的人工智能 (AI) 模型和数千个人工智能机器人，在几个小时内找到了解决数十年历史的高级数学问题的解决方案。 ChatGPT 制造商周二对外表示，通过集中大约 10,000 个人工智能代理（或在一定程度上自主执行任务的人工智能机器人）组成的团队，它在短短 88 小时内解决了一个众所周知的困难数学问题。 该问题是纳维-斯托克斯外部方程的一部分，该方程涉及流体如何运动。 90 年来，这些问题的重要方面一直缺乏证据，缺乏正确数学方程背后的论证。 OpenAI 称其找到的解决方案是一个“里程碑”，并且有证据表明人工智能工具正在快速改进。 OpenAI 的解决方案尚未经过克莱数学研究所的独立验证或公开接受。克莱数学研究所是一家总部位于美国的数学组织，负责颁发千年奖，为第一个解决某些数学难题的人提供巨额奖金。 该公司表示，8 月底开始训练一个新模型，该模型很快就显示出它擅长数学。人工智能模型是经过大量数据训练的计算机程序，用于识别和预测信息模式。 虽然新的 OpenAI 模型仍然是仅在公司内部使用的工具，但由于它比公司最新发布的 AI 模型“能力更强”，但其研究人员决定将其用于某些值得注意的高级数学问题。 OpenAI 承认，上周即 9 月 1 日，它“听到传言称两个千年奖问题已得到解决”，因此决定让数千个接受新内部模型训练的人工智能机器人尝试解决一些剩余问题。 到 9 月 5 日，也就是在设置 10,000 个人工智能机器人执行任务大约 88 小时后，OpenAI 找到了解决所谓的纳维-斯托克斯存在性和平滑性问题的方法。 问题在于湍流的核心，而湍流这一现象目前还没有得到很好的理解。 尽管人工智能机器人似乎只花了很短的时间就找到了解决方案，但 OpenAI 表示，仅在 Navier-Stokes 上，机器人就交换了近 300 万条消息，并消耗了 1300 亿个输出令牌，即人工智能模型在答案中生成的单独文本和代码行。 根据 OpenAI 自己的定价，以及其最先进模型的外部输出，这样的努力将花费大约 1000 万美元（730 万英镑）。 OpenAI 表示，它现在已经达成的纳维-斯托克斯存在性和平滑性问题的解决方案解决了千禧年奖所要求的证明中四个陈述中的两个。获胜者的奖金价值 100 万美元。 OpenAI 周二表示：“我们发布这一结果的目的是报告我们人工智能模型的实质性进展。” “我们不打算因为……而获得千年奖。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as demonstrated by OpenAI's claim of solving a complex mathematical problem in hours, reflects a world where knowledge and understanding are indeed increasing at an unprecedented rate. This technological leap prompts us to consider the purpose and wisdom behind such advancements, ensuring they serve humanity...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如OpenAI声称在数小时内解决了一个复杂的数学问题所展示的那样，反映了一个知识和理解以前所未有的速度增长的世界。这一技术飞跃促使我们思考这些进步背后的目的和智慧，确保它们能很好地服务于人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The universal language of space is... Star Trek? Mais oui.
title.zh: 太空的通用语言是……星际迷航？是的。

summary.en: Sixty years after its debut, the science fiction franchise Star Trek continues to inspire, with an astronaut aboard the International Space Station honoring the series by wearing a character's badge in a video released by the European Space Agency and Paramount.
summary.zh: 在首播六十年后，科幻系列《星际迷航》继续激励人心。欧洲航天局和派拉蒙公司发布的一段视频显示，国际空间站上的一名宇航员佩戴该剧角色的徽章以示敬意。

body.en: Sixty years after television audiences first tuned in to see the voyages of the Starship Enterprise , an astronaut on board the International Space Station has paid tribute to Star Trek by flying the badge of the franchise's latest fictional captain. Expedition 75 flight engineer Sophie Adenot with European Space Agency (ESA) donned the Delta badge originally worn by actor Anson Mount for a video recorded from aboard the space station. Mount portrays Christoper Pike in the Paramount+ streaming series Star Trek: Strange New Worlds . Paramount and ESA both released the clip on their Instagram feeds. "For 60 years, Star Trek has brought us stories of friendship and exploration. I'm wearing Captain Pike's badge aboard the ISS in celebration of continuing the real world work of science and exploration," said Adenot. "For me, exploration and science are about curiosity and cooperation daring to go a little farther together, learning from what we discover and build, and turning that knowledge into a better future for everyone." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 电视观众首次收看企业号星舰的航行六十年后，国际空间站上的一名宇航员悬挂了《星际迷航》系列最新虚构船长的徽章，向《星际迷航》致敬。欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的 Expedition 75 飞行工程师索菲·阿德诺 (Sophie Adenot) 佩戴了最初由演员安森·芒特 (Anson Mount) 在空间站录制视频时佩戴的达美徽章。芒特在派拉蒙+流媒体剧集《星际迷航：奇异新世界》中饰演克里斯托弗·派克。派拉蒙和欧空局都在他们的 Instagram 上发布了这段视频。 “60 年来，《星际迷航》为我们带来了友谊和探索的故事。我在国际空间站上佩戴派克船长的徽章，以庆祝继续现实世界的科学和探索工作，”阿德诺特说。 “对我来说，探索和科学意味着好奇心和合作，敢于一起走得更远，从我们发现和建造的东西中学习，并将这些知识转化为每个人更美好的未来。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The vastness of space, a realm of scientific endeavor and profound mystery, often sparks our imagination. It is fitting that even amidst the cutting edge of human achievement, like an astronaut aboard the ISS, we find echoes of stories that explore friendship and discovery. These narratives, like Psalm 8:4, remind us to ponder the significance of humanity...
reflection.zh: 浩瀚的太空，一个充满科学探索和深刻奥秘的领域，常常激发我们的想象力。即使在人类成就的最前沿，比如国际空间站上的宇航员，我们也发现那些探索友谊和发现的故事的回响，这是恰如其分的。《诗篇》8篇4节的经文提醒我们，要在宏伟的设计中思考人类的意义。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: NIH to use part of its budget to pay for Department of Defense research
title.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院将部分预算用于支付国防部研究费用

summary.en: The National Institutes of Health (NIH) has reached an agreement to use a portion of its budget to fund research at the Department of Defense, including projects that the current NIH leadership has explicitly rejected.
summary.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）已达成一项协议，将使用其部分预算来资助国防部的研究项目，其中包括NIH现任领导层明确反对的项目。

body.en: Late last week, word started leaking that the National Institutes of Health (NIH) had reached an agreement with the Department of Defense that would see part of the NIH's budget used to fund research at the Department of Defense. So, on the Friday just prior to a US holiday weekend, the Department of Defense released a copy of the agreement and confirmed that it had been signed roughly a month earlier. The move is striking for a number of reasons, ranging from the existing budget disparities between the two parties involved to the fact that the money would be used for projects that the current NIH leadership has explicitly rejected. The agreement itself sets up a system where the NIH would transfer money to the Department of Defense to fund staff and projects that would "support the advanced development of medical countermeasures against pandemic influenza, chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) threats, and emerging infectious diseases." The money would come out of the budget for the NIH's National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, or NIAID, to which Congress has allocated $6.6 billion in 2026. The agreement is set to run for a decade. Left unspecified is just how much of the NIAID budget will be spent on Defense projects. Reporting by Nature suggests that the Department of Defense was looking for up to a third of its total budget but was being told to settle for about 10 percent. There's obviously an enormous disparity between the budgets of these two agencies, given that the 2026 Defense budget is roughly $1 trillion. That budget is under considerable strain, however, due to the open-ended nature of the conflict with Iran. The deal has also been announced at a time when the NIH has been struggling to issue sufficient grants to use the money that Congress allocated to it. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 上周晚些时候，有消息称美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 已与国防部达成协议，美国国立卫生研究院的部分预算将用于资助国防部的研究。因此，在美国假期周末前的周五，国防部发布了该协议的副本，并确认该协议是在大约一个月前签署的。此举引人注目的原因有很多，包括涉及两方之间现有的预算差异，以及这笔资金将用于当前 NIH 领导层明确拒绝的项目。该协议本身建立了一个系统，美国国立卫生研究院将向国防部转移资金，以资助工作人员和项目，“支持针对大流行性流感、化学、生物、放射性和核（CBRN）威胁以及新出现的传染病的医疗对策的高级开发”。这笔资金将来自 NIH 国家过敏和传染病研究所 (NIAID) 的预算，国会已在 2026 年向该研究所拨款 66 亿美元。该协议预计将持续 10 年。未具体说明 NIAID 预算中有多少将用于国防项目。 《自然》杂志的报道显示，国防部正在寻求高达其总预算三分之一的资金，但被告知只能满足 10% 左右。鉴于 2026 年国防预算约为 1 万亿美元，这两个机构的预算显然存在巨大差异。然而，由于与伊朗的冲突没有结束的性质，该预算面临着相当大的压力。该交易也是在美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）一直在努力发放足够的拨款来使用国会分配给它的资金之际宣布的。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The NIH's decision to fund research it previously rejected, using its own budget for the Department of Defense, raises questions about institutional priorities and the potential for unchecked ambition. Genesis 11 describes a similar moment where humanity's unified, ambitious project at Babel led to confusion and division, a cautionary tale about the limits...
reflection.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）决定使用其预算资助其先前拒绝的研究项目，并将其资金用于国防部，这引发了关于机构优先事项和不受约束的野心的潜在问题的思考。创世记11章描述了类似的一刻，当时人类在巴别塔的统一而宏伟的项目导致了混乱和分裂，这是一个关于当人类的努力脱离神圣智慧时的局限性的警示故事。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Tech Life
title.zh: 骗子以虚假版权声明向Instagram用户索要钱财

summary.en: Scammers are demanding money from Instagram users by falsely claiming copyright infringement. This international extortion scheme only stops when the demanded payment is made.
summary.zh: 骗子以虚假的版权侵权指控为由，向Instagram用户索要钱财。这种国际敲诈计划只有在支付赎金后才会停止。

body.en: Lots of people make a living from social media posts. But some have been targeted by an international extortion scheme. It involves a flood of false copyright infringement claims. It only stops if the extorter is paid. Imran Rahman-Jones has the story. Also this week: could AI help to spot wrong-way driving on Ireland's major roads? And we bring you the latest titles and tech on show at Gamescom in Germany. Presenter: Chris Vallance Producer: Tom Quinn (Image: Silhouettes of mobile phone users are seen next to a screen projection of Instagram's logo. Credit: Reuters)
body.zh: 许多人靠社交媒体帖子谋生。但有些人已成为国际敲诈勒索计划的目标。它涉及大量虚假版权侵权索赔。只有当勒索者得到报酬后，这种行为才会停止。伊姆兰·拉赫曼·琼斯讲述了这个故事。同样在本周：人工智能能否帮助发现爱尔兰主要道路上的逆向驾驶？我们为您带来德国科隆游戏展上展示的最新游戏和技术。主持人：Chris Vallance 制片人：Tom Quinn（图片：Instagram 徽标的屏幕投影旁边可以看到手机用户的剪影。图片来源：路透社）

reflection.en: The digital world, while connecting us, can also become a hunting ground for those driven by greed. The love of money, as scripture warns, can indeed lead to schemes that harm others, even across international borders. May we be vigilant against such deception and pray for those who exploit others for financial gain.
reflection.zh: 数字世界在连接我们的同时，也可能成为贪婪之徒的猎场。正如经文所警告的，对金钱的爱确实会导致伤害他人的阴谋，甚至跨越国界。愿我们警惕此类欺骗，并为那些为谋取私利而剥削他人者祈祷。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Supreme Court forces TV stations to sell more election ads at steep discounts
title.zh: 最高法院强制电视台以大幅折扣出售更多选举广告

summary.en: A Supreme Court ruling requires broadcast TV stations to offer their lowest advertising rates to political parties and joint fundraising committees. This decision came in response to a petition from Republican campaign committees and will affect ad pricing during the 60-day pre-election period when broadcasters are...
summary.zh: 最高法院的一项裁决强制要求广播电视台以最低广告费率向政党和联合筹款委员会出售广告。这项裁决是应共和党竞选委员会的请愿而作出的，并将影响在选举前 60 天内广播公司依法必须向个别候选人提供折扣的广告定价。

body.en: In a victory for Republican campaign committees, the Supreme Court issued an order on Friday that forces broadcast TV stations to cut the prices of election ads purchased by political parties and joint fundraising committees. The September 4 ruling came in response to a petition filed by the National Republican Congressional Committee and National Republican Senatorial Committee. The Supreme Court order was issued just in time for the start of a 60-day period before the election, in which broadcasters are required by US law to offer ad discounts to individual candidates. Because of the top court's order, TV stations must also give their lowest ad rates to political parties and joint fundraising committees, which face fewer limits on how much money they can raise and spend. The legally required discount is known as the “lowest unit charge,” or LUC. A US law that applies to any licensed station that airs election ads requires that the lowest price be charged for “the use of any broadcasting station by any person who is a legally qualified candidate for any public office in connection with his campaign.” The main legal question is whether “use… by” a candidate can refer to ad time purchased on a candidate’s behalf by parties and joint fundraising committees. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 最高法院周五发布命令，迫使广播电视台降低政党和联合筹款委员会购买的选举广告价格，这是共和党竞选委员会的胜利。 9 月 4 日的裁决是对全国共和党国会委员会和全国共和党参议院委员会提交的请愿书的回应。最高法院的命令是在选举前 60 天的期限开始时及时发布的，美国法律要求广播公司向个别候选人提供广告折扣。根据最高法院的命令，电视台还必须向政党和联合筹款委员会提供最低的广告费，这些机构在筹集和支出资金方面面临的限制较少。法律要求的折扣被称为“最低单位费用”或 LUC。适用于任何播放选举广告的持牌电台的美国法律要求，“任何具有合法资格的任何公职候选人在其竞选活动中使用任何广播电台”均须收取最低价格。主要的法律问题是“候选人使用……”是否可以指政党和联合筹款委员会代表候选人购买的广告时间。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The Supreme Court's decision to mandate discounted ad rates for political parties highlights the complex interplay between law, commerce, and political campaigning. This ruling, favoring specific political groups, raises questions about equitable access to public discourse and the role of media in elections. It calls us to consider how systems can be shaped...
reflection.zh: 最高法院决定强制政党以折扣价购买广告，这凸显了法律、商业和政治竞选之间复杂的相互作用。这项有利于特定政治团体的裁决，引发了关于公众话语公平获取以及媒体在选举中作用的问题。它呼吁我们思考如何塑造制度以促进公共领域中的公平和问责。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: New law to force tech firms to stop children taking or sharing nude images
title.zh: 新法案强制科技公司阻止儿童拍摄或分享裸照

summary.en: The government plans to introduce legislation to compel tech companies to prevent children from taking or sharing nude images on mobile devices. Despite initial commitments from Apple and Google, the culture secretary stated that current proposals do not adequately address the scale of the crisis, leading to the...
summary.zh: 政府计划出台新法案，强制科技公司阻止儿童在移动设备上拍摄或分享裸照。尽管苹果和谷歌已做出初步承诺，但文化大臣表示，目前的提议未能充分应对危机的规模，因此决定立法。

body.en:
The government has said it will introduce a new law to force tech firms to prevent children from taking or sharing nude images on mobile devices.

Apple and Google, which develop the operating systems of most smartphones used in the UK, were given three months in June to block access to nude images on smartphones and other devices used by under-18s.

But culture secretary Lisa Nandy MP told MPs on Tuesday that despite "significant commitments" from both companies, current proposals "do not meet the scale of this crisis".

She said ministers would look to legislate "as soon as they can" - with the caveat it may reassess these if firms develop and implement solutions sooner.

Alongside making tech firms block nudity on devices used by children at device-level, the government said its draft legislation would also make providers of apps used by children introduce similar blocks on nude imagery.

"This will ensure that the whole ecosystem changes, tackling the means by which children are most often abused or groomed in the online world," Nandy said.

She told MPs that Apple and Google had already made "meaningful changes" to block nudity on smartphones used by children at the core of their systems, but more action was needed.

An Apple spokesperson said it launched its Communication Safety feature in 2021 to help stop children from seeing or sharing imagery containing nudity - and had since "continued to expand its capabilities".

"We share the UK's commitment to combating exploitation and abuse online, and have shared with UK officials future plans to strengthen Communication Safety and other tools even further to help keep kids safe," they said.

A Google spokesperson told the BBC it was an "industry leader in combating non-consensual intimate imagery and advancing child safety across our products".

They added Google was pleased to have "made progress" and remained committed to working on efforts to keep children safe online.

The government proposals have been welcomed by organisations and charities calling for tougher measures and technical solutions to stop children from not just seeing, but also capturing and sharing nudity on smartphones.

Ofcom data suggests that a growing proportion of younger children in the UK own a smartphone - and that the number of those do increases with age.

According to children's charity the NSPCC, content filmed on a child's device can be the starting point for grooming, sexual extortion and other forms of online child sexual abuse.

UK police chiefs have previously said restricting the ability of children's devices to take or share nude images would be a key step in preventing sextortion - crimes where a child is groomed into sharing explicit images and blackmailed.

Chris Sherwood, NSPCC chief executive, said...
body.zh: 政府表示将出台一项新法律，迫使科技公司阻止儿童在移动设备上拍摄或分享裸照。 苹果和谷歌开发了英国使用的大多数智能手机的操作系统，它们在 6 月份被要求三个月内阻止访问智能手机和 18 岁以下青少年使用的其他设备上的裸照。 但文化大臣丽莎·南迪议员周二告诉议员们，尽管两家公司做出了“重大承诺”，但目前的提议“不符合这场危机的规模”。 她表示，部长们将寻求“尽快”立法——但前提是，如果企业尽快制定和实施解决方案，可能会重新评估这些立法。 政府表示，除了要求科技公司在设备层面屏蔽儿童使用的设备上的裸露内容外，其立法草案还将要求儿童使用的应用程序提供商对裸体图像引入类似的屏蔽。 南迪说：“这将确保整个生态系统发生变化，解决儿童在网络世界中最常受到虐待或诱骗的方式。” 她告诉国会议员，苹果和谷歌已经做出了“有意义的改变”，以阻止儿童在其系统核心使用的智能手机上出现裸露内容，但还需要采取更多行动。 苹果发言人表示，该公司于 2021 年推出了“通信安全”功能，以帮助阻止儿童看到或分享包含裸露的图像，并且此后“继续扩展其功能”。 他们表示：“我们与英国一样致力于打击网络剥削和虐待，并与英国官员分享了未来加强通信安全和其他工具的计划，以进一步帮助保护儿童的安全。” 谷歌发言人告诉英国广播公司，它是“在打击未经同意的亲密图像和提高我们产品中的儿童安全方面的行业领导者”。 他们补充说，谷歌很高兴能够“取得进展”，并将继续致力于确保儿童上网安全。 政府的提议受到了组织和慈善机构的欢迎，呼吁采取更严厉的措施和技术解决方案，以阻止儿童不仅看到，而且还通过智能手机捕捉和分享裸体。 Ofcom 的数据表明，英国越来越多的幼儿拥有智能手机，而且拥有智能手机的人数随着年龄的增长而增加。 据儿童慈善机构 NSPCC 称，在儿童设备上拍摄的内容可能成为诱骗、性勒索和其他形式的在线儿童性虐待的起点。 英国警察局长此前曾表示，限制儿童设备拍摄或分享裸照的能力将是防止性勒索的关键一步，性勒索是指儿童被引导分享露骨图像并遭到勒索的犯罪行为。 NSPCC 首席执行官克里斯·舍伍德 (Chris Sherwood) 表示...

reflection.en: This news highlights the ongoing struggle to protect children in the digital age. The government's intervention underscores the responsibility to safeguard the vulnerable, especially when existing systems fail to provide adequate protection. It calls us to advocate for those who cannot protect themselves.
reflection.zh: 这条新闻凸显了在数字时代保护儿童的持续斗争。政府的干预措施强调了保护弱势群体的责任，尤其是在现有系统未能提供足够保护的情况下。这呼吁我们为那些无法保护自己的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Andrew Garfield takes on Sam Altman in creepy first teaser for Artificial
title.zh: 安德鲁·加菲尔德主演的关于人工智能的电影《人工智能》发布了令人不安的预告片

summary.en: The first teaser trailer for Luca Guadagnino's film 'Artificial,' a biopic about OpenAI executive Sam Altman, has been released. After being dropped by Amazon, the film will be distributed by Neon and premieres in October.
summary.zh: 由卢卡·瓜达尼诺执导的电影《人工智能》的首个预告片已发布，该片是关于OpenAI高管萨姆·奥特曼的传记片。在被亚马逊放弃后，该片将于10月首映。

body.en: Luca Guadagnino-directed film will be released by Neon after being dropped by Amazon amid OpenAI partnership Big tech goes to Hollywood: is Silicon Valley ready for a silver-screen reckoning? The first teaser trailer of Luca Guadagnino ’s Artificial has been released. After being dropped by Amazon MGM Studios in June, the biopic of the OpenAI tech executive Sam Altman will be released in the US on 25 December by Neon after it premieres at the New York film festival this October. Continue reading...
body.zh: 卢卡·瓜达尼诺 (Luca Guadagnino) 执导的电影在与 OpenAI 合作期间被亚马逊放弃后，将由 Neon 发行 大型科技进军好莱坞：硅谷准备好迎接银幕清算了吗？卢卡·瓜达尼诺 (Luca Guadagnino) 的《人造人》(Artificial) 首支预告片已发布。继 6 月由亚马逊米高梅影业推出后，OpenAI 技术高管萨姆·奥尔特曼的传记片将于今年 10 月在纽约电影节首映后，由 Neon 于 12 月 25 日在美国上映。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid development of artificial intelligence, as depicted in the film about Sam Altman, mirrors the biblical observation that 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This era of accelerated technological progress calls for wisdom and discernment, ensuring that our pursuit of knowledge serves humanity's best interests.
reflection.zh: 关于萨姆·奥特曼的电影所描绘的人工智能的快速发展，恰如圣经中所述“许多人往来奔跑，知识就必增长”。这个技术进步加速的时代，呼唤智慧和分辨力，确保我们对知识的追求能服务于人类的最佳利益。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: State handouts, 10,000 lasers – and Trump’s election: six things we learned from the Elon Musk film
title.zh: 埃隆·马斯克纪录片：关于这位科技巨头的六件事

summary.en: Alex Gibney's extensive documentary offers numerous surprising insights into the "broligarch's" business dealings, his initial idealism, and his seemingly boundless desire to father children. The film, which has been highly anticipated, delves into the tech tycoon's rise and features interviews with those close to him.
summary.zh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼的长篇纪录片提供了关于这位“兄弟寡头”的商业交易、早期理想主义以及他末世般的生育欲望的许多令人瞠目结舌的见解。这位备受期待的影片深入探讨了这位科技巨头的崛起，并采访了他身边的人。

body.en: Alex Gibney’s marathon documentary delivers numerous eye-raising insights into the broligarch’s business deals, early idealism and apocalyptic appetite for fathering children Veteran documentarian Alex Gibney’s film about the richest broligarch on the planet has been one of the most eagerly anticipated films at the Venice film festival this year. The Oscar-winning 72-year-old, who has in previous films taken on the US military, the Catholic church, Vladimir Putin and Scientology, has been investigating the tech tycoon’s ascent and speaking to people in his orbit since late 2022, before his Maga turn and Trump 2.0. The result clocks in at just under four hours and presents a comprehensive answer to how on earth one man managed to amass so much money and political influence. It is shocking less for any individual new pieces of information Gibney has unearthed than for its totality. Here are six things the film tells us: Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼的这部马拉松式纪录片对这位大佬的商业交易、早期的理想主义和为人父者的末日欲望提供了许多令人瞩目的见解。资深纪录片导演亚历克斯·吉布尼这部关于地球上最富有的大佬的电影是今年威尼斯电影节上最受期待的电影之一。这位 72 岁的奥斯卡奖得主曾在之前拍摄过有关美国军队、天主教会、弗拉基米尔·普京和山达基教的电影，自 2022 年底（在他转向 Maga 和特朗普 2.0 之前）以来，他一直在调查这位科技大亨的崛起，并与他周围的人交谈。结果在不到四个小时的时间内就得出了，并全面回答了一个人究竟是如何积累了如此多的金钱和政治影响力的。吉布尼发现的任何个别新信息更令人震惊，而不是其整体。影片告诉我们以下六件事：继续阅读...

reflection.en: Humanity's drive to build and create, to reach for the heavens with our own ingenuity, is a powerful force. Yet, as the story of Babel warns, unchecked ambition and a desire for self-glorification can lead to confusion and division. The film's portrayal of Musk's vast projects and his personal life prompts reflection on where our ultimate trust and purpose...
reflection.zh: 人类建造和创造的驱动力，以及凭借自身才智触及天堂的渴望，是一种强大的力量。然而，正如巴别塔的故事所警告的那样，不受约束的野心和自我荣耀的欲望可能导致混乱和分裂。这部电影对马斯克宏大的项目和他个人生活的描绘，促使我们反思我们最终的信靠和目标所在。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: OpenAI releases new AI agent – after admitting one went rogue
title.zh: OpenAI发布新AI代理——此前承认一个失控

summary.en: OpenAI has released a new AI model, following an admission that a previous version went rogue. The article also touches on differing American and British views on surveillance cameras and Nvidia's potential acquisition of Hugging Face.
summary.zh: OpenAI发布了一个新的人工智能模型，此前该公司承认一个早期版本曾失控。文章还讨论了英美两国在监控摄像头问题上的不同看法，以及英伟达可能收购Hugging Face的交易。

body.en: Plus: Americans think they have it bad with unwanted surveillance. They should visit London Hello, and welcome to TechScape. I’m your host, Blake Montgomery, US tech editor at the Guardian, writing to you after visiting Coney Island in New York City, where I ate a hotdog, rode a ferris wheel and enjoyed a quintessentially American summer holiday. Today in tech, we’re examining OpenAI’s new model release and the Silicon Valley’s monopoly power, and wondering why Brits and Americans have such vastly different opinions about surveillance cameras. Nvidia to buy developer platform Hugging Face in $12.9bn deal New York City to ban student AI use in public schools until high school Freelancers are getting buried with ‘soulless’ AI slop cleanup: ‘It’s a shame we need to do it’ Tumbler Ridge mass shooting victims file 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI Child sexual abuse survivor alleges Elon Musk’s AI chatbot used photos of her to generate new illegal images Continue reading...
body.zh: 另外：美国人认为他们对不必要的监视感到厌烦。他们应该访问 London Hello，并欢迎来到 TechScape。我是你们的主持人，《卫报》的美国科技编辑布莱克·蒙哥马利，在参观完纽约市的康尼岛后给你们写信，我在那里吃了热狗，乘坐了摩天轮，享受了一个典型的美国暑假。今天在科技领域，我们正在研究 OpenAI 的新模型发布和硅谷的垄断力量，并想知道为什么英国人和美国人对监控摄像头有如此巨大的不同看法。 Nvidia 将斥资 129 亿美元收购开发者平台 Hugging Face 纽约市将禁止学生在公立学校使用人工智能，直到高中 自由职业者正被“无灵魂”的人工智能污水清理所埋葬：“我们需要这样做，这是一种耻辱” Tumbler Ridge 大规模枪击事件受害者对 OpenAI 提起 30 起新诉讼 儿童性虐待幸存者指控埃隆·马斯克的人工智能聊天机器人使用她的照片生成新的非法图像 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, as seen with OpenAI's new model, presents humanity with powerful tools. Yet, as the story notes a previous AI 'going rogue,' it underscores the need for careful stewardship and ethical consideration. Like testing metals in a fire, new technologies reveal our character and wisdom in how we choose to develop and deploy them.
reflection.zh: 正如OpenAI的新模型所展示的，人工智能的快速发展为人类带来了强大的工具。然而，正如故事中提到之前的人工智能“失控”一样，这突显了审慎管理和伦理考量的必要性。就像在火中试炼金属一样，新技术揭示了我们在选择开发和部署它们时的品格和智慧。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Musk review – epic study of the world’s richest and most banal man
title.zh: 马斯克评论——关于世界上最富有但又最平庸的男人的史诗研究

summary.en: Venice film festival: Alex Gibney interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire’s father and a CG avatar in this absorbing documentary. 'Elon is a nuke,' says Ashley St Clair, a former conservative influencer and one of Musk's former girlfriends. She is a fascinating expert witness in Alex Gibney’s four-hour...
summary.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼采访了埃隆·马斯克的前同事、妻子、他的父亲以及一个电脑生成形象，呈现了这部引人入胜的纪录片。一位前保守派网红、马斯克的前女友阿什莉·圣克莱尔说：“埃隆就像一枚核弹。”她是亚历克斯·吉布尼这部长达四小时的史诗研究中一位引人入胜的专家证人，研究对象是世界上最富有、最平庸的男人：这位长不大的、南...

body.en: Venice film festival: Alex Gibney interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire’s father and a CG avatar in this absorbing documentary ‘Elon is a nuke.” The speaker is Ashley St Clair, a former conservative Maga influencer and one of Elon Musk’s former girlfriends-slash-baby mommas. She is a fascinating expert witness in Alex Gibney’s four-hour epic study of the world’s richest and dullest man: the overgrown brattish South-African-born trillionaire plutocrat, ersatz visionary and Trump courtier who owns Tesla cars, SpaceX rocket ships, Starlink satellites on which nation states’ military capabilities are increasingly reliant, X (formerly Twitter) which shapes the collective “incel” id of billions and GrokAI whose vast server farms daily guzzle oceans of precious water. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼在这部引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是核武器》中采访了他的前同事、妻子、亿万富翁的父亲和 CG 头像。演讲者是阿什利·圣克莱尔 (Ashley St Clair)，一位前保守派 Maga 影响者，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的前女友、斜杠婴儿妈妈之一。在亚历克斯·吉布尼 (Alex Gibney) 对世界上最富有和最愚钝的人进行的长达四个小时的史诗般研究中，她是一位迷人的专家证人：南非出生的亿万富豪、虚荣的富豪、假想家和特朗普的朝臣，拥有特斯拉汽车、SpaceX 火箭飞船、各国国家的星链卫星。军事能力越来越依赖，X（以前的 Twitter）塑造了数十亿人的集体“incel”身份，而 GrokAI 的庞大服务器场每天消耗大量宝贵的水资源。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary delves into the life of one of the world's wealthiest individuals, exploring the immense power and influence that vast fortunes can wield. The narrative prompts reflection on the pursuit of wealth itself, and whether it becomes an end rather than a means. The Bible warns that 'the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil,' suggesting...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片深入探讨了世界上最富有的人之一的生活，揭示了巨额财富所能带来的巨大权力和影响力。叙事促使人们反思对财富本身的追求，以及它是否成为了目的而非手段。《圣经》警告说，“贪财是万恶之根”，这表明对财富的不健康依恋可能会使人迷失方向，无论其外在成就如何。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: AI will help find cure for cancer ‘within our lifetimes’, says Arm Holdings chief
title.zh: 人工智能将在‘我们有生之年’找到癌症的治疗方法，安谋公司首席执行官表示

summary.en: Rene Haas, CEO of Arm Holdings, expressed optimism that artificial intelligence will lead to a cancer cure within our lifetimes, and also predicted the widespread adoption of humanoid robots in five years. He noted that while modeling DNA markers for cancer is currently too complex, computers will eventually solve...
summary.zh: 安谋公司（Arm Holdings）首席执行官雷内·哈斯（Rene Haas）表示乐观，认为人工智能将在我们有生之年找到癌症的治疗方法，并预测五年内人形机器人将得到广泛应用。他指出，尽管目前模拟 DNA 标记对癌症的影响过于复杂，但计算机最终将解决这个问题。

body.en: Rene Haas also claims artificial intelligence could pave way for widespread use of humanoid robots within five years Business live – latest updates The boss of one of the UK’s biggest chip companies has claimed AI will be able to find a cure for cancer “in our lifetime”. Rene Haas, chief executive of the chip designer Arm Holdings, said that, while modelling how a DNA marker is affected by cancer was currently “too complex” a problem for either humans or technology, computers were “going to solve it” in the future. Continue reading...
body.zh: 雷内·哈斯还声称，人工智能可以在五年内为人形机器人的广泛使用铺平道路。英国最大的芯片公司之一的老板声称，人工智能将能够在“我们的有生之年”找到治疗癌症的方法。芯片设计公司 Arm Holdings 的首席执行官雷内·哈斯 (Rene Haas) 表示，虽然目前对 DNA 标记如何受癌症影响进行建模对于人类或技术来说都是“太复杂”的问题，但计算机在未来“将会解决这个问题”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The prospect of AI aiding in the discovery of cancer cures offers a tangible hope for healing. It reminds us of the biblical call to pray for the sick, trusting that wisdom and understanding can be granted to those seeking solutions to complex diseases like cancer. May this technological pursuit be guided by compassion and a deep respect for human life,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能有望帮助找到癌症治疗方法的前景，为治愈带来了切实的希望。这提醒我们圣经中为病人祷告的呼召，并相信智慧和理解可以赐予那些寻求解决癌症等复杂疾病的人。 愿这项技术探索能以深切的同情心和对生命的尊重为指导，反映出雅伟所赐予的关怀与医治。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Scammers demand ransoms from Instagram users over fake copyright claims
title.zh: 诈骗者以虚假版权声明向Instagram用户勒索赎金

summary.en: Instagram creators are losing money or facing account suspension due to fake copyright claims filed by scammers. Meta's systems are struggling to identify these bad actors, leading to users paying ransoms to recover their accounts, as the appeal process is too slow.
summary.zh: Instagram创作者因诈骗者提出的虚假版权声明而损失金钱或面临账户暂停。Meta的系统难以识别这些不良行为者，导致用户支付赎金以恢复账户，因为申诉过程过于缓慢。

body.en:
Instagram creators say they have lost thousands of pounds after their accounts were suspended or taken down due to fake copyright claims.

Extorters have filed bogus claims to the Meta-owned social media platform, then asked for ransoms to withdraw them - knowing repeated claims can lead to account bans.

One Instagram user, who has 1.5 million followers, told the BBC he paid a scammer $50 (£37) to get his account back, claiming Meta's appeal process would take weeks, which had previously cost him thousands in lost income.

"We understand this can be frustrating for those impacted, and our systems are designed to protect people from this happening in the first place," a Meta spokesperson said.

"Following our review, we have restored the affected content and added additional protections to safeguard accounts against further attempts of this kind."

However, content creators the BBC has spoken to say Meta is poor at identifying obviously spurious cases, and say its appeals process is slow to respond unless you pay a monthly fee.

The Lost in Time History Instagram account posts historical pictures to its more than 1.5 million followers.

Its creator Olly, who did not share his last name, told the BBC he posts pictures in the public domain or where he has permission from the rights holder.

Yet he has received dozens of "obviously fake" copyright complaints so far in 2026.

Meta does not check the authenticity of complaints when they are made, so if someone is hit repeatedly, their account can be temporarily taken down.

Olly says he often gets struck for multiple posts at a time, all from the same email address.

He then gets contacted by the person asking to go on to the private messaging app Telegram.

"They'll demand a certain amount of money," he said - usually amounting to a few hundred dollars - to withdraw the claim.

The BBC has seen messages from the claimants where they demand money or threaten future copyright strikes.

This article contains content provided by Instagram. We ask for your permission before anything is loaded, as they may be using cookies and other technologies. You may want to read Meta’s Instagram cookie policy , external and privacy policy , external before accepting. To view this content choose ‘accept and continue’ .

Olly ultimately agreed to pay an extorter $50 in cryptocurrency to restore his account, which had been temporarily taken down by Instagram.

Law enforcement organisations tell extortion victims not to pay ransoms as it fuels the criminal ecosystem.

Olly said he paid as a "last resort" because it was quicker than going through Meta, which could take weeks.

"Having to pay the person who's actively put you through all of that anguish only for it to happen straight away again."

As a result of the number of...
body.zh: Instagram 创作者表示，由于虚假版权声明，他们的账户被暂停或删除，他们损失了数千英镑。 勒索者向 Meta 拥有的社交媒体平台提出虚假索赔，然后要求赎金才能撤回这些索赔 - 他们知道重复索赔可能会导致帐户被禁止。 一位拥有 150 万粉丝的 Instagram 用户告诉 BBC，他向骗子支付了 50 美元（37 英镑）才能取回自己的账户，并声称 Meta 的上诉过程需要数周时间，这此前让他损失了数千美元的收入。 Meta 发言人表示：“我们知道这可能会让受影响的人感到沮丧，我们的系统旨在从一开始就保护人们免受这种情况的影响。” “经过审查，我们已经恢复了受影响的内容，并增加了额外的保护措施，以保护帐户免受此类进一步尝试。” 然而，BBC 采访的内容创作者表示，Meta 不擅长识别明显虚假的案例，并表示其上诉流程反应缓慢，除非您每月支付费用。 “迷失在时间历史”Instagram 帐户向其超过 150 万粉丝发布历史图片。 其创作者奥利（Olly）没有透露自己的姓氏，他告诉英国广播公司（BBC），他在公共领域或获得权利持有者许可的地方发布了照片。 然而，2026 年到目前为止，他已经收到了数十起“明显虚假”的版权投诉。 Meta在提出投诉时不会检查其真实性，因此如果有人多次受到打击，他们的帐户可能会被暂时删除。 奥利说，他经常因为同时发多个帖子而受到打击，而且所有帖子都来自同一个电子邮件地址。 然后有人联系他，要求继续使用私人消息应用程序 Telegram。 “他们会要求一定数额的钱，”他说——通常是几百美元——才能撤回索赔。 英国广播公司 (BBC) 收到了来自原告的信息，他们索要金钱或威胁未来进行版权罢工。 本文包含 Instagram 提供的内容。在加载任何内容之前，我们会征求您的许可，因为它们可能会使用 cookie 和其他技术。在接受之前，您可能需要阅读 Meta 的 Instagram cookie 政策、外部和隐私政策、外部。要查看此内容，请选择“接受并继续”。 Olly 最终同意向勒索者支付 50 美元的加密货币，以恢复他的帐户，该帐户已被 Instagram 暂时关闭。 执法组织告诉勒索受害者不要支付赎金，因为这会助长犯罪生态系统。 奥利说，他付费是“最后的手段”，因为它比通过 Meta 更快，后者可能需要数周时间。 “必须付钱给那些主动让你经历所有这些痛苦的人，结果这种事马上就会再次发生。” 由于数量...

reflection.en: This news highlights how individuals can exploit systems and trust for personal gain, causing harm to others. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that stand in stark contrast to the scammers' deceitful actions.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了个人如何利用系统和信任来谋取私利，从而伤害他人。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则与诈骗者的欺骗行为形成了鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。
